title: 法国手推车背鹿 - 中文
author: Cherihawn
steps: 4建造农shift回羊
双击6 Villagers to Sheep ，HQQ，1 农 Mill and House 返回吃羊.
1 Villager to Gold and Mining Camp
Rally 4 Villagers to Gold and Wheelbarrow
Rally to Sheep 直到 Feudal Age
二本地标 School of Cavalry 提前 编号4 Sheep Villager ，385以上手动提交
建造4农shift回去吃羊
Rally to Straggler Tree until 5 Villagers on Wood
1 Gold 农，建造 House
看情况进攻对方，适当时候，出冲车，萌新一定记得暴兵
点 Professional Scouts and Royal Knight ，吃羊农手动提交，骑兵学校生产3 Scouts 去鹿区
1伐木农，建造 Archery Range ，1金农建造 House ， Rally Sheep
1吃羊农，建造 Archery Range ，5农民TC穿越，去吃鹿。 持续生产 Archer 保护背鹿
Archery Range 建造好，转移3个吃羊农去采金，金农补 House
持续金马和小弓，保护金区和背鹿，尽量不要断，持续生产 Archer Royal Knight
1农补 Blacksmith ，点 Iron Undermesh Steeled Arrow ，8分钟差不多6个小弓，3匹金马
Chivalry Cantled Saddles ， Rally Gold ，金马小弓不要断
10农采金后，木农补 Stable
差不多9金马，15个小弓
差不多14金马，18个小弓
开始吃浆果，点 Horticulture
开始8农吃猪肉，立塔，尽早开二金
另外的情况，二本一拳打不死，需要考虑上三，马弓，小弓是前排，便宜量大，分散站位，金马游龙，马弓拉扯走A
兵回来，TC十几个吃肉农民去建造 Guild Hall ，TC补吃肉
上3以后，补5农挖石头

title: General Castle
description: Baseline to easily pivot if fuedal pressure
author: ChinoCochino
steps: Use 2-4 Villagers age up aachen chapel is best if you have the ability to go it without harrass. if you are being harrasssed or plan on fuedal pressure go meinwark. meinwark always in the front, aachen needs to hit 2 resources
OOTD should always have 5 vills on wild food, scout for first deer pack and move to it if possible
rally food

when getting to castle you can make either a barracks or a stable, stable is more universally good. ootd units are expensive and easy to over produce, 2-4 spears will defend a whole base if used well. 2-4 horsemen the same, if you go more than this might as well consider yourself fuedal
You can think about going "naked" castle at this point not a bad idea but greedy for sure
at this point you can get castle in 8-10 min with 2 horsemen or not basically same timer
burger is not enough to mass, make barracks
age to burger for now, once you get better and more comfortable with the civ you will go reignitz but for now burger into maa spears

title: 2 TC ayyubid "the beasty build" - copy
description: 2 TC ayyubid build, beasty was bored so he cooked this BO
author: MJAYwarrior
steps: Make Camel Lancer + Archer. Make Tower of the Sultan to push enemy base
1 Villager builds House of Wisdom and House, 2 Villagers go to Sheep and 3 Villagers go to Gold (don't make a Mining Camp, we need only 30 Gold ) Rally Food
When you have resources go for Advancement (Bonus Culture Wing), 6 Villagers go to mine Stone Rally Stone
Once you have 350 Stone all Villager you had in Stone go to Wood Rally Wood
Once you have 350s and 400w build a Town Center near Wood or Gold (move 4 Villagers to Food while building it for Villager production)

Here you need to build military poroduction buildings, you need to respond to the rival. But most likely you go 2 Archery Ranges and 2 Stables then Horseman and Archer (Make barracks if it's against knight civ)
Age up with Growth (Bonus Economic Wing) (If you can don't use Berries until age up is done)

title: Beasty 2TC (detailed) - 中文翻譯
description: 2TC
author: leadingtw
steps: 3 村民吃 Sheep, 3 村民採 Stone. 第一位產生村民蓋 Farmhouse 去採 Berries, 之後 Rally 至 Stone 直到 5 人
集結採 Food
存 300 Stone, 升級 Daimyo Manor. 注意: 升級 Daimyo Manor 時, 不要排 Villager 在後面生產
4 Food 村民去蓋 Kura Storehouse. Food 村民留 4 個, 其他採 Wood (不要蓋 Lumber Camp, 去採靠近 TC 的 Straggler Tree ). Rally 至 Wood
存到 350 Stone, 讓採 Stone 村民去採 Wood (靠近 TC 的 Straggler Tree )
拉 8 採 Wood 村民去造 2 TC 在 Gold 旁. 蓋 Lumber Camp, 保持 8 ~ 10 村民採 Wood
蓋 2TC 村民去採 Gold. 兩TC Rally 至 Food. 1 村民蓋 Barracks 開始產 Onna-Bugeisha. 如果可以, 升級 Tawara, Double Broadax, Takezaiku, Tatara (如果敵人有弓箭手, 升級 Iron Undermesh ). 用額外的 Wood 去蓋 Palisade Wall

title: Beastyqt’s OOTD Aggresive Strategy - Simplified
description: * This Build Order focuses on early pressure using powerful units from the Order of the Dragon. * It highlights resource management to sustain the expensive army units. * The strategy allows you to create two unit types to counter your opponent's forces and change unit types as needed. This Build Order was created by Beastyqt.
author: othmen
steps: 5 Villagers to Sheep
Rally 2 to Gold first builds House then Mining Camp
Rally to Sheep until 9
Send 2 Villagers from Sheep to build Meinwerk Palace for Feudal Age
Send 3 Villagers from Sheep to Wood
Rally to Wood until 6
Send a Villager from Sheep to build a Mill and then to Berries
Build a Lumber Camp with a Villager from Wood
Research Wheelbarrow
Rally to Sheep until you have 12
Send Villager Meinwerk Palace to build Stable and then to Sheep (Immediately start producing Gilded Horseman )
Build a House
With your first Gilded Horseman, go harass enemy Villager
Build Archery Range and start producing Gilded Archer. If your enemy goes cavalry, build a Barracks instead and produce Gilded Spearman
Research Double Broadax
Rally 2 Villagers to Wood. Then Rally to Food until you have 14
Research Iron Undermesh / Fitted Leatherwork / Steeled Arrow / Bloomery depending on your enemy’s army composition
watch over the population limit Order of the Dragon military units take 2 population spaces. Build House when you need it
Build Archery Range / Barracks and keep the producting Gilded Archer / Gilded Spearman
When you run out of food, go for Boar or Deer if it is safe. then research Survival Techniques. Slowly build Farm before running out of food sources. Research Horticulture in that case
Rally Villager to Wood until 15. Then rally to Food again

From now on, the match depends on your enemy’s response and army composition. Research Iron Undermesh / Fitted Leatherwork / Steeled Arrow / Bloomery, build more Barracks / Archery Range / Stable, research Siege Engineering to build Battering Ram, save resources to age up to Castle Age and send more Villager to Gold to produce Gilded Knight / Gilded Crossbowman, or decide what you believe is best for the match.

title: Mongol build attempt #1
author: phoenixchamp
steps: Unpack town center near large tree patch, unpack ger at gold, khan gets sheep
Build Ovoo on stone
Deer Stones Build it next to Ovoo, Spawn new villagers on wood

Usually you will have weaker units than most other civs until you castle. Your objective is to not let them feel safe enough to leave their camp. If you have mangudai outside their camp and watch towers for vision, you can stop them from spawning and sending individual units to your camp or somewhere that bothers you. He then has to keep his units (military and villagers) close to his town center.
Build Archery Range and Market, start trading, eventually have 10 Venetian Traders
Start to harass with 2 Mangudai, once you have 4 of them, make 1 Khan’s Hunter. Keep in mind mangudai lose to archers.
You can completely stop enemy from growing outside of the range of their town center with the mangudai, stop them from getting secondary food (deer) etc, build Outpost close to their base for eyes
Have one more market than enemy has trade centers to stay on top economically
Whenever you run out of sheep, have all but 2 food villagers go to Berries, build Ger. 2 food villagers build at least three Pasture next to town center
Build Stable, Barracks if necessary depending on what units enemy has
Kurultai
Keep building more and more Pasture
Khaganate Palace

title: china 2TC
description: The Villager #'s aren't perfect as it can vary based on map/opponent civ/how quickly you can macro - more of just an outline that you can play around with!
author: siberian_wolf
steps: 6 Villagers on Mill ( Wood ) on Sheep ( Mill ). 2 Rally on House on Gold. 5 Rally on Sheep
5 Sheep Villager,then Imperial Academy. 3 Rally on Straggler Tree

This is the end of the build order, but from here there are many options on how to proceed with the game: 1. Pro Scout into Fast Castle - If you are under ZERO pressure from opponent (i.e. they are playing a fast castle civ), you can remacro onto Food Gold, go Imperial Palace, and make Lancer + Archer or Spearman and Palace Guard + Archer. 2. Feudal All In - You can keep the Stable Imperial Official and pump out Horseman and Archer and just try to end the game right away. 3. Fast Song Dynasty - During Feudal, you can make Barbican of the Sun to get Song Dynasty for Zhuge Nu and Granary and all in this way as well, I usually like to go Song at some point during the game because Zhuge Nu go brr and Granary are crucial in mid-late game once you have run out of deer. Really just go crazy with it idk man i love this civ
5 Imperial Academy Villager on Sheep. Imperial Official on Mill on 2 Collect Tax. Imperial Official on 4 Rally on Lumber Camp on Straggler Tree
2 Gold on Barbican of the Sun on Stone. Mill Imperial Official on 6 Sheep Villager on Mining Camp on Stone. Rally Imperial Official on Lumber Camp. Rally on Straggler Tree. 3 Rally on Sheep
8 Stone Villager on Town Center on Sheep. Rally Imperial Official on Mill. 2 Rally on Sheep

title: HRE FC (VortiX)
author: Sabrosito
steps: Rally to Sheep
1* Villager to House then Sheep
2* Villager Sheep to Meinwerk Palace. 2* Villager Sheep to Wood
create 1 * Prelate to Gold
when Prelate arrive 2* Villager Sheep to Gold
1 new Villager to Wood. then Rally to Sheep
8* Villager Sheep to Regnitz Cathedral (near Straggler Tree ). 1* Villager Gold to Stable
2* Prelate to Relic. Rally to Gold
in Regnitz Cathedral,then Cistercian Abbeys. in Stable,then Knight. in Meinwerk Palace,then Steel Barding
WHEN Cistercian Abbeys,then 8* Villager to Wood. Prelate to Regnitz Cathedral. Rally to Wood
When have Relic you can split Gold Villager to Wood Food. Use Monastery as drop-off

title: Beasty's 1-3-1-1 into 2 TC into late game for me (a noob playing team games)

steps: 1 Food 3 Lumber Camps Wood 1 Mining Camp Gold 1 Mining Camp Stone. Rally Food

1 Build,then Build Military School
4 Food,then Feudal Age Twin Minaret Medrese,then Berries. 4 Food,then Wood. Rally Wood (10)
When at 100, 1 Stone,then Gold
Build House
Rally Food when Wood (10)

Double Broadax. 1 Military School,then Mehter (1),then Sipahi
Build House (a few)
Produce Archer
1st Vizier Point: Anatolian Hills (or Field Work )
Horticulture. Stable,then Sipahi (At that point, 3 Archers 3 Spearmen 1 Sipahi 1 Mehter present)
Steeled Arrow (At that point, 7 Archers 3 Spearmen 3 Sipahis 1 Mehter present)
Rally Gold (At that point, 9 Archers 3 Spearmen 6 Sipahis 1 Mehter present)
Iron Undermesh
2nd Vizier Point: Military Campus. 4 Wood,then Stone (450) (At that point, 12 Archers 3 Spearmen 12 Sipahis 1 Mehter present)
8 Food,then Castle Age Mehmed Imperial Armory,then Food
Wheelbarrow Specialized Pick ( Survival Techniques if deer). 1 Stone,then Build Military School,then Wood. 3 Gold,then Wood
8 Build,then Food. Rally Wood (30+) to prepare for army + Farm + 2nd Town Center
Upgrade Archer and Sipahi to VETERAN. Production buildings: 1 Barracks; 2 Archery Ranges; 2 Stables; 3 Military Schools; 1 Siege Workshop
Vizier Point: Advanced Academy. Military School,then Janissary
Once you get 350 Stone, build 2nd Town Center behind your base to protect future Farm placements. Ideally you want it near Wood.
4 Build 0,then Food / Wood / Gold
Start building Farm and Mill
Lumber Preservation Fertilization Shaft Mining when you can
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this before Imperial Age use 2 TC to increase
Fertilization Lumber Preservation Shaft Mining when you can
Start building Farm and Mill
Wedge Rivets Fitted Leatherwork Insulated Helm Bloomery Decarbonization when you can
Vizier Point Janissary Company then Siege Crews
Istanbul Observatory: Always the best choice. Sea Gate Castle: Only if you desperately need to protect your base from an incoming all-in OR if you are trading (which we are not doing in this guide).

Army composition: Archer + Sipahi + Janissary + Mehter + Great Bombard. OR (vs Lancer + Archer ). Archer + Lancer + Crossbowman + Mehter + Mangonel. Add Ribauldequin if enemy is making melee units only
Upgrade Sipahi to elite. Upgrade Janissary to elite and research Janissary Guns. Upgrade Archer to elite. Produce Great Bombard, Add Ribauldequin if enemy is making melee units only
Make Market and Venetian Trader and send to teammates markets for gold
See to the left. Ideal economy balance
University upgrades University. Biology (,then Incendiary Arrows ),then Elite Army Tactics,then Chemistry,then Siege Works when you can
Precision Cross-Breeding Crosscut Saw Cupellation when you can
Angled Surfaces Master Smiths Damascus Steel Platecutter Point when you can

title: Mongol
author: Myff
steps: 5 Villagers go on Wood, 1 Villager build Ovoo then to Gold. After the TC is placed near a forest, switch the 5 to Food.
1 Villager to Food
1 Villager to Gold
Rally Food until Feudal Age
Age up with 3 Food Villager on either The Silver Tree for trade / Deer Stones if Trade Posts spawn bad. (add markets later)
Keep 4 Food Villager and 2 Gold Villager. Rest to Wood until Stable
Build Stable with 2 Villagers and Rally Food until 11 Food Villager then add 2 Villagers to Gold
Feudal Age: Queue 2x Keshiks and Rally Wood until 5
add Archery Range and constantly produce Keshik + Archer. Rally Food until 14 then Wood until 11 then Gold until 8 and add Venetian Trader + more production

Keep building army and when you can, start adding traders. Ultimately you want to take full map control, pocket resources, then go castle, get veterancy upgrades and win with a castle timing attack through Kurultai. Remember Relic and all the eco upgrades.

title: Beastyqt’s Knights Templar Aggro - Pilgrims Strategy
description: This Build Order is meant to help you build a strong economy. You will be able to afford any units that you want, in any of the many combinations you will have to choose from with Knights Templar. This Build Order was created by Beastyqt.
author: RMSeba13
steps: Send all 6 Villagers to Sheep
Send the next Villager to build House and another Villager from Sheep to build Mining Camp. Then send them both to Gold
Rally Villager to Sheep until you have 10
When you gather 200 Gold, send the 2 Villagers from Gold, 2 from Sheep and the next to Wood
Age up to Feudal Age with Kingdom of France

If your enemy is going aggresive with Spearman / Horseman, you should delay the Safe Passage strategy and build an Archery Range / Barracks and produce Archer / Spearman. When playing with Knights Templar, it is likely that your enemy will try to stop your Safe Passage, so you need to protect them and change the Sacred Site destination accordingly.

From now on, you need to manage your economy depending on how the match is developing. Remember to send Villager to Gold as the Safe Passage will not supply enough on their own. Produce more military units, gather Stone to build Fortress at your enemy's city (and get more Safe Passage ), keep pushing your enemy or save resources to age up to Castle Age
When you age up to Feudal Age, inmediately research Safe Passage and send them to the best Sacred Site location
Send the next 2 Villagers alongside with 1 from Sheep to Wood
Queue Sanctuary. This should be perfectly timed so the next time your pilgrims spawn (every 60 seconds), you can have 2 instead of 1 (start researching Sanctuary at least 20 seconds before the spawn)
Rally Villager to Food
Build a Stable and start producing Chevalier Confrere. Build an Archery Range and produce Archer
Go harass your enemy Villager

title: Chinese Tax Mill into Pro Scouts & Fast Castle
description: A unique way to play Chinese with pro scouts and fast age up behind it leading into PGs or Lancer Spam
author: PengPrimate
steps: build an Imperial Official and send 6 Villagers to Sheep with a Mill + House close to Town Center
Rally 2 Villagers build a Mining Camp and gather Gold
Rally back to Sheep at Mill until Feudal Age
build Imperial Academy near Mill and wood line with 3 Villagers from Sheep
Remacro (see tab to the left) and Rally Villager to Straggler Tree,then Wood until 8 Villagers on Wood
at 50 wood: build Lumber Camp
Get Survival Techniques when Deer is dropped to Mill. Dont forget to route the drop offs from scouts to the Mill for Collect Tax
Queue 2 Imperial Officials consecutively from Imperial Academy.
Build a Lumber Camp and Supervise Food / Wood
Stable and 3-4 Scouts from Stable
Professional Scouts from Mill. After Professional Scouts started get 3rd Imperial Official
Outpost on Gold and remacro (see tab to the left). Rally Food
Village
Build Imperial Palace with 8 Villagers from Sheep
Remacro and get economy upgrades. You will be up fast, so prepare to macro for Supervise Lancer or Palace Guard production.

Monastery and Lancer production. Keep making lancers until opponent makes mass Spearman / Crossbowman. Then it will be time for archers for you and therefore remacro. You can take this many other directions too, but now you are set for a safe castle age with food and relics. Do with that what you want:P

title: 2 TC Ayubíes

Cuando tengas x350 Stone, mueve los Villager de Stone a Wood. Rally Wood

Construye Stable y Archery Range, y produce Horseman y Archer. (Construye Barracks en lugar de Archery Range si te enfrentas a una civilización de caballería). Balancea tu economía entre Food, Wood y Gold
Sube de edad con Growth (Bonus Economic Wing) (si puedes, no tomes Berries hasta haber subido de edad)
Cuando llegues a Castle Age produce Camel Lancer + Archer para presionar al enemigo.

author: Pilsen
steps: 6x Villagers on Sheep. Next 2x Villagers on Mining Camp Gold and make 1x House. Next 2x Villagers on Lumber Camp Wood. Next 3x Villagers on Mining Camp Stone
When 3900 Gold left --,then. Age up building Lancaster Castle with 3x Villagers from Sheep. Move 2x Villagers from Gold to Wood. Rally Wood until you have 15x Villagers there
Since you have very solid defense from the Manors, Landcaster Castle and TC, you can even try going Fast Castle or 2 TC! There are many possibilites!

title: Japanese | Feudal all-in
description: Aggressive build order to try and overwhelm the opponent with a strong push in Feudal Age. Block enemy production with shinobis' sabotage abilty and win by simply outnumbering the opponent. Other japanese builds: - FC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/vEngvoom6xbHijnpEYRl - 2TC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/BKgxe5CAXfcRTj4Sbq5C
author: Jockxtar
steps: Since you don't rely on Sheep, use Scout to go deep into the enemy side of the map, try to steal their Sheep and check their landmarks. Use the idle time to talk to your allies and plan a strategy, your base's layout, how will you defend yourself during Feudal Age, etc.
5 Villagers,then Sheep. 1 Villager,then build Farmhouse at Berries
Rally,then Gold (2). First one builds Forge
Rally,then Sheep (10)
Rally,then Straggler Tree (5). We need to chop 2 entire Straggler Tree before building a Lumber Camp
Build Koka Township with 3 Sheep Villager. Of the 3 Villagers Build Koka Township: 2 to Gold, 1 to Wood
2 Sheep Villager,then Gold
Farmhouse,then Tawara
Forge,then Tatara
Build Farmhouse at Berries
Rally,then Sheep (30)
Build Barracks with 1 Food Villager
Army composition: Shinobi + Horseman + Naginata Samurai. Add Spearman vs Knight. Add Battering Ram to finish off the opponent
Farmhouse,then Takezaiku
Barracks upgrade Naginata Samurai
Produce Shinobi on Koka Township. Shinobi role will be to use sabotage on enemy production buildings, nothing more. Once they do that, retreat them to safety.

--- vs Delhi Sultanate French Jeanne d'Arc Rus Knights Templar Mongols Byzantines ( Imperial Hippodrome ) ---. Upgrade and produce Spearman to counter their cavalry. Keep a few protecting your Food Villager, move the rest to help in the all-in.
Once Takezaiku is finished, move Sheep Villager to Berries. Rally,then Berries (30)
Build Stable with 1 Wood Villager
Forge,then Iron Undermesh
Build Farmhouse with Food Villager as you need them
Forge,then Hizukuri

Produce Shinobi, Horseman and Naginata Samurai nonstop. Add Spearman vs Knight. 6 Shinobi is enough to constantly sabotage up to 3 production buildings. But, because they might die during fights, it's best to have at least 9. Prioritize Horseman over Naginata Samurai, as they are more useful at both killing Villager and ranged units. While you mass a decently sized army, focus on blocking resources such as Gold and Stone, and sabotage production buildings with Shinobi. To do this, move the Naginata Samurai first to tank the Town Center shots, then move the Horseman to force enemy ranged units away or get some Villager kills. Last, move the Shinobi to use the sabotage skill. Don't fully dive the enemy Town Center too soon or you will not be able to reach critical mass.
When you start to gather from Deer and Boar, research Survival Techniques
Town Center cancel all Villager on queue and research Daimyo Manor
Stable make 1 Uma Bannerman
Tatara + Hizukuri + Uma Bannerman aura allows Horseman to reach killing breakpoints on Villager even if they have Textiles (6 hits with it, 4 hits without it). This makes them really strong raiders.

Once the Uma Bannerman reaches the Horseman army, it's the perfect moment to go for the dive. Focus production buildings first, then Outpost and then additional Town Center before going for the main Town Center.
With excess Wood build a second Stable and a second Barracks. With excess Gold research Specialized Pick, Double Broadax and Fitted Leatherwork

If you see an angle to finish the opponent, research Siege Engineering and build 2 Battering Rams. You can put Shinobi inside Battering Ram to protect them against Town Center fire while waiting for a new round of sabotages on the enemy production.
If you can't quite finish off the opponent and end up with a high bank of Gold, stop producing units for a bit and age up Castle Age
Floating Gate to boost production further and research veteran upgrade for Horseman quicker.
Research veteran upgrade for Horseman and Naginata Samurai, Wedge Rivets and Kobuse-gitae. That's all you should need to close the game by simply torching down enemy landmarks.

Much safer but worse scaling.

Leave the 4 Villagers on Stone to later build and upgrade Tughluqabad Fort
Rally,then Sheep (20)
--- vs cavalry civs ---. 1 Wood Villager,then Build Barracks
Main Town Center Rally,then Food. 2nd Town Center Rally,then Wood
Research Wheelbarrow and Woven Baskets

When you get 400 Stone, build Tughluqabad Fort near your two Town Center with at least 2 empty tiles around it to build House and Farm. Select Bhakkar as the governor for this Tughluqabad Fort. The passive Food will help us fund the extra Villager production and eventually go to Castle Age. Prioritize upgrading it rather than building new Tughluqabad Fort.
If the opponent is playing aggressive and forces you to make units in Feudal Age, build Blacksmith and research the upgrades, otherwise you will soon start floating Gold

House of Learning: Offers excellent upgrades for our core units (the elephants). Compound of the Defender: Since we are already playing very greedy with the second Town Center, focusing on building and upgrading Tughluqabad Fort is too greedy.
During age up make sure to build another Tughluqabad Fort and assign Uch as its governor for the discounts on upgrades.
Army composition: Early: Spearman + Crossbowman + Raider Elephant. Late: War Elephant + Ballista Elephant + Raider Elephant. Add a few Man-at-Arms to tank Spearman
Gradually build Farm and Tughluqabad Fort to complete your economy.
Defend with an infantry army ( Spearman + Crossbowman ) and raid with Raider Elephant. Add a few Man-at-Arms to tank Spearman
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production buildings: 2 Barracks; 2 Archery Ranges; 4 Stables; 1 Siege Workshop

Tughluqabad Fort governors priority: Bhakkar (tier 3) followed by Uch (tier 1). Then pick based on the situation: Ajmer if under inmediate threat or to help secure an exposed Gold vein. Sehwan if you manage to grab some Relic. Jalor for a stronger cavalry army. Preferably leave it for later. Multan if you don't need/want the others. A bit unnecessary.

Hisar Academy: Can generate up to 300 Food and 300 Gold per minute, which is incredibly useful for the ideal Tuglhaq Dynasty army that requires a lot of Gold. Palace of the Sultan: The only tier 4 governor effects that are worth are Bhakkar for more resources and Jalor for a bit of extra health on cavalry or Sehwan for more healing on Healer Elephant. Since we have already built and upgraded Bhakkar, we can discard that option. Jalor only grants 15 more health compared to the tier 3 effect, so it's not really worth it, although it can be useful for a timing attack right after aging up; since we are skipping the several minutes it takes to build and upgrade the Tughluqabad Fort (and the Stone cost). Sehwan is ok, but nothing too crazy, and adding Healer Elephant is very expensive for the stats they provide. It's good to have a few of them, but investing an entire landmark to buff them is not optimal.
Army composition: War Elephant + Ballista Elephant + Raider Elephant + Healer Elephant. Add a few Man-at-Arms to tank Spearman
Prioritize: Raider Elephant ( Imperial Age ),then Biology,then Armored Beasts,then Reinforced Arm Ballista,then

title: FFA Abbasid , by a noob 4 noobs
description: just boom quick enough and pray for the best.
author: Azur
steps: Berries 4 on Berries. House 1 to build House, then Berries Berries. House of Wisdom 1 build Landmark, then Berries Berries.
Mining Camp 2 on Gold. Scout make sure to scout as much as you can. Especially your neighbours and the center.
Berries 4 on Berries.

Straggler Tree 2 on Wood. Feudal Age Age up in ECO in House of Wisdom House of Wisdom,then Economic Wing. NOTE: Make sure you don't have unneccessary villagers Q'd up, preventing you from ageing up around this time.

The Moment you aged up: First, research in your Landmark House of Wisdom,then Economic Wing your unique Tech Fertile Crescent. (Which you Received by aging up.). Second, research in your Mill Mill your "Villager discount". Fresh Foodstuffs

Don't forget to always keep at least 1 villager Q'd up in you TC, during your age up. NOW: Adjust your Eco as soon as you click up. Take 8x Food from Berries Berries,then Wood wood to Straggler Tree around your TC. Rally next 2 vils on Berries Berries.

Take 5 vil's on straggler trees. Build a Mining Camp mining camp on stone Stone, as soon you have the wood. NOTE: You need to wait until you can effort it. Collect stone Stone, until you have 460. (Enough for 2 TC's in Feudal, with your unique Tech in House of Wisdom)
Keep Rallying Rally X Villagers on Wood Wood, until you can effort your first and second TC. Build a lumber camp Lumber Camp with one willager from the straggler trees, already collecting wood.

Adjust: Use 5 Villagers from Wood Wood to place you first TC Town Center on a ressource you want to secure. Use 5 Villagers from Stone Stone to place your second TC Town Center. Switch Rally point Rally from Home TC to food Food.

At this point you are wide open and slightly vulnerable, but don't worry to much if you lose something, since most people are on one TC. You are on 3 TC's easily effording production on all of them. NOTE if you are being attacked: Wood is really important for you defending possible attacks and repairing your buildings, building towers or building a single barracks nearby, secondly food to keep your villager production running and producing spearman. Make sure you always kept scouting your opponents. or you have at least vision towards them (Tower or 1 scout). Therefore you can react to possible attacks. Get an equal amount of Villager numbers on Food, Wood and Gold. In general effort at least one Barracks to defend yourself, until Castle. Produce some Spearman to defend yourself 6x Spearmen, until you reach castle. Get melee upgrades in Forge Blacksmith and Barracks Barracks. - Otherwise your units are low quality paper

- Freestyle from here. - Never stop producing VIllagers. - Build Order kind of ends here. Make sure your TC never stops producing villagers until you reach around 120 pop. At the beginning you can even overproduce to 135 Villagers, since you try to push your military numbers faster and they probably gonna die anyways during the game. - If not make sure you gonna kill them later. Otherwise you will lose fights, because you dont have higher army numbers. Which can even cost you the game. Meanwhile,... ... Start to build more Millitary buildings Barracks Stable Siege Workshop to prepare an attack. Get your millitary numbers up at all times from now on. In case you feel like you have to many vills on wood, then you probably don't have enough millitary buildings or secured vision by towers on desired ressources. Note: you infantry can build siege. Your Main unit compostion should look something like this Battering Ram, Mangonel, Spearman, Ghulam, Camel Rider. ( Springald against enemy Siege, Counterweight Trebuchet against castles, Horseman Horseman against archery or siege.). If you didn't received any attack until this point and never stopped producing villagers, you should be much superior in Eco, that you can easily effort a fight. !!! Get information what is happening on the map with a few Scouts. Scout!!! Start to build a few pallisades Palisade Wall and towers Outpost for vision on ressources you aim for. The earlier you move out for an attack the more gold is gonna be in your enemys base to secure for yourself. NOTE: Without gold you probably loose. Be aggressive from now on. Stone can be sold for gold in the market, if you run out of gold only do it if want to keep up your momentum. But it will be cheaper for other players to purchase, which can result in more castles on the map. Rather use your stone to secure important areas with castles. Especially gold. don't waste it to much on stonewalls. Rather protect your base with towers. and in FFA, every time you kill your enemy King, you get +50 towards your popluation cap. so don't forget to build houses. You want to kill 'em all. since your boom'd you might have the eco to invest those +50 pop cap straight in more military and go for the next kill.

I think you can choose between millitary wing Military Wing or culture wing Culture Wing. Since you have a lot of open upgrades at this point, i think culture Wing might boost you, getting everything in castle much easier and therefore faster Preservation of Knowledge. Your advancing to Imperial age becomes cheaper too.
Max your Army first, than go imperial.

Again: Effort more than just a single forge Blacksmith, otherwise your techs will take so much time and your army is going to be paper. Get all your melee millitary upgrades first and then your eco upgrades. You want to FIGHT now. Get Information on the map, Map control and Fight. Scout Outpost. Age up as soon as you can to Imperial.
keep getting Information on the map, Map control and Fight. Scout Outpost

Important Note: In Imperial Age Imperial Age and in your House of Wisdom House of Wisdom. Make sure you get get the unique Tech for your infantry of your Military Wing Military Wing,then Camel Support. As well as all the other Melee upgrades in Military Wing,then Boot Camp and. in Madrasa,then Elite Army Tactics.

title: Malian | Trade Farimba - Team Games
description: Trade build for team games. Play defensive at the beginning like usual and make cows. Start producing traders only when it's safe to do so (you have a big enough standing army and/or good walls). This build order works well in closed maps where you can take a bit more time to ramp up your trade eco and catch enemies off-guard by making more than 30 units in 3 minutes (yep, Farimba is that insane).
author: Jockxtar
steps: Warrior Scout neutral Market to know where to build the landmark. Save 5 villagers in one control group and 3 in another.
5 Villagers,then Straggler Tree,then Sheep. 1 Villager,then Pit Mine,then 2 Houses,then 2 Houses,then 2 Houses,then Sheep. Rally,then Sheep (13)
Rally,then Straggler Tree (14)

5 Villagers,then Saharan Trade Network,then Wood. The ideal position for Saharan Trade Network is the closest point to your base that's in the future trade route. 3 Villagers,then Straggler Tree. This build plays around trade for the extra gold economy. This landmark provides protection and extra value to the Venetian Trader.
1 Sheep Villager,then Build Mill on Deer / Berries
Build Lumber Camp
If you built Mill near Deer: research Survival Techniques
Ideal army: Donso + Javelin Thrower to defend
Research Double Broadax ASAP
Build Barracks to produce Donso. You will need at least 4 Donsos to protect yourself from early raids. Next Villager,then 1 House,then Mining Camp on Pit Mine. Rally,then Gold (8)
1 Villager,then 2nd Pit Mine with full House and Mining Camp around it (keep them mining Gold there)
Research Wheelbarrow
Rally,then Food (12)

Build Archery Range to produce Javelin Thrower. 6 Donsos and 6 Javelin Throwers should be enough to defend yourself from early harassment. If you scout an opponent is going to all-in you, make more units that properly counter their army and ask for help until you have numbers advantage.
Produce Cattle from Mill as you get the Gold. Slowly add Cattle Ranch as you produce Cattle
Rally,then Wood (20)

Build 2 Markets and start making Venetian Trader only after securing your base with units and/or Palisade Wall. Remember to build Toll Outpost in the trade route to defend and boost your trade, but make sure their influence areas don't overlap or you won't gain the bonus Gold and Food!!
Research Horticulture after you run out of Deer and move to Berries. Stop producing Cattle and Venetian Trader when you feel ready to Castle Age

Scout your opponents and choose a target to all-in. Prioritize enemies that are playing very greedy or that still need more time to start producing units like China English Holy Roman Empire Japanese Ottomans Rus. If there is none (or they already have big army), attack a player that has been fighting against your allies and has lost troops.
10 Food,then Build Farimba Garrison,then Gold. Rally,then Food (16) {If you run out of Berries and Deer, build Farm }
Build 2nd Barracks, 2nd Archery Range and 3 Stables
Gather Stone for Stone Wall.
Ideal army: Archer + Sofa + Mangonel. Add Donso vs cavalry. Add Musofadi Warrior vs Man-at-Arms and its variants

Produce units from Farimba Garrison constantly. First 30 Archers; then 20 Donsos and/or Musofadi Warrior depending on how the opponent decides to counter your Archer, although Donso are always nice to have around in case any enemy decides to flank your army with cavalry. If they make mass ranged units, you can make one or two Mangonel to break them. Still, with good micro, the poison arrows and the high production speed should be enough to win you the fight.

Produce Warrior Scout from stables and slowly transition into Sofa as you get more Venetian Trader. These units will work as a meat shield for your infantry and maybe even force the opponent into making Spearman

Don't forget to research all economic upgrades and build more Barracks, Archery Range and Stable (5 of each is ok for now but as you get more Venetian Trader you will need more). Don't produce Archer from Archery Range at first, spend the Wood on buildings.

Choose an opponent and all-in them. If you are not able to finish them off completely, ask an ally to send a few troops to aid you. You should win any 1v1 and 2v2 if you produce the right units and keep your Archer mass high enough. Build Battering Ram to destroy buildings for more permanent damage. Prioritize additional Town Center then Barracks, Archery Range and Stable
If the all-in fails, Stone Wall your base and start raiding with Sofa. Send the rest of your army to support your allies wherever they go. If you get attacked, ask your allies for help.

Fort of the Huntress is a good choice if your team has control of a key area in the map. Rally your reinforcements wherever you build it so that they will be safe until you decide to make them join the rest of the army or go to a different location to defend. It's also ok if you desperately need a keep in your base to defend from an inminent attack, but remember that it has the stats of a regular Keep.

Griot Bara has two unique active abilities that can help a lot at replenishing lost army and a third one that's very powerful to finish off opponents by giving your units additional siege damage. If your team doesn't have map control or things between both teams are even, this landmark will be more useful.
Ideal army: Musofadi Gunner + Sofa + Mangonel + Culverin. Add Donso vs cavalry
See to the left. Eco should look like this. Stop at 40 Venetian Traders
10 Barracks, 10 Archery Ranges, 10 Stables and 4 Siege Workshops
For Madrasa upgrades, prioritize this order: Biology,then Chemistry,then Court Architects,then Siege Works,then Elite Army Tactics
Your role at this stage of the game will be to defend your team's side of the map and support your allies in combat. Don't forget to raid the enemies' economy and wall areas with important resources.

title: Onna-Musha FC Mixup
description: FC mixup that focuses on base raiding and anti armor. This is a typical Japanese FC but leads with an archery range instead of a stable. The idea is 3-5 early Onna-Musha will shut down french knights/JD, HRE, or english MAA/king, and can raid and one shot villagers. You will compliment them with horsemen. The cav army is fully buffed by the Uma Bannerman, the horseman can help take down wood walls, and spearmen will get kited by the Onna-Musha. If you end up over your head, a transition to mounted samurai and archers is instant. You could also build 3-5 barraks and have enough production for the rest of the game.
author: snowypeet
steps: Gather berries first so you can move to sheep when you start to get harrased.
Start with all 5 villagers on berries, with a house and instant Tawara.
Que the next 3 on sheep
3 to gold after Towara is done
One more to sheep
The next 3 to a solo tree by TC.

The tower is technically optional, but you should plan to always need it. You could do all of this with 2 on the solo tree instead of 3, but that delays when you could make a tower and you wont know if its necessary until its too late. This tower can be upgraded to aarow slits or stone tower ASAP, but will delay a bannerman.
With 3 sheep vils begin age up with KS, ideally next to wood to avoid having to build a lumber camp.
The next two vils to gold, get a second house too. Rally to sheep. When you have 100 wood, get a tower on your gold.

A quick note on the house locations. The first should always go next to berries. The second one can, and the third one should be kept safe under TC. They can all be used to drop off from farms and need to be kept safe because you WILL need the wood right away. I prefer using them two farm spaces away from the TC, but right next to the TC is ok too.
Age up finishes, move a sheep vil to the free farm if it is near and under TC. Takezaiku now is optional, but recommended.
3 vils on solo tree to woodline, use Kura Storehouse for dropoff if you can. A third house should be built, location is not important.
At 150 wood, start building an archery range. At almost 1200 food move a few vils to the woodline too.

While all of this is going on you may begin to get pressuered, hold out and focus on getting enough gold to age up. This is the weakest point and you NEED that gold. Remember you have an archery range and can feel free to produce from it once you have the food to age up.
Begin age up with Floating Gate right next to the TC. We are still rallying onto sheep btw.
Build a stable when you have the wood and make sure you have been using the free farms from Kura Storehouse.

Produce Onna-Musha and horsemen and pick up the relics. Gold will be the limiting factor now. You should get enough wood/map control to build up your food eco with ease. Start a mining camp on stone with 2-3 vils and get Daimyo and Uma bannerman. Use the Onna-Musha to raid safley, and horseman to raid from one ro two other sides. Onna-Musha should safely be able to pick villagers. Horseman can facetank knights/horseman while Onna's deal high DPS safely. If the raiding starts too feel weak, transition to knights/archers. Ideally the opponent will push for castle and your raids will end the game early, if they only make units instead then they will need spearman/archer to counter, focus on the archers and avoid the spearmen with your high mobility and keep up the raids. any big fight should be in your favor still as long as you kite the spearment before going in. Very few civs get unique spearmen or archers so this can work against many civs.

Put the first Yorishiro into the archery range and start spamming Onna-Musha. this should push back any knights/MAA coming your way. I promise you will run down JD laughing. The second Yorishiro can go into stable, or you can build two more stables and put it into TC instead.

steps: Starting Villager build Mill at Berries and House, attempting to connect the Mill. Micro Sheep onto Town Center. Send Scout. Build Villager

In Feudal Age your goal is to simply amass as much Food and Gold as possible as quickly as possible. You will have to move onto Sheep once the Berries run out. Aim for Villager count similar to posted. Prioritize getting to a few on Wood, then getting Gold close to 10, getting Food to 10, Gold to 10, Wood to 5. Advanced to Castle Age most likely using Culture Wing Advancement (Bonus Culture Wing) because it is cheaper and faster. Start upping your Wood Villager count towards 10. Start building 2 Stables for Camel Lancer

title: Knights Templar | Feudal all-in
description: Basic opening for a strong Feudal Age all-in with chevalier confrere and archers. Very similar to a French all-in, but with a stronger economy and more reliance on archers rather than knights. My other Knights Templar build orders: - 2TC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/4eHSzSzuResmbfKsdVCV - Dark Age tower rush: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/txlg20KyI99bVIoPSWXs
author: Jockxtar
steps: Queue the Straggler Tree Villager to move to Sheep and Gold after chopping their respective tree.
6 Villagers on Sheep. Rally,then House,then Mining Camp,then Gold (2)
Rally,then Sheep (7)

Rally,then Straggler Tree (8). 2 to closest Straggler Tree to Sheep; they will go gather Sheep after they fully chop it. 2 to closest Straggler Tree to Gold; they will go gather Gold after they fully chop it. The rest to main Wood
Move 3 Sheep Villager,then Wood
For the purpose of this build order, it is assumed that you pick Kingdom of France. If you pick any of the other options, adapt your economy accordingly to produce whatever unique unit you unlock.
Feudal Age

Kingdom of France: The best option for this strategy. Heavy cavalry in Feudal Age are super strong and the bonus unit production speed allows you to outproduce most civilizations in the game. Additionally, you will force the enemy to make Spearman, which you will counter with Archer. Chevalier Confrere are discounted feudal knights, decent for early raids and harassing opponents, but they are worse in direct combats. Still, once you group a large amount they can overwhelm enemy archers. Knights Hospitaller: vs Abbasid Dynasty or Ayyubids (they can very easily counter cavalry). Hospitaller Knight are decently tanky in Feudal Age and, with good micro, you can save units from dying during the early game, even while diving the enemy static defenses. They don't scale very well into Castle Age, but they become considerably tanky in Imperial Age. Principality of Antioch: Is better for tempo/scaling strategies. Still, they are the best option vs French and Jeanne d'Arc, since they have Royal Knight which destroy Chevalier Confrere and Hospitaller Knight. Serjeant are a great unit to mass in Feudal Age, but way too expensive and are soft-countered by Archer and static defenses. This makes all-ins with this unit very difficult.
TL;DR: Kingdom of France on Knights Hospitaller on Principality of Antioch
The Straggler Tree Villager should be close to finishing chopping their respective tree and then moving 2 to Sheep and 2 to Gold. Pay attention so that they don't go chop more trees.

Town Center,then Safe Passage. Rally,then Wood (16). Having 4 Villagers on Gold will secure enough income to produce Chevalier Confrere without relying on pilgrims, which can be denied easily by our opponent.

1 Wood Villager,then Build Stable. Produce Chevalier Confrere until you have 5 and use them to raid. Make sure they take as little damage as possible, forcing idle time is good enough and we need a large amount of them for the all-in.

1 Gold Villager,then Build Blacksmith,then Build House. Order of upgrades: Iron Undermesh,then Steeled Arrow,then Siege Engineering. You can research Bloomery first for Villager kill breakpoint on Chevalier Confrere (charge + 3 normal attacks instead of 4), but this will delay your all-in timing. Do it only if you are confident on your micro or if you want to punish enemy Villager on Deer. One pilgrim generates 130 Gold per minute, which coincides perfectly with Blacksmith upgrades.
Build Villager,then Build 2nd House
1 Wood Villager,then Build Archery Range. Produce Archer nonstop. If you ever lack Food to produce units, prioritize Archer
Build Villager,then Build second Archery Range or Barracks
If you build Barracks, move 4 Gold Villager,then Food; otherwise move only 2. Either way, pause Chevalier Confrere production until you have enough Food
Rally,then Food (14). Now should be a good time to resume Chevalier Confrere production.
Move Food Villager to Deer or Boar if you have map control. This will spike your unit production significantly, therefore you should build more military buildings to spend the resources.

Once you have over 10 Archers, if you lack Food but have too much Wood, make Battering Ram. Otherwise research Sanctuary put 1 or 2 Wood Villager on Farm. 2 Battering Rams is enough to destroy secondary Town Center, but don't move for the main Town Center until you have at least 4.
If you float too much Gold, you can build Market to buy other resources or another Stable for more Chevalier Confrere.
If the game is not finished after a while and you want to change your strategy, age up to Castle Age to upgrade your army and deal the final blow.

Angevin Empire: Heavy Spearman are amazing against Feudal Age armies that rely on cavalry. Going for these will allow you to close up the game in early Castle Age against civilizations like French, Jeanne d'Arc and Rus, since their Archer will become useless and they will have no way to protect their Knight. Republic of Genoa: Genoese Crossbowman are very strong against pretty much any unit, but are specially strong against melee infantry (most noticeably, Spearman ). Their biggest counter are Horseman and Archer, but both can be dealt with our Feudal Age unique unit ( Chevalier Confrere, Hospitaller Knight or Serjeant ). Kingdom of Castile: Genitour are ultra specific counter units. Good choice against Ayyubids Abbasid Dynasty Rus Mongols if they are doing mounted cavalry units, but since we have been playing aggressive all this time, we should not wait to see what our opponent does after aging up, we want to have the upper hand by going Castle Age first.
TL;DR: Angevin Empire on Republic of Genoa

title: English Drush Into Heavy Feudal
description: This build order turns up the tempo knob of English and brings instant pressure.1 maa into feudal spear longbow with upgrades. Aim to have about 35 military units at min 10. Practice build order again if you are not reaching at least 30 military units. Macro is extremely important and the only way this build works is if you don't slow yourself down by adding farms and instead use your military advantage to push the game.
author: Moonstrife
steps: 2 Villagers build Barracks; 1 Villager goes to build House and back to Food. The other Villager goes to Straggler Tree. When Barracks completes, instantly queue 1 Man-at-Arms. Rally Sheep until 7 Food Villager.
Rally Wood until 2 on Straggler Tree.
Rally 1 Villager to Gold. When 50 Wood take the 2 Straggler Tree Villager to Gold too.
Rally Food
When 10 Food Villager you Rally Straggler Tree
Take 4 Food Villager and build Council Hall
Macro 6 Food / 3 Gold / rest to Straggler Tree,then Wood
House
Pull Gold Villager to Wood and 1 Villager to build Mill on Berries
Instantly queue Spearman Longbowman and keep spamming.
Wheelbarrow
House

POST BUILD ORDER: Aim to have about 35 military units at min 10. Practice build order again if you are not reaching at least 30 military units. Macro is extremely important. Around min 8-10 is when you add 3 on gold again to get more upgrades. Depending on how many sheep you gathered, you can move more Villager to Berries. Try not to add farms before min 8-9ish so you can build a military lead/tempo/pressure. macro wise, you will be rallying primarily on wood and add farms with wood vills continously until you have 3 full farm setups. When you have 3 is when you can go castle (you dont have to if you can finish the game in feudal). When you go castle, you go for King's Palace ALWAYS. If you go white tower, you've probably already lost the game. Remember to macro heavy on Gold for upgrades in castle. You are going castle for a timing:). This build will NOT work vs and you will have to use other strategies: Rus Malians English

title: Agro into mounted samurai
description: Good in every matchup except english/house of lancaster (villagers with bow), Rus (don't need gold but can maybe burn hunting cabins) and mongols (can outproduce spearmen)
author: Piepet
steps: They idea is to harass ennemy's gold while going into a FC. Do not lose spearmen and bring them back when can't harass anymore to defend Gold and Berries.
Build Barracks + Farmhouse. Try not to block Kura Storehouse by Build near Straggler Tree. Scout goes straight to ennemy base.
Produce 2 Spearmen to harass ennemy gold without overcomitting
When finished Build Farmhouse, do Tawara.
Send 4 Sheep Villager to Gold
Send Wood Villager to Sheep. Send 1 Sheep Villager to build Farmhouse near Berries
Send 9 Sheep Villager to Berries. The goal is to be greedy and save Sheep for safe later food source.
When ennemy gets dangerous, send Berries Villager back to Sheep (around 6:15). If ennemy is really dangerous, go Feudal Age with 2 Villagers to get Arrowslits faster
Build Kura Storehouse with only 1 Villager, send Sheep Villager to Wood and Rally on Wood
When 3 Villagers on Wood, Rally on Sheep and shift click Wood Villager on Sheep (they just need to cut 1 tree to then Build Outpost on Gold )
1 Gold Villager Build Outpost and next Villager goes on Gold.

Instantly Arrowslits the Gold Outpost. Scout ennemy and if danger is high then Fortify Outpost. If not, save Stone to get Daimyo Manor later. Send the Feudal Age Villager to use first Kura Storehouse Farm but pay attention to ennemy raids.
Build Floating Gate witth 7 Food Villager and start collecting Wood next to Kura Storehouse to Build Stable.

The idea now is to use the Kura Storehouse Farm whenever possible, constantly produce Villager + Mounted Samurai to get map pressure and expand. Split Villager to Build Outpost on outside Food sources. Harass with Mounted Samurai and maybe dive with Fitted Leatherwork (and Insulated Helm if possible). Get Daimyo Manor before putting Arrowslits. Put second Place Yorishiro on Town Center and third on Archery Range. If against full knights comp, can get 10/15 Mounted Samurai and then go full Onna-Bugeisha (with veteran upgrade).

The 7 Castle Age Villager go Build the Stable. Try to get a 2:1 ration on Food / Gold to constantly produce Villager + Mounted Samurai. First Shinto Priest place Place Yorishiro in the Stable and then go grab Relic. If can easily grab Relic, put 3 more Villager on Wood to Build Shinto Shrine.

GENEL BİLGİ. -Sürekli olarak Sipahi üretmek istiyoruz. Osmanlının erken oyunda en güçlü yönü Sipahi üretebilmesidir. Oyunun en güçlü hafif atlısıdır. -Eğer Feodal Çağ'da kalıp rakibi yenmeyi düşünüyorsak Sipahi + Archer şeklinde ordu kurmamız gerekiyor. French ve Jeanne d'Arc, Royal Knight üretebildiği için bu ikisine karşı oynarken Feodal Çağ'da Sipahi + Spearman şeklinde ordu daha etkili olacaktır. Rus, Knight üretiyorsa eğer Spearman basılmalıdır. -Kaynaklar yettiği zaman sırasıyla Double Broadax + Horticulture + Wheelbarrow ekonomi geliştirmesi almak istiyoruz. -Askeri teknoloji olarak sırasıyla Steeled Arrow + Iron Undermesh + Siege Engineering araştırmamız gerekiyor. Archer üretmiyorsak eğer Iron Undermesh + Siege Engineering şeklinde araştırma yapıyoruz. -Askeri üstünlüğü ele geçirdiğimiz zaman rakibin kaynaklarını engellemeye çalışmalıyız. Gold veya Wood kaynakları Town Center korumasında uzakta kaldığı için bunlara odaklanmalıyız. Eğer rakibin Town Center korumasında Sheep kalmadıysa önceliğimiz Food kaynaklarını engellemek olmalı. - Siege Engineering araştırmasıyla Battering Ram üretip rakibin Gold 'da Outpost varsa ona yoksa House ve Archery Range, Stable, Barracks gibi askeri üretim binalarını hedef alabiliriz. - Blacksmith etkisinde bulunan yapılar çağlara göre %20, %30 ve %40 daha hızlı üretim yapar. Imperial Age 'a Istanbul Observatory ile çıkıldıysa bu etki %100 olur. Bu hızlı üretim etkisi. Military School ve Mehmed Imperial Armory yapılarını da etkiler. Daha hızlı şekilde daha fazla ücretsiz birim üretmemizi sağlar. -Oyun sonu ordumuz Sipahi + Janissary + Great Bombard şeklinde olmalıdır. ASKERİ OKUL. - Dark Age 'da sadece Spearman üretebiliyor. - Feudal Age 'da Sipahi veya Archer ürettiriyoruz. Sipahi, Food ağırlıklı olduğu için Food korumamızı sağlıyor ama üretmesi çok uzun sürmesi dezavantaj oluyor. Wood az bulunan haritalarda Archer tercih ediyoruz. - Castle Age 'da rakip Feodal Çağdaysa veya Spearman ağırlıklı orduya sahipse Man-at-Arms iyi tercih. Zırhlı birimler getiriyorsa Crossbowman iyi tercih. Advanced Academy puanını aldıktan sonra Janissary iyi tercih. Lancer çok yavaş çıktığı için tercih etmiyorum ama üretilebilir. - Imperial Age 'da Janissary hem atlı birimlere ekstra vurması hem de genel hasarı yüksek olması sebebiyle en iyi seçenek. - Mehter saniye/kaynak olarak diğerlerinden daha verimlidir. Oyun sonu 1 Military School, Mehter üretiminde bırakılabilir. TOPHANE-İ AMİRE. - Castle Age 'da rakip ordusu ağırlıklı olarak yakın dövüşçü yayalardan oluşuyorsa ( Spearman, Man-at-Arms vb.) Springald üretmeliyiz. Herhangi menzilli birim ağırlıklıysa Mangonel üretmeliyiz. - Imperial Age 'da Great Bombard üreteceğiz. VEZİR PUANLARI. -Puanları öğrenene kadar, Anatolian Hills ⮞ Military Campus ⮞ Advanced Academy ⮞ Janissary Company ⮞şeklinde alabilirsiniz. - Field Work Yoğun Feodal Çağ çatışması yaşanıyorsa, 2 Imams çıkarılıp toplu iyileştirme kullanarak savaşlardan galip çıkabiliriz. Veya Kale Çağına çıktığımızda hızlı bir şekilde Relic toplamak için de kullanılabilir. - Anatolian Hills Çatışmanın yoğun olmadığı veya Food kaynaklarının yetersiz, korunaksız olduğu durumlarda tercih edilebilir. - Mehter Drums Mehterlere, askerleri hızlandırma özelliği verdiği için Horse Archer, Mangudai, Camel Archer gibi birimleri yakalamak için kullanılabilir. - Military Campus ve Advanced Academy Askeri okulları güçlendirdiği için her oyun almayı istiyoruz. - Siege Crews Kuşatma ağırlıklı oynadığımız maçlarda, kuşatma makinelerini güçlendirdiği için iyi bir tercihdir. - Janissary Company ve Anlık asker üretip kendimizi savunmak veya oyunu bitirmek için kullanılabilir. - Trade Bags Ticaret yaptığımız maçlarda %40 altın gelirini arttırdığı için alınması şarttır. - Pax Ottomana 2 Şehir Merkezi kurduysak ve anlık Villager sayısını yükseltmek istiyorsak alınabilir. - Extensive Fortifications Rakip Kale Çağına geçtiyse ve zırhlı birimler getiriyorsa kendimi savunmak için alınabilir. Veya takım oyunlarında ticaret kuruluysa ve Sea Gate Castle ile İmparatorluk Çağına geçtiysek ticaret yollarına daha ucuza ve daha güçlü Keep 'ler kurmak için alınabilir.
Feudal Age geçtik. Twin Minaret Medrese 'de 3 Villagers ile Berries topla. Sheep 'da çalışan 3 Villagers 'yi Wood 'a yolla.
Sheep 'da çalışan 1 Villager ile Military School kur.
Çağ atladığımızda Military School 'ların üretimini Sipahi veya Archer değiştirmemiz gerekiyor.
10 Villagers ile Town Center kur. Town Center kurarken öncelikle Deer veya Gold güvenceye almalıyız.
Town Center 'den sonra Blacksmith kuracağız.

Açılış burada bitiyor. Bu açılışın amacı 2 Şehir Merkezi kurarken askeri okulları kurup kendimizi koruyacak kadar askere sahip olmak ve kaynaklarımızı bitirmeden ücretsiz şekilde asker üretebilmek. Bu andan itibaren rakibin ne yaptığına göre oynamamız gerekiyor. Eğer ordu üretip bizi öldürmeye çalışıyorsa ordu üretmeye başlamalı ve kendimizi savunmalıyız. Eğer agresif oynamıyorsa Kale Çağına geçmeye çalışmalıyız.

Start Building Aachen Chapel near with 2 Villagers that were on Sheep. Make it near berries and trees. Keep sending newly Spawned Villager to Sheep near home base.

Villager to Sheep

Send one more Villager to Gold. Then set Villager Rally to Food near Aachen Chapel. Make House with a gold villager
Villagers keep going to food. Start looking for place to build Regnitz Cathedral
Villagers keep going to food near Aachen Chapel. Get ready to age up.

Start building Regnitz Cathedral with 15 food villagers around time 6:10. Age up should complete by 6:45. (I've done at 6:30 also). Set Rally and return for first Monk from Regnitz Cathedral to get first Relic. Newly spawned villagers go to wood near Aachen Chapel. After age up, only 7 out of 15 go back to food. Other 8 start collecting wood. Move 2 (out of 5) gold villagers to wood as well. We will be chopping wood big time now!

<b on. Shift the economy:</b on Stop mining distant gold and move villagers into food and wood. Add farms so production stays constant and safer from raids. <b on Secure vision:</b on Place two outposts for warning and map awareness, not damage. Add short sections of Palisade Wall to protect so your advantage continue to build. <b on Prepare production:</b on Add 2–3 military buildings, but do not mass units yet. They exist to reinforce defense, not start a push. <b on Create a defensive army: </b on Train a small force, mostly Gilded Spearman only to defend. Avoid attacking the enemy base. <b on Research upgrades in this order:</b on Get Wheelbarrow, Horticulture, Double Broadax, Specialized Pick. Do not engage prematurely. Your ideal engagement time is after 13:00, specially if you have 5 relics.
Start creating second Monk from Regnitz Cathedral
Change Rally for Regnitz Cathedral to and from second Relic and create second Monk. Make first Barracks towards front.

author: Jockxtar
steps: While aging up, scout what the opponent is doing with Khan. To micro the Straggler Tree Villager, click on a tree, then shift+click on the Ger and then shift+click on a Sheep, otherwise they might not drop the full 150 Wood (it's bugged)
1 Villager,then Ovoo,then Sheep. 5 Villagers,then 1 Straggler Tree (unpack Ger close to them),then Sheep. Town Center unpack near Wood. If possible, also near Gold

Rally,then Gold (4)
Rally,then Wood (15)

Deer Stones,then Unlocking Khan’s Hunter production is immensely valuable and, on top of that, it also boosts our economy by increasing the movement speed of our Villager. The Silver Tree,then We are already booming our economy with more Villager so we don't need to start trading early.
After gathering 150 more Gold (gold vein at 3750): Move Gold Villager,then Wood. Move Ger inside Ovoo area and research Wheelbarrow (improved)
Army composition: Spearman + Horseman
2 Build Villager,then Sheep. Rally,then Sheep (15)
12 Wood Villager,then Build Town Center right next to them. Move Ger back to Gold

5 Build Villager,then Build Outpost on Gold. 7 Build Villager,then Wood. Both Town Center Rally,then Sheep (19). If there are enemy units outside of your base, don't move to Gold until it's safe. Move them to Sheep until you have enough units to push the opponent away.

Build Barracks with 1 Wood Villager and move it inside Ovoo area of influence. OR --- vs Mongols ( Mangudai ) English ( Longbowman ) Byzantines ( Longbowman )---. Build Stable with 1 Wood Villager and move it inside Ovoo area of influence
Research Superior Mobility at the Ovoo once you have Gold for it
After Superior Mobility is finished, move 2nd Town Center to Deer
Main Town Center Rally,then Gold (15). 2nd Town Center Rally,then Deer (8)
Make enough units to defend. With the Stone double production and strong Food economy from double Town Center, Deer and early Pasture, you won't have any Food problems.
If you are not being pressured, don't make units and move 5 Sheep Villager to Gold for a faster Castle Age timing.
Both Town Center Rally,then Wood (25). See to the left. Remacro to this (8 on Deer, 17 on Sheep ) and get ready to Castle Age
Build Ger and put it on Ovoo to research improved versions of economic upgrades. Prioritize Forestry,then Double Broadax,then Horticulture,then Specialized Pick,then Wheelbarrow
Gradually build Pasture with 1 Sheep Villager and move them inside Ovoo area of influence. 1 Pasture per 3 Villagers gathering. If you run out of Sheep, move the Villager to Berries temporarily.
Also build Outpost near Wood and Sheep to protect your Villager against raids.
10 Gold Villager Build Steppe Redoubt
Build 2 Archery Ranges vs Knight / Man-at-Arms armies; or 1 Archery Range and 1 Stable vs ranged armies
Army composition: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Crossbowman + Horseman + Khan’s Hunter

Keep adding Pasture until you have 16 with a 4x5 space in the center to fit The White Stupa. That's enough to sustain 40 Villagers with all Horticulture upgrades (the improved one too). If Castle Age goes on for too long, build a Prayer Tent in that gap and research Monastic Shrines.
Research: Ovoo: Whistling Arrows and, if you are going to push enemy base, Raid Bounty. Ger: Fertilization, Shaft Mining and Lumber Preservation. Don't forget about relevant Blacksmith upgrades.
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production balance: 5 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 5 Stables

*Team games tip: When saving up to reach Imperial Age, move your buildings into your allies’ base and place the landmark in the safest spot. You’re already pausing production to save resources, so this won’t slow you down (much), and your Food Villager should have enough Sheep to get to 2400.

The White Stupa: Allows getting the improved versions of upgrades and Cannon Emplacement on your Outpost sooner. Khaganate Palace: Since you already have a strong economy by this point, you will be at max population most of the time, therefore this landmark won't have much value.
Build 2nd Blacksmith inside Ovoo or The White Stupa area of influence

Now it's the time to think about what late-game army composition you want to streamline which Imperial Age upgrades you will get: - Infantry: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Handcannon Ashigaru + Khan’s Hunter + Mangonel + Bombard. - Cavalry: Horseman / Keshik + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter
Army composition: - Infantry: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Handcannon Ashigaru + Khan’s Hunter + Mangonel + Bombard. - Cavalry: Horseman / Keshik + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter
Research elite upgrades for your units as soon as you age up.

Blacksmith upgrades depending on army composition: - Infantry: Elite Army Tactics (regular),then Serpentine Powder,then Siege Works,then Chemistry. Also research on Siege Workshop: Adjustable Crossbars + Greased Axles. - Cavalry: Siha Bow Limbs (improved),then Platecutter Point,then Incendiary Arrows,then Silk Bowstrings,then Biology
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this: If you have Kurultai instead of Steppe Redoubt, substitute Gold Villager for Venetian Trader
Production balance: (Infantry). 10 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 2 Siege Workshops. (Cavalry). 5 Archery Ranges; 10 Stables

Save up Stone for improved versions of: - Infantry: Elite Army Tactics,then Greased Axles,then Siege Works. - Cavalry: Siha Bow Limbs,then Biology,then Steppe Lancers. Remember to eventually research *Pax Mongolica* and Court Architects. Other improved upgrades that are worth getting are: Military Academy, Whistling Arrows, Stone Bounty, Raid Bounty, Textiles, Tithe Barns (if you have Relic ). Also, upgrade your Outpost with Cannon Emplacement (starting by the ones in your base).
Build Outpost around your resources (specially the Sheep ) and on the path between your production buildings and wherever you are fighting the enemies so that reinforcements arrive faster.

Build a lumber camp Lumber Camp and supervise it with your IO Imperial Official. If you're going against an aggressive opponent: 15 vils on food Food, 15 on wood Wood, 6 on gold Gold, rally Rally both TCs to food Food and start producing a defensive army Spearman Zhuge Nu with its upgrades Blacksmith. If opponent ages up, attack them and age up yourself.
If youre going against a passive opponent: Just age up to castle. Assign 6 vils Villager to gold Gold and move all but 6 vils from wood Wood to food Food.
If your opponent wasnt agressive, advance to castle with the Clocktower Astronomical Clocktower, use 8 vils to build it.

At this point start rallying Rally to gold Gold until you have 15 vils Villager on it and research imperial examinations Imperial Examinations because you will need a lot for unit and blacksmith upgrades Blacksmith, monks Monk and units. Create a stronger army Palace Guard Crossbowman with some nest of bees Nest of Bees and secure relics Monastery Relic if you can.

author: Flirtz
steps: Start: 5 Villagers Stone 1 Villager Sheep Food. Rally TC to food until 9 Villagers Sheep Food. Goal is to get 50 stone mined (=1 run without building mining camp,then enough stone for military school)

Move 5 Villagers Stone to Wood (until 50 wood = with 5 villagers it means 1 run). Move 5 Villagers Wood to Sheep Food. When military school is finished,then 1 Villager from Military School builds House (do not build house where you are going to build military buildings so they are in blacksmith bonus range). 1 Villager from House goes to Sheep Food (so there will be 9 vills on food). Change TC rally point to Gold until 3 Villagers. Our target at this stage is to have 9 food and 3 gold vills
When 9 Villagers Sheep Food and 3 Villagers Gold (until 200 gold). Rally TC to food until age up
When 200 Gold move 3 Villagers Gold to Wood

Age up with Twin Minaret Medrese with 5 Villagers from Sheep Food. - Build Twin Minaret right next to TC but not too close to berries, so workers on Minaret are not in rage of berries. - Do not build it in the place where you will place military buildings. Twin Minaret can support 5 Villagers. When Horticulture researched, reduce it to 4 Villagers, when Fertilization researched, reduce them to 3 Villagers or just keep 4 all the time to make it easier
During age up, move 4 Villagers Sheep Food to Wood and build Lumber Camp. Rally TC to Wood until 8. Chop 2 Straggler Tree next to TC
1 Villager Wood builds House then moves to build Mining Camp at Stone. When 2 trees chopped, move 5 Villagers Wood to Stone

5 Villagers from age up stay on Twin Minaret Medrese (see more above about villagers on Minaret). Switch Military School to Sipahi and harras. Move 4 Villagers from Sheep Food to Wood. Rally TC to Stone until 650 Stone for 2TC. 350 stone is for 2TC and 300 is for military schools
Build 2TC with 8 Villagers on Gold. Rally TC to wood

When 650 Stone move Villager Stone to Wood and Sheep Food. Workers that were building 2TC go to Gold. Rally TC to food. Rally 2TC to gold. Target at this stage is to have 8 on wood, 8 on gold and rest on food with TC rally point to food
1 Villager Wood builds Military School and Blacksmith. Get Wheelbarrow and Double Broadax. Build House. Then get Horticulture and Iron Undermesh

What to do next. - We can age up to Castle (with 8 villagers). or. - Stables and knights. or. - barracks, archer ranges and MAA (we do not want to produce janissaries until enemy has cavalry). or. - if opponent has cavalry we want to age up and get janissaries. or. - get relics
Vizier points. With first Vizier Point we get sheeps, so we can place 2TC on gold because we have safe food. With second Vizier Point we get +1 military schools

Vs some civs. English Do not go military school that soon if you play against English and instead age up quicker. Rus If against Rus - you can kill him some wolfs with spearman to deny bounty. French Jeanne d'Arc Be annoying at their gold with spearman. Abbasid Dynasty Be annoying at gold and stone. Knight civs ( Jeanne d'Arc French Rus ). - When we age up, we make barracks and upgrade spearman to defend

title: Healer Elephants + Archers Rush (5:30 Hit) - Swaggy PRofessor - simplified - copy - same as "healer elephant age 2 fight"

author: Wado321
steps: 6 Villagers to Sheep. Scout scouts one flank; starting worker elephant scouts the opposite flank (they can capture Sheep as drop-off). Immediately queue a 2nd worker elephant (this one scouts near your Gold only).
First new vil → Sheep. Next 3 vils will go to Gold as they pop.
First gold vil builds House under TC coverage (vs spear rush). Worker elephants will bring back sheep they pass; use them to path through herds.
After 3 on gold, Rally to Food until 9 on food.

Age up with Dome of the Faith using 3 Villagers. Now set TC Rally to Wood for the rest of Feudal. If the second worker elephant hasn’t returned yet, send wood vils to stragglers until it does, then to the woodline.
Feudal completes: queue 1 Healer Elephant immediately. Landmark builders place Archery Range, then return to eco. Rally army to an exposed enemy resource (gold / berries).
Begin Archer production nonstop. Every time you place a House, follow a 4x4 grid layout (prep for Fort aura economy later).
First timing: Healer Elephant (~500 HP) + Archers can dive short under towers/TC due to healing. If enemy spams horsemen, add 1–2 Barracks and produce Spearman alongside archers.
Scale to ~4 Healer Elephants total while massing. Spend gold on Blacksmith and key eco upgrades. If short on food: go Berries first, then Deer once you have map control.
Send a large group to collect 425 Stone. Build Tughluqabad Fort centered within your 4x4 Houses grid. Assign the Food Governor to the Fort to generate ~240 Food /min passively.
Shift eco toward Food and Gold to prepare Castle. Keep pressure with Healer Elephants + Archers; deny deer/berries and punish over-extensions.
Age up with House of wisdom. Keep army close to enemy for immediate post-Castle timing.

Instantly research: Wedge Rivets, Balanced Projectiles, Veteran Archers and House of Wisdom Upgrades. If you added Barracks: research the Spearman training/upgrade techs as well. Tughlaq techs complete in ~5s → hit your timing immediately with fully upgraded Castle army.
Push for game-ending fight: Healer Elephants + Veteran Archers (+ Spearmen if needed). Keep adding Farm or House around Fort as wood floats

title: Healer Elephants + Archers Rush (5:30 Hit) - Swaggy PRofessor
description: Feudal power spike with Healer Elephants from Dome of Faith, backed by mass Archers. Transition to Castle for instant upgrades and timing.
author: Swaggy Professor
steps: 6 Villagers to Sheep. Scout scouts one flank; starting worker elephant scouts the opposite flank (they can capture Sheep as drop-off). Immediately queue a 2nd worker elephant (this one scouts near your Gold only).
First new vil → Sheep. Next 3 vils will go to Gold as they pop.
First gold vil builds House under TC coverage (vs spear rush). Worker elephants will bring back sheep they pass; use them to path through herds.
After 3 on gold, Rally to Food until 9 on food.

Age up with Dome of the Faith using 3 Villagers. Now set TC Rally to Wood for the rest of Feudal. If the second worker elephant hasn’t returned yet, send wood vils to stragglers until it does, then to the woodline.
Feudal completes: queue 1 Healer Elephant immediately. Landmark builders place Archery Range, then return to eco. Rally army to an exposed enemy resource (gold / berries).
Begin Archer production nonstop. Every time you place a House, follow a 4x4 grid layout (prep for Fort aura economy later).
First timing: Healer Elephant (~500 HP) + Archers can dive short under towers/TC due to healing. If enemy spams horsemen, add 1–2 Barracks and produce Spearman alongside archers.
Scale to ~4 Healer Elephants total while massing. Spend gold on Blacksmith and key eco upgrades. If short on food: go Berries first, then Deer once you have map control.
Send a large group to collect 425 Stone. Build Tughluqabad Fort centered within your 4x4 Houses grid. Assign the Food Governor to the Fort to generate ~240 Food /min passively.
Shift eco toward Food and Gold to prepare Castle. Keep pressure with Healer Elephants + Archers; deny deer/berries and punish over-extensions.
Age up with House of wisdom. Keep army close to enemy for immediate post-Castle timing.

Instantly research: Wedge Rivets, Balanced Projectiles, Veteran Archers and House of Wisdom Upgrades. If you added Barracks: research the Spearman training/upgrade techs as well. Tughlaq techs complete in ~5s → hit your timing immediately with fully upgraded Castle army.
Push for game-ending fight: Healer Elephants + Veteran Archers (+ Spearmen if needed). Keep adding Farm or House around Fort as wood floats

title: Beasty fast castle RUS - copy
description: Minhas Anotações de Ordem de Construção → = fila = shift + clique para adicionar à fila de trabalho Configuração Inicial de Aldeões e Batedores Coloque aldeões na fila, ponto de encontro para a Cabana de Caça (2). 5 aldeões na MADEIRA. 1 aldeão constrói a Cabana de Caça (1) → Casa → volta para a COMIDA. Envie o Batedor 1 para procurar ovelhas. Primeira Produção de Aldeões O 1º aldeão (que sair) constrói a Cabana de Caça (2) → volta para a COMIDA. Ponto de encontro da TC (Centro da Cidade) para a COMIDA. Quando o 1º aldeão sair, seus 5 aldeões da MADEIRA já terão coletado 50 de MADEIRA e entregue (ou estarão a caminho); envie-os para a COMIDA (DEPOIS de terem coletado os 50 de MADEIRA iniciais). Fila de Batedores Coloque 1 batedor na fila o mais rápido possível da HC (1). Coloque 1 batedor na fila o mais rápido possível da HC (2). (Total: 3 batedores.) Idade de Ouro com Portão Dourado Avance para a Idade com o Portão Dourado usando 4 aldeões. Mantenha 4 na COMIDA. Envie o resto dos aldeões para a árvore isolada que já foi cortada → depois para a linha de MADEIRA. Ponto de encontro da TC para a linha de MADEIRA; faça o 1º aldeão construir um Acampamento Madeireiro. Quando 8 aldeões estiverem na MADEIRA, ponto de encontro da TC para a COMIDA. Construa 1 Casa (com 1 aldeão da COMIDA). Gerenciamento de Batedores e Cervos Depois que os batedores terminarem de explorar o mapa, traga as ovelhas de volta e empurre seus cervos mais próximos para dentro da sua base. Quando os cervos estiverem na base (TC ou perto da HC), traga todos os aldeões da COMIDA para os cervos. (Adicional: explore o inimigo, espalhe os cervos inimigos, queime/assede construções.) Configuração de Bônus de Madeira 3 aldeões da MADEIRA constroem uma Fortaleza de Madeira (para obter 20% mais MADEIRA). Pesquisa Inicial PESQUISE "Técnica de Sobrevivência" (da HC). Avance de Idade com Casa de Comércio Alta Venda MADEIRA por OURO no Portão Dourado para avançar de idade. Avance de Idade com a Casa de Comércio Alta usando 8 aldeões → 2 aldeões voltam para a COMIDA. Ponto de encontro da TC para a MADEIRA. Construa 3 Campos de Arqueiros com 3 aldeões da MADEIRA (1 por campo) → cada um volta para a MADEIRA. Melhorias (Pós-Avanço de Idade) PESQUISE: Machado Largo (melhoria de MADEIRA). PESQUISE: Carrinho de Mão (velocidade de coleta e movimento de aldeões). Divisão de Aldeões 14 na COMIDA (Use-os para construir). 20 na MADEIRA. Etapas Militares e Econômicas (Após o Avanço de Idade) Construa 1 Monastério. Fila: Produza Arqueiros a Cavalo (AC). Pegue RELÍQUIAS com Monge + AC. (Se o oponente estiver na Idade Feudal, pegue as RELÍQUIAS dele; se na Idade do Castelo, garanta as suas primeiro e depois negue as dele com AC.) Mais Melhorias Construa Ferreiro. PESQUISE: +1 Ataque à Distância, +1 Defesa à Distância, Horticultura (velocidade de agricultura). Estratégia Contínua Continue pegando RELÍQUIAS. Produza unidades constantemente. Garanta os LOCAIS SAGRADOS.

title: New Player Guide to OOTD
description: Very basic, no-frills OOTD build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to be aggressive in the Feudal Age with Gilded Horsemen and Archers. This can be played on any land map against any civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games (or you can go pure horsemen!) There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Get siege engineering from the Meinwerk so you can make rams with your archers. If Feudal goes really long, make sure to add another archery range (or even a barracks for Gilded Men-at-arms!) 2. Go Castle Age! Put a couple more villagers to gold, stop making units, and age up with the Burgrave Palace. Once up, upgrade your existing units and overwhelm your opponent with cheap and quickly-produced Gilded MAA (make sure to get+2 ranged armour and Golden Cuirass from the Meinwerk) Once you're feeling comfortable with this build, look for more advanced and optimal build orders. Like HRE, OOTD are very versatile and can be played pretty much every way. Their strongest strategy is arguably 2TC (though I wouldn't recommend that for new players) and their biggest challenge is not running out of food (which this build is designed to help avoid). I recommend checking out a recent build order guide video from a pro player. Two good options are Beastyqt and Valdemar.
