title: Beasty fast castle RUS
description: My build order notes, thought I'd share it → = queue = shift + click to queue work order INITIAL VILLAGER & SCOUT SETUP Queue Villagers, rally to Hunting Cabin (2). 5x villagers on WOOD. 1x villager builds Hunting Cabin (1) → House → back to FOOD. Send Scout 1 for sheep. FIRST VILLAGER PRODUCTION 1st villager (pops out) builds Hunting Cabin (2) → back to FOOD. Rally TC to FOOD. When the 1st villager pops out, your 5 WOOD villagers will have gathered 50 WOOD and dropped (or going to) it off; send them to FOOD (AFTER they got the initial 50 WOOD). SCOUT QUEUEING Queue 1x scout ASAP from HC (1). Queue 1x scout ASAP from HC (2). (Total: 3 scouts.) AGE UP WITH GOLDEN GATE Age up with Golden Gate using 4 villagers. Keep 4 on FOOD Send the rest of the villagers on the straggler tree that has already been chopped down → then to the WOOD line. Rally TC to the WOOD line; have the 1st villager build a Lumber Camp. When 8 villagers are on WOOD, rally TC to FOOD. Build 1x House (with 1x FOOD villager). SCOUT & DEER MANAGEMENT After scouts finish scouting the map, bring back sheep and push your closest deer into your base. When deer is in base (TC or near HC), bring all FOOD villagers to deer. (Additional: scout enemy, spread enemy deer, burn/harass buildings.) WOOD BONUS SETUP 3x WOOD villagers build a Wooden Fortress (to get 20% more WOOD). EARLY RESEARCH RESEARCH "Survival Technique" (from HC). AGE UP WITH HIGH TRADE HOUSE Sell WOOD for GOLD in the Golden Gate to age up. Age up with High Trade House using 8 villagers → 2x villagers back to FOOD. Rally TC to WOOD. Build 3 Archer Ranges with 3x WOOD villagers (1 per range) → each returns to WOOD. UPGRADES (POST-AGE UP) RESEARCH: Broad Axe (WOOD upgrade). RESEARCH: Wheelbarrow (villager gathering and movement speed). VILLAGER SPLIT 14 on FOOD (Use these for building). 20 on WOOD. (AFTER AGE UP) MILITARY & ECONOMIC STEPS Build 1x Monastery. Queue: Produce Horse Archers (HA). Get RELICS with Monk + HA. (If the opponent is Feudal, take his RELICS; if in Castle, secure your own first and then deny his with HA.) FURTHER UPGRADES Build Blacksmith. RESEARCH: +1 Ranged Attack, +1 Range Defense, Horticulture (farming speed). ONGOING STRATEGY Keep getting RELICS. Pump out units. Secure SACRED SITES.

title: BeastyQT Castle Rush with HRE in Season 6 AOE4 - copy
description: A guide to help with HRE castle rushing in Season 6 by BeastyQT
author: Tags
steps: 3 Villagers on food and 3 on gold ASAP. Prelate moved to inspire ALL gold Villager and then immediately back to inspire food. First new Villager will build House then Rally Sheep.
should be able to Feudal Age here. Once you have 8 Villagers on Food, Rally Wood.

Feudal Age Aachen Chapel with 4 Food Villager and rally them back to Food after. IMMORTANT to prioritize safety of this landmark first. Try to avoid front facing Aachen Chapel as we will be putting our farms here later. Ideal Aachen Chapel would be influencing Food Wood and Gold, but depending on spawn this will not always be the case. More often, we will only be able to get 2/3 of these resources, so prioritize Food first (Food is the most inportant for fast castle with HRE) and influence either Wood or Gold depensing on your spawn.
After we have found a good spot to palce Aachen Chapel, rally to Wood and move 1 Food Villager to Wood. We will be getting the straggler Wood around our Town Center first.

Once we get 6 Wood Villager, we should have enough Wood for our first Outpost and this will usually be placed close to our Gold Villager. Have 1 Gold Villager build an Outpost. Try to place Outpost that it covers as much resources as possible. Have 1 Wood Villager put down another House. Then back on Wood.

Prelate goes inside Aachen Chapel as age up is finished. Take the time to adjust some Villager numbers as we will be redistributing our Wood Villager at this time. We will have 5 Gold Villager once the Outpost is completed. Town Center Rally Food. 4 Wood Villager will go straight to Stone. DO NOT BUILD A MINING CAMP. They will complete ONE mining cycle and then Rally Food. 2 Wood Villager will build a Stable / Barracks OR build a 2nd Outpost to cover your resources. Don't do both at this time.

By this time our Stone Villager will have finished one cycle of mining and will go on Food. Our 2 Villagers that were building Barracks / Stable OR 2nd Outpost will go back on Wood (if they were on Outpost then it may take them longer to get back). If we decided to go militery buildings, make around 3-5 units as needed but dont go overboard. Remember our goal is to leave Feudal Age asap and the longer we are fighing we worse our odds of winning. Get Arrowslits for your towers.
These are the numbers we are trying to end Feudal Age with.
Castle Age Regnitz Cathedral with 8 Food Villager. Then Town Center Rally Wood. It is now that we will start getting our economy upgrades. start with Double Broadax and Specialized Pick.

START GETTING RELICS Relic! This is very important and will unfortunately make or brake how your game will go. If you can get the age up even earlier and be safe at the same time even better. We are trying to get a minimum on Two (2) Relics. The more the merrier and the faster you will snowball. If you can secure Sacred Site as well please do. Keep Town Center Rally Wood.Start looking to get Forestry and Wheelbarrow. If you can not leave your base to secure more food start looking to transition into Farm. Otherwise, think about getting more Deer or even Boar on the map. Make a Market the first chance you get.

It is at this point you have to play and adapt with that is going on in the game. If you have not built a militery building now is the time to do so. The best army to go as HRE as you hit Castle Age are Knight as there is a good chance no one else has age 3 knights at this time in the game. Use your discretion however, as we are almost always going to be using Man-at-Arms as our late game comp as that is our best unit once fully upgraded. The remainder of this guide is going to assume the game is reletively stable for you after 8:00~

If you have been succesfull in obtaining Relic and/ or Sacred Site. HRE has a nice little advantage of not needing any Gold Villager to reach Imperial Age. Assuming you have at least 3 Relic and militery units, these numbers are possible to age up with. But its still a good idea to have some Gold Villager. Get any unit upgrade as needed and your remaining economy upgrades. Try to get to Imperial Age before 16:00 minutes if possible and good luck!

Move Ger to Wood
Stable: 2x Horsemen. Rally,then Sheep (12)

Deer Stones,then Unlocking Khan’s Hunter production is immensely valuable and, on top of that, it also boosts our economy by increasing the movement speed of our Villager. The Silver Tree,then In very closed maps like Black Forest or Mountain Pass. Not the purpose of this guide and, loosing the ability to produce Khan’s Hunter is really bad in the long term.
Rally,then Food (15). Research Wheelbarrow
Army composition: Raiding: Keshik + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter. All-in: Archer + Keshik + Khan’s Hunter + Battering Ram. Defending (2TC/Trade): Spearman + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter
Stable,then 2x Keshiks

Build Archery Range with 1 Wood Villager and move it inside Ovoo area of influence. OR --- vs French Jeanne d'Arc Byzantines ( Imperial Hippodrome ) Knights Templar Delhi Sultanate Mongols ---. Build,then Barracks (and later Archery Range )
Stable upgrade Horseman
Produce Mangudai + Keshik to raid and Spearman to defend against cavalry.
Choose a follow-up:

----------------------------------------------- All-in ------------------------------------------------. If the closest opponent to your base built additional Town Center. Rally,then Wood (20). Research Double Broadax, Steeled Arrow, Iron Undermesh and Siege Engineering (in that order). Afterwards, move 3 Gold Villager to Food. If enemy is making Knight, build Barracks and make some Spearman. If you are floating Wood, add second Archery Range for more Archer. Army: Archer + Keshik + Khan’s Hunter + Battering Ram. Use Stone to double produce Keshik. [Optional] Right before attacking with Battering Ram, research Raid Bounty.

---------------------------------------- Economic (trade): ----------------------------------------. Rally,then Wood (15). Research Double Broadax, Steeled Arrow and Iron Undermesh. Build Barracks and produce Spearman and Mangudai to defend while you keep raiding with Keshik and Mangudai. Build 2 Markets and Outpost all over the trade route. Keep distracting the opponents with your cavalry army while you invest on Venetian Trader. 15 Venetian Traders is a good amount to stop at until your team has completely secured the trade route with Stone Wall. Try to keep a decently sized army but prioritize going Castle Age, otherwise Castle Age Knight and Man-at-Arms can just permanently dive your Town Center and kill all your Villager and Venetian Trader.

---------------------------------------- Economic (2TC): ------------------------------------------. Rally,then Wood (15). Research Double Broadax, Steeled Arrow and Iron Undermesh. Build Barracks and produce Spearman and Mangudai to defend while you keep raiding with Keshik and Mangudai. Build 2nd Town Center with 12 Wood Villager and then Rally to Food and Gold. Keep distracting the opponents with your cavalry army while you invest on economy. Build Outpost to buff and protect your Villager. Try to keep a decently sized army but prioritize going Castle Age, otherwise Castle Age Knight and Man-at-Arms can just permanently dive your Town Center and Outpost and idle your entire economy.

After you finish gathering from Sheep, move 10 Villagers to Deer, build and Outpost near them and research Survival Techniques. If you want extra safety, build an additional Outpost to have enough space to garrison all of them.
Remember to research Superior Mobility at some point to be able to reposition Deer Stones faster.

Build Ger and put it on Ovoo to research improved versions of economic upgrades. Prioritize Forestry,then Double Broadax,then Horticulture,then Specialized Pick,then Wheelbarrow. Don't research improved Specialized Pick if you have Venetian Trader

Kurultai: As a follow-up to a failed Feudal Age all-in, to defend against Castle Age all-ins or if trade is viable (good map control, allies are walling...). Steppe Redoubt: For Fast Imperial when trade is not viable (your team has no map control, your team is not walling, the enemies are making a lot of cavalry...).
Army composition: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Crossbowman + Khan’s Hunter + Mangonel

Change to an infantry based army with Spearman and Crossbowman, adding Man-at-Arms for extra tankiness on the frontline and Mangonel to kill big masses of Archer and Crossbowman. Both Mangudai and Keshik are terrible against Castle Age Knight, making basically every matchup unwinnable with them.

Start adding Pasture with 3 Villagers at a time and sending them to gather Sheep. Build them near your main Town Center leaving a 4x5 space in the center to fit a Prayer Tent which will buff their production speed thanks to Monastic Shrines. Build a total of 16 Pastures and place them in Ovoo / Prayer Tent / The White Stupa area of influence. That's enough to sustain 40 Villagers with all Horticulture upgrades (the improved one too).

Research: Ovoo: Whistling Arrows and, if you are going to push enemy base, Raid Bounty. Ger: Fertilization and Lumber Preservation. If you don't have Venetian Trader, also research Specialized Pick and Shaft Mining. Don't forget about relevant Blacksmith upgrades.
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production balance: 3 Barracks; 3 Archery Ranges; 1 Stable
Build Outpost around your resources (specially the Pasture ).

*Team games tip: When saving up to reach Imperial Age, move your buildings into your allies’ base and place the landmark in the safest spot. You’re already pausing production to save resources, so this won’t slow you down (much), and your Food Villager should have enough Sheep to get to 2400.

Khaganate Palace: If you didn't invest on economy (no trade or 2nd Town Center ) but still want to reach Imperial Age quickly, this landmark can help you in the early phases to repopulate your army and survive while you get key upgrades for your units. The White Stupa: Allows getting the improved versions of upgrades and Cannon Emplacement on your Outpost sooner. If you have high Venetian Trader count, it's not necessary.
Build 2nd Blacksmith inside Ovoo / Prayer Tent / The White Stupa area of influence.

Now it's the time to think about what late-game army composition you want to streamline which Imperial Age upgrades you will get: - Infantry: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Handcannon Ashigaru + Khan’s Hunter + Mangonel + Bombard. - Cavalry: Horseman / Keshik + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter
Army composition: - Infantry: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Handcannon Ashigaru + Khan’s Hunter + Mangonel + Bombard. - Cavalry: Horseman / Keshik + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter
Research elite upgrades for your units as soon as you age up. If you have Venetian Trader, also research Stone Commerce.

Blacksmith upgrades depending on army composition: - Infantry: Elite Army Tactics (regular),then Serpentine Powder,then Siege Works,then Chemistry. Also research on Siege Workshop: Adjustable Crossbars + Greased Axles. - Cavalry: Siha Bow Limbs (improved),then Incendiary Arrows,then Silk Bowstrings,then Platecutter Point,then Biology
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this: If possible, substitute Gold Villager for Venetian Trader
Production balance: (Infantry). 10 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 2 Siege Workshops. (Cavalry). 5 Archery Ranges; 10 Stables

Save up Stone for improved versions of: - Infantry: Elite Army Tactics,then Greased Axles,then Siege Works. - Cavalry: Siha Bow Limbs,then Biology,then Steppe Lancers. If you have Venetian Trader, prioritize Stone Commerce after Elite Army Tactics / Biology. Remember to eventually research *Pax Mongolica* and Court Architects. Other improved upgrades that are worth getting are: Military Academy, Whistling Arrows, Stone Bounty, Raid Bounty, Textiles, Tithe Barns (if you have Relic ). Also, upgrade your Outpost with Cannon Emplacement (starting by the ones in your base).

Once you get 350 Stone, build 2nd Town Center behind your base to protect future Farm placements. Ideally you want it near Wood.
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:

Make a big army, fight a lot with your opponent before they can set up their economy and slowly grab Relic and capture Sacred Site. Our goal now is to slow down the game to get Vizier Point until our economy is strong enough to go Imperial Age comfortably.

Vizier Point Advanced Academy,then *,then Siege Crews. *For the 4th Vizier Point, you can choose any upgrade you want, but it's too early to really benefit from Siege Crews, so leave that one for last. My recommendations: - Janissary Company can help you turn around a complicated situation or get an edge over the opponent's army and start a snowball effect. - Pax Ottomana on 1 Town Center is helpful, but not that great. On 2 Town Centers though, it's a massive boost that allows you to reach optimal Villager count just as quickly as if you had started the game with the additional Town Center.
Istanbul Observatory: Always the best choice. Sea Gate Castle: Only if you desperately need to protect your base from an incoming all-in OR if you are trading (which we are not doing in this guide).

Army composition: Man-at-Arms + Sipahi + Janissary + Mehter + Great Bombard. OR (vs Lancer + Archer ). Spearman + Lancer + Crossbowman + Mehter + Mangonel. Add Ribauldequin if enemy is making melee units only
Upgrade Sipahi to elite. If enemy is not making a lot of Archer, also upgrade Janissary to elite and research Janissary Guns. Otherwise upgrade Crossbowman to elite.
University: Biology (,then Incendiary Arrows ),then Elite Army Tactics,then Chemistry,then Siege Works. Incendiary Arrows only if you are making Crossbowman instead of Janissary
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this: Once you have a good bank of resources, you can delete Villager thanks to Military School free units.
Production balance: 5 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 5 Stables; 2 Siege Workshops

Once you are close to max population, gather a lot of Wood and do the Farm transition. You can keep reinforcing your army slowly thanks to Military School and Mehmed Imperial Armory, so the impact should be lower than for other civilizations.

At 30 Food Villager change Town Center Rally to Wood and 1 Gold. Send 4 Wood Villager to gather Stone and get Daimyo Palace

Floating Gate: For better tempo (faster unit upgrades and production speed) and passive Gold income. You might also be able to snatch one of the last Relic since the first Shinto Priest comes out immediately after completing the landmark. Temple of Equality: Only if there still are lots of Relic left to pick up on the map (which there shouldn't be) and you are not being pressured by enemies. Buddhist Monk are also decent against Order of the Dragon units and Delhi Sultanate elephants.

Ideal army composition: Onna-Bugeisha + Naginata Samurai + Katana Bannerman. Add Spearman vs Knight. Add Horseman vs Crossbowman, Springald and Mangonel. Add Mangonel vs Archer, Crossbowman and Handcannon Ashigaru. - Mounted Samurai for raiding only. No more than 10.

Floating Gate: Ideally you want to place the yorishiros on 1 Stable and 3 Forges, but if you have a big infantry army by the time you age up, put it on 1 Barracks instead to get the upgrades faster. Temple of Equality: Zen allows you to get value similar to that of trading with smaller investment and zero risk. Keeping between 10 and 20 Buddhist Monks alive at all times will boost your economy quite significantly, although you might need the population space later on.
If there still are Relic, try to grab them

During this age you should finish setting up your Farm economy to keep constant unit production and still manage to save up for Imperial Age. This includes researching Daimyo Palace and Shogunate Castle on your main Town Center
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:

Tanegashima Gunsmith: Is the standard. Always good no matter what. Getting free Handcannon Ashigaru and Ozutsu adds a lot of firepower to your main army with just 1 Yumi Bannerman, no further investment is needed for them to work. Ribauldequin are excellent at defending against big groups of melee units. And Bombard are excellent at finishing off opponents. Castle of the Crow: Is very strong in the late stages of the game to protect key resources in the middle of the map or to secure chokepoints. The additional resources are also nothing to scoff at. 210 Food Wood Gold and 70 Stone per minute is the equivalent to 9 Relic split into all 4 resources.

Ideal army composition: Mounted Samurai + Handcannon Ashigaru + Uma Bannerman + Yumi Bannerman. Add Onna-Bugeisha + Katana Bannerman vs Spearman + Crossbowman. Add Spearman vs Horseman Knight. Add Bombard to finish the game
See to the left. Economy balance should look like this.
Military buildings proportions: 15 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 10 Stables; 1 Siege Workshop
Since the japanese gain additional Stone when mining Gold and viceversa, and your army is very Gold heavy, researching Cupellation after your military "elitency" upgrades is very much worth it.

Research Bunrei at a Shinto Shrine and place the two new yorishiros at Forge. Additionally, you may delete the Stable / Archery Range holding the first yorishiro to place the replacement on a Siege Workshop. Getting siege units and their upgrades faster can be crucial in the late stages of the game.

Commanderies don't affect water units at all, but we should consider what will be more impactful in the mid-game, when we will start fighting on land. Kingdom of France is the obvious choice to unlock Chevalier Confrere for raiding enemy Wood Villager. They are way cheaper than Templar Brother and just as good as a distraction. The bonus production speed is also great to transition to a land army quicker. Principality of Antioch unlocks Serjeant, which can be amassed very quickly in the mid game for a very powerful all-in. They are also a decent counter to Feudal Age Knight alongside Spearman and a good frontline to protect Archer from cavalry flanking maneuvers. Knights Hospitaller: Hospitaller Knight are only good in fights with low numbers to take advantage of their healing ability. Because the early game is basically skipped in water/hybrid maps, they loose all value.

description: BO basé sur le nouveau guide de Beasty. Cette stratégie est idéale contre les adversaires qui essaient de développer leur économie en ajoutant un forum ou en investissant dans les éclaireurs professionnels. Elle consiste à utiliser quelques derviches et pillards du désert pour ralentir leur économie, puis foncer à l'âge des châteaux pour prendre les reliques, et enrôler une armée de chameliers, d'archers et d'engins de sièges pour garder la pression sur l'ennemi et ainsi avoir toute la carte pour soi. Les nombres de villageois indiqués dans la colonne de gauche sont tirés autant que possible du guide. Ceux qui ont été déterminés par un test en jeu rapide sont précédés d'un "≃", ils sont purement indicatifs.

title: New Player Guide to French
description: Very basic, no-frills French build order for new players. Video below! A single-minded gameplan: mass Royal Knights and pick apart your opponent before overwhelming them outright. This can be played on any land map against any civilisation allowing you to take map control and dictate the tempo in any game. Works even better in team games! There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Keep adding vils to food and gold, add more stables, and don't let up with making knights. When you have a critical mass or your opponent tries to age up, take a straight up fight and/or dive your opponent's base. 2. Go Castle Age! Stop making knights and age up with the Royal Institute. Once up, upgrade your Royal Knights and get the Royal Bloodlines upgrade to make your army unkillable. Once you're feeling comfortable with this build, look for a more advanced and optimal build order. The more standard French build order opts for Knights + Archers in Feudal Age which, although a bit more complicated, is often stronger in 1v1s. I recommend checking out a recent build order guide video from a pro player. Two good options are Beastyqt and Valdemar.

Always try to harras enemy resources with 2 Sipahis. while your opponent distracted because of fighting against your pushes-or his aggressive behaviors-hunt his villagers with sipahis to eliminate resources for his productions.It will help you in any situation deffensive or agressive doesnt matter. After harrasing his/her economy and military things; research Siege Engineering and try to end with few Battering Ram. but only produce it if u are in front of him by military count and power. Good Luck and Have Fun

title: KT Dark Age spear rush (vs. Cav. civs)
description: A "cheese" build allowing you to rush out 3 spearmen in Dark Age and still Age-up in the most competitive timing. Good for early gold harassment & picking your opponent off-guard, pushing your deer (nerved) & laming opponent's deer. The build goes then right into a greedy 2 Pilgrims right away utilizing your already trained spearmen for escort until you build up your army behind and take map control. The build is made by me personally and is NOT recommended for gold players as it requires a very high APM & multitasking to reach its goals (push/lame deer/harass) while managing to pull off really tight resource timings. Extended build practice vs AI is recommended before trying this on ladder. Many attempts went into perfecting this build. However if you find any optimizations, feel free to comment below & I will test them out and edit the build if they are really an improvement.
author: Massacrimus
steps: I recommend practicing the build several times against AI because it is pretty tight to pull off if you want to avoid TC idle time. Sometimes due to poor spawn and far-away gold, a ~3s TC idle time might be unavoidable. It is still better than trying to gather another 50 wood for house before clicking-up (huge delay).
Rally 5 Villagers to Straggler Tree asap and 1 Villager to Sheep. Rally all following Villager only to Sheep until Feudal Age
@150 Wood build a Barracks BEHIND your Town Center and Scout around your opponent's base to find his Gold!
@50 Wood move 2 Villagers from Straggler Tree -,then Sheep
Build a House with the builder Villager, then rally him to Wood (with him these will be our 3 gold villagers for age-up)
Train first Spearman immediately, but prioritize constant Villager production always! (the barracks will have slight idle time)

Train 2. and 3. Spearman and get active: 1. IF enemy is civ that needs gold mining to age-up,then harass his Gold! 2. If enemy civ is not dependent on gold, then PUSH Deer to your Town Center and then LAME opponent's Deer
@50 Wood and 3 trained spears -,then switch the 3 Wood Villager to Gold and build Mining Camp
Continue Rally Villager to Sheep until you have for Feudal Age @20/20 supply (don't worry about the supply block!)

There are different options for villager splits while aging up depending on your goals. You can modify the build from here on. The recommended split allows you to Research Safe Passage, train 2 villagers, then instantly Sanctuary (allowing 2 pilgrims on the second trip asap) and have enough resources for Stable and Survival Techniques right away.
Feudal Age with Kingdom of France (click-up @3:25). Switch 6 Sheep Villager + 2 Gold Villager to Wood. Build a House while aging up.

From here on you must freestyle / play according to your match-up and strategy. I like going for Chevalier Confrere + Archer with Blacksmith upgrades and 1-2 Battering Rams, while having a few Spearman to defend. Applying pressure on the opponent in Feudal Age in order to ensure he is too busy to contest your Sanctuary while slowly aging up to Castle Age to upgrade your army and get the Relic. - If opponent rushes Castle Age, then skip Archer entirely and get ~8-10 Chevalier Confreres to harass his Gold, switch 3 Wood Villager to Gold / Food and then age-up fast yourself while using your Chevalier Confrere to deny opponent's Monk and maintain map control! - If the game seems like it will drag on into a long Feudal Age, make sure you get your Wheelbarrow and Horticulture early. ( Specialized Pick is not worth it if you have fewer than 6 Gold Villager, assuming your main gold income will be from Sanctuary )
@ Feudal Age: Research Safe Passage and immediately queue up exactly 2 Villagers, 1 to Sheep and 1 to Gold
@150 Wood build a Stable with a sheep Villager
Queue-up Sanctuary AS SOON as you get the resources for it! (even 1 second delay/idle time on TC will screw you up!)
Build a Mill near your Town Center or Berries (wherever Deer is) and research Survival Techniques. Swap Sheep Villager to Deer!
Start producing Chevalier Confrere for map control and harassment, escort your pilgrims if needed. I like adding a 2. Stable

Produce Prelate everytime you have a bit of gold but it won’t stop barracks production(rally with men at arms)

Game should be over before those are gone. Civs with horse archers can counter this. But you should still win because the rams will force them to stay instead of kite. Always keep 1 prelate with food and 1 with wood and gold or vice versa depending on resource placement. Build houses when needed, you shouldn’t need more than 5 or 6. title: New Player Guide to Macedonian Dynasty
description: As basic as possible Macedonian build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to be aggressive in the Feudal Age with Hippodrome and Varangian Guard. This can be played on any land map against any* civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games! There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build and attack: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Make more production for more VG, take the map's food, and keep diving until your opponent is tapped. Having lvl 2 infantry defence while both in feudal age is essentially a win condition. 2. Go Castle Age! Halt production of VG and age up with the Golden Horn Tower in a defensive location. Upgrade your VG and spam Riddari out of your Hippodrome + Strongholds. Don't forget your Arsenal upgrades and go kill your opponent. *Going mass VG is not efficient against feudal knight civs. You will want to make spears (Atgeirmaðr) out of the Strongholds instead of VG, and don't halt making horsemen. Don't add any more vils to gold than the original 2, otherwise the build order is essentially identical. Look to take good fights and if you all in, use cheirosiphons as spears can't dive like the VG!

title: Golden Horde | Fast Castle
description: Distract the opponent with Khan and Torguuds while you save up for aging up to Castle Age. Then rush relics and spam Kipchaks and heavy cavalry. Even if you optimize the build order to go Fast Castle naked and without gathering wood, the age up timing still is the worst out of all the civilizations currently in the game, hence it's best to make a few torguuds to raid and slow down the opponent. Added some tips for the late game. Check my other golden horde guides: - Feudal aggro: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/oETaXrqjc8MOTMRV8eem - Feudal all-in: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/CroZRSJRDDcQvM3tY58o
author: Jockxtar
steps: 5 Villagers,then Sheep. 1 Villager,then Build Ovoo,then Build Golden Tent (next to Gold ),then Build Ger on Gold. Rally,then Sheep (8)
Rally,then Gold (3)
Rally,then Sheep (10)
Rally,then Straggler Tree (5)

Rally,then Sheep (16)
Research Wheelbarrow
Send the closest villager to the second Stone to be ready to Build Ovoo
Produce Batu Khan from Golden Tent. Build Ovoo

From Building Carts, unpack next to Golden Tent, leaving a 3x3 space in the center for a future Fortified Outpost: Stable + Archery Range. OR --- vs Delhi Sultanate French Jeanne d'Arc Rus Knights Templar Mongols Golden Horde Byzantines ( Imperial Hippodrome ) ---. Stable + Barracks and adapt the rest of the build order to make a few Spearman to defend.
Golden Tent,then Torguud
With Wheelbarrow complete, you may move 5 Villagers to closest Deer and research Survival Techniques. If not now, do it when it's safe.
Build Ger on Wood
Golden Tent,then Torguud
Rally,then Gold (8)

Build Fortified Outpost on Deer with 5 Sheep Villager, so that you have a total of 10 on Deer and the rest on Sheep. This is risky but will accelerate the timing considerably. If too risky, build it with the 5 Villagers already on Deer.
Build Fortified Outpost on Golden Tent (and production buildings) with 1 Wood Villager

Force drop Food and Gold if necessary. Also, make sure you don't have more than 1 Villager in production. If you move an extra 5 Villagers to Deer as I mentioned, you may get an even faster timing than 7:55.
Golden Tent,then Relic Ovoos: The whole point of this build order is to grab Relic quickly.
Rally,then Wood
Stable start producing Keshik nonstop
1 Wood Villager,then Build Blacksmith
Research Double Broadax
1 Wood Villager,then Build Archery Range (we want to have 2 in total)
Army composition: Batu Khan + Torguud + Keshik + Kipchak. Add Kharash against Spearman. Add Horseman against Crossbowman. Make Spearman + Crossbowman to defend against Knight
Upon aging up, unpack the newly generated Building Carts as a Prayer Tent. Golden Tent,then Torguud. Stable upgrade Keshik
Prayer Tent,then Shaman to pick up Relic. We will grab the Relic and drop them in our base as Relic Ovoos
Build third Ovoo when we have a decent army to defend with or if the opponent is distracted blocking Relic.
Once Sheep run out, move the 8 Villagers to Boar or a second pack of Deer. If too risky, send them to Berries, but only as a last resort.

Now that we have 15 Villagers on Wood (which is enough to produce Kipchak on 2 Archery Ranges ), start adding Stockyard gradually with Wood Villager whenever you float over 300 Wood. We want to have 12 Stockyards in total. Build them around Fortified Outpost at the back of your base. Rotation Grazing and Over Grazing are very important.
Remember to research Ovoo Offering, Steeled Arrow, Balanced Projectiles and Lumber Preservation. As well as other relevant Blacksmith upgrades.

Produce Torguud until you have 8 or 10. Then, depending on the enemy army composition, use excess Stone for: - vs Spearman + Crossbowman: Kharash Edict,then Triple Shot,then Battlefield Salvage. - vs mass Archer: Stables Reinforcements,then Padded Armor. - vs anything else: Archery Range Reinforcements,then Triple Shot

We want to prolong Castle Age as much as possible to get our Stone related upgrades before saving up to Imperial Age. It is a good idea to research Stockyard Edict before aging up to get extra Gold for upgrades while waiting.

Stone Armies: Reduces the amount of time it takes to produce Torguud and Stone cost by half (from 20 to 10 seconds, 160 Stone to 80). Since that's the core unit in our army, the faster we produce them the better. Yam Network Trade: Generates passive Gold for each Fortified Outpost built, which comes very handy for producing Handcannon Ashigaru. Since we already are generating Gold with Stockyard Edict, Yam Network Trade is not entirely necessary, so choose your favourite.
Produce Horseman instead of Keshik to save up Gold. Also, upgrade Horseman to Castle Age.
Switch to Stockyard Edict for extra Gold.
If you didn't already, research Rotation Grazing and Over Grazing at Ger
Army composition: Batu Khan + Torguud + Handcannon Ashigaru. Add Horseman against Crossbowman. Add Bombard to destroy Keep. Use Horseman and Kipchak to raid enemy economy.

Research Ovoo Ceremony ASAP. Upgrade Keshik and Horseman if you already have a lot of them, otherwise skip that to get the other upgrades. Focus on producing Torguud and Handcannon Ashigaru, that will be the core of the army. Once you are at full population, spend Stone on upgrades (see next row).

Blacksmith: Biology,then Serpentine Powder,then Angled Surfaces,then Damascus Steel,then Master Smiths. With Stone: Ovoo Tithe,then Archery Range Reinforcements,then Stables Reinforcements,then Padded Armor,then Increased Supplies,then Steppe Lancers,then Glorious Charge
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production buildings: 1 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 3 Stables

Edicts: Production Edict: Not very useful at this point since we can simply build more production buildings. Defensive Edict: Toggle it if you are fighting in range of a Fortified Outpost. Kharash Edict: Not worth at this point in the game. The +1 armor is barely noticeable against Imperial Age units. Stockyard Edict: The best by default. The extra Gold is very much needed for the army.

This also makes it easier to open with a barracks (or archery range) and delay a stables if needed. Use your prelate to inspire gold villagers at the start, but otherwise keep prelate on food vils to help make up for the delay on food collection from double scout.

Build House and Mill using 2 Wood Villager

Your goal upon hitting feudal age is to get professional scouts researched and start using your 2 scouts to pull deer ASAP. Best case scenario you can start taking 2+ deer from the enemy side, especially if you found enough sheep to last. Because you opened with 2 scouts, you don't need to open with a stables to start collecting deer. Instead you can start making Awl Pikes Spearman to defend your scouts, kill enemy scouts, or harass the enemy. Once professional scouts is up, deer are coming in, and you have some military units you now need to adapt to the current game situation. Continue making units if needed to defend or harass. Scale up production more barracks, stables, or ranges. If you have the room to do so and are not committing to a feudal victory, adjust your villagers to food and gold to bootstrap into Castle Age. Either Regnitz Cathedral or Burgrave Palace can be good, depending on the situation and your gameplan.

Upgrade Horseman if you have more than 10 (Same with other unit types!). Build Blacksmith near WINERY Cistern ( Timing around 7 minutes ). Use longbows around resources to get vision if you dont have Border Settlements or Outpost up. You want to make Outpost on Berries if they are facing your enemy. Make Outpost on the Gold if no forward Berries. In feudal, start with a Barracks to make Limitanei vs knight civs ( Jeanne d'Arc French Rus Mongols ) then go into Mercenary House. (+1 and +2 ranged upgrades are insanely important, your longbows are basically crossbows for dealing with anything living and mechanical, with good splits during fights, you can whittle down mangonels too very quickly). Consider your timings. You can make a lot of units in castle and push, but when you approach 200/200 it is time for imperial. Another timing is your age 4 Longbowmen upgrade that makes them do serious damage again vs age 3 opponent. Varangian age 4 upgrade is also insane. In higher ranked games, it's typically over in under 20 min. Generally you should have 2 production buildings at near the. same time you finish age up and be making army non stop. Transition to castle with a purpose, because you are at a disadvantage in early castle if you don't have the resources to use it. Also never float resources, keep everything under 300 when not planning to use those resources immediately! Solid additional tips: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1i9ZrtievRYPquOD0fYgDC71pSZpDZ6iY2TzYcQOF59I/edit?gid=2112505777#gid=2112505777. ( Many tips courtesy of Vlademar and Beasty )

Limitanei + Horseman for low Gold / getting into late Imperial Age

title: BeastyQT Castle Rush with HRE in Season 6 AOE4
description: A guide to help with HRE castle rushing in Season 6 by BeastyQT
author: Lasco senpai
steps: 3 Villagers on food and 3 on gold ASAP. Prelate moved to inspire ALL gold Villager and then immediately back to inspire food. First new Villager will build House then Rally Sheep.
should be able to Feudal Age here. Once you have 8 Villagers on Food, Rally Wood.

Feudal Age Aachen Chapel with 4 Food Villager and rally them back to Food after. IMMORTANT to prioritize safety of this landmark first. Try to avoid front facing Aachen Chapel as we will be putting our farms here later. Ideal Aachen Chapel would be influencing Food Wood and Gold, but depending on spawn this will not always be the case. More often, we will only be able to get 2/3 of these resources, so prioritize Food first (Food is the most inportant for fast castle with HRE) and influence either Wood or Gold depensing on your spawn.
After we have found a good spot to palce Aachen Chapel, rally to Wood and move 1 Food Villager to Wood. We will be getting the straggler Wood around our Town Center first.

Once we get 6 Wood Villager, we should have enough Wood for our first Outpost and this will usually be placed close to our Gold Villager. Have 1 Gold Villager build an Outpost. Try to place Outpost that it covers as much resources as possible. Have 1 Wood Villager put down another House. Then back on Wood.

Prelate goes inside Aachen Chapel as age up is finished. Take the time to adjust some Villager numbers as we will be redistributing our Wood Villager at this time. We will have 5 Gold Villager once the Outpost is completed. Town Center Rally Food. 4 Wood Villager will go straight to Stone. DO NOT BUILD A MINING CAMP. They will complete ONE mining cycle and then Rally Food. 2 Wood Villager will build a Stable / Barracks OR build a 2nd Outpost to cover your resources. Don't do both at this time.

By this time our Stone Villager will have finished one cycle of mining and will go on Food. Our 2 Villagers that were building Barracks / Stable OR 2nd Outpost will go back on Wood (if they were on Outpost then it may take them longer to get back). If we decided to go militery buildings, make around 3-5 units as needed but dont go overboard. Remember our goal is to leave Feudal Age asap and the longer we are fighing we worse our odds of winning. Get Arrowslits for your towers.
These are the numbers we are trying to end Feudal Age with.
Castle Age Regnitz Cathedral with 8 Food Villager. Then Town Center Rally Wood. It is now that we will start getting our economy upgrades. start with Double Broadax and Specialized Pick.

START GETTING RELICS Relic! This is very important and will unfortunately make or brake how your game will go. If you can get the age up even earlier and be safe at the same time even better. We are trying to get a minimum on Two (2) Relics. The more the merrier and the faster you will snowball. If you can secure Sacred Site as well please do. Keep Town Center Rally Wood.Start looking to get Forestry and Wheelbarrow. If you can not leave your base to secure more food start looking to transition into Farm. Otherwise, think about getting more Deer or even Boar on the map. Make a Market the first chance you get.

It is at this point you have to play and adapt with that is going on in the game. If you have not built a militery building now is the time to do so. The best army to go as HRE as you hit Castle Age are Knight as there is a good chance no one else has age 3 knights at this time in the game. Use your discretion however, as we are almost always going to be using Man-at-Arms as our late game comp as that is our best unit once fully upgraded. The remainder of this guide is going to assume the game is reletively stable for you after 8:00~

If you have been succesfull in obtaining Relic and/ or Sacred Site. HRE has a nice little advantage of not needing any Gold Villager to reach Imperial Age. Assuming you have at least 3 Relic and militery units, these numbers are possible to age up with. But its still a good idea to have some Gold Villager. Get any unit upgrade as needed and your remaining economy upgrades. Try to get to Imperial Age before 16:00 minutes if possible and good luck!

Feudal Age Aachen Chapel with 3 Villagers place on Wood. Prioritize safety, farms here later. Ideal Aachen Chapel would be influencing Food Wood and Gold, but depending on spawn this will not always be the case. More often, we will only be able to get 2/3 of these resources, so prioritize Food first

Strat after: After this you can go full maa and take out eco, go 2nd tc and/or go for castle age reignitz. We dont go burger, because we already have barracks. Dont forget to take res on map since we have map control
Prelate goes inside Aachen Chapel as age up is finished. 3 Feudal Age Villager back to Food. Build Blacksmith + Barracks
Build 2nd Barracks and resplit vills 15/3 for Man-at-Arms
Queue Marching Drills,then Iron Undermesh
Rally Wood when 15 Villagers Food. Spam Man-at-Arms
THE ABOVE AND FOLLOWING ARE BEASTY'S FAST CASTLE GUIDE, WILL ADJUST END GAME STEPS FOR FC AFTER TESTING
Castle Age Regnitz Cathedral with 8 Food Villager. Then Town Center Rally Wood. It is now that we will start getting our economy upgrades. start with Double Broadax and Specialized Pick. Castle Age

START GETTING RELICS Relic! This is very important and will unfortunately make or brake how your game will go. If you can get the age up even earlier and be safe at the same time even better. We are trying to get a minimum on Two (2) Relics. The more the merrier and the faster you will snowball. If you can secure Sacred Site as well please do. Keep Town Center Rally Wood.Start looking to get Forestry and Wheelbarrow. If you can not leave your base to secure more food start looking to transition into Farm. Otherwise, think about getting more Deer or even Boar on the map. Make a Market the first chance you get.

It is at this point you have to play and adapt with that is going on in the game. If you have not built a militery building now is the time to do so. The best army to go as HRE as you hit Castle Age are Knight as there is a good chance no one else has age 3 knights at this time in the game. Use your discretion however, as we are almost always going to be using Man-at-Arms as our late game comp as that is our best unit once fully upgraded. The remainder of this guide is going to assume the game is reletively stable for you after 8:00~

If you have been succesfull in obtaining Relic and/ or Sacred Site. HRE has a nice little advantage of not needing any Gold Villager to reach Imperial Age. Assuming you have at least 3 Relic and militery units, these numbers are possible to age up with. But its still a good idea to have some Gold Villager. Get any unit upgrade as needed and your remaining economy upgrades. Try to get to Imperial Age before 16:00 minutes if possible and good luck!

Age up to Feudal Age with Kingdom of France

When playing with Knights Templar, it is likely that your enemy will try to stop your Safe Passage, so you need to protect them and change the Sacred Site destination accordingly.

From now on, you need to manage your economy depending on how the match is developing. Remember to send Villager to Gold as the Safe Passage will not supply enough on their own. Produce more military units, gather Stone to build Fortress at your enemy's city (and get more Safe Passage ), keep pushing your enemy or save resources to age up to Castle Age
When you age up to Feudal Age, immediately research Safe Passage and send them to the best Sacred Site location
Send the next 2 Villagers alongside with 1 from Sheep to Wood
Queue Sanctuary. This should be perfectly timed so the next time your pilgrims spawn (every 60 seconds), you can have 2 instead of 1 (start researching Sanctuary at least 20 seconds before the spawn)
Rally Villager to Food
Build a Stable and start producing Chevalier Confrere. Build an Archery Range and produce Archer
Go harass your enemy Villager

title: Dark Age Horsemen Rush
description: This strategy is using the Stables as an opener, instead of barracks and uses the 2x bonus for Horsemen, giving you quick and effective units to neutralize enemy deployment outside their TC Range and effectively kill villagers/neutralize Gold. It is not followed up by a Tower Rush, though it might be, and secures a transition into Mangudai, Archers or Keshik.
author: Kharyshkyr
steps: Villager 5x Villagers go to Wood, 1x Villager goes builds OOVOO. / Alternatively, If Stone and Wood are close, 6x Villager build Ovoo,compromising idle time (adds up to max 50 res). Then, send 1x to Food and 5x to Wood. Send Town Center Wandering Town Town Center as a second action, quickly, to the treeline, as close as possible to either Gold or Stone. Send Khan away and assign to Hotkey 1. Send Sheep near TC, but not on it, they prevent TC from placing down.
Place TC and create 4x Villagers. Rally new villagers to Sheep, up until you have 9 Villagers on Food. Collect 150 Wood. Scout for Sheep with Ger.

Wood From Wood, take 4 Villagers, force drop, and send to sheep. Select one Villager to build Stable. No hurry. (if you have not built oovoo with 6, you have time). Scout the Area with Khan. You have time to start with sheep around your area, but you should check for the gold location. Hitting a villager with a few shots to weaken a villager will make Horseman more effective.
When you have 9 Villagers on Food, Rally 2 villagers to Gold. Have Ger placed. *If you scout enemy Spearman, rally 2 more villagers on Wood for a defensive Outpost on Gold.

Create 2x Horsemen and send War Horses with previously set rally point on enemy gold. Intercept with Khan for Whistling Arrows increased movement speed. *Building oovoo first grants up to 15 seconds faster production.

Once you have 2 villagers on gold rallied, send Rally next villagers to Food Sheep under TC. Harass your opponents Gold, Berries or intercept Scouts or Villagers outside of TC range. Ideally, you can burn the Mining Camp of your opponent for 25 Food, 25 Gold.

Once you are close to aging up (Around 4:00), select 6 Villagers and ready them to build the Landmark Deer Stones. When you age up, you will have 8 on Food, 1 on Wood, 2 on Gold. Rally the next villagers to Wood, keep harassing your opponent. You can produce another Horseman or a Scout during Age-Up. If you create a Horseman before aging up, your age-up will be delayed.

You will age up around the 5:20 minute. Upgrade Horseman, it is cheap and makes them stronger. Now, you can transition into an Archery Range or into 2x Keshik, whatever you see fit, and send villagers that built landmark to gold (you need 7 on gold, 6 on wood, rest go to food).

title: French Feudal Rush & transitions
description: Feudal Age Rush with notes on how to transition into all-in, Castle Age or 2TC . I'm kinda of a noob, the guides I write are mostly my experience/intuition and meant for personal use, so take them with a grain of salt.
author: Jockxtar
steps: Scout scout opponent. Find weakspots and exposed resources.
6 Villagers,then Sheep
Second Villager,then House,then Mining Camp,then Gold. Rally,then Gold (3)
Rally,then Sheep (12). Scout returns Sheep to Town Center
5 Sheep Villager,then School of Cavalry

Vs Ottomans Ayyubids Abbasid Dynasty: Soft raids with the first few knights. Idle oponent's villagers until you have enough archers. If you can't break their defense, age up and make crossbows to counter camel riders, ghulams and janissaries. Vs Rus French Jeanne d'Arc Byzantines (Hippodrome): Make a bunch of spears to defend from raids. Separate a few knights to raid and leave the rest at home to defend if you see them commiting hard to feudal age. Otherwise, match their strategy (2TC or FC) while you raid with a few early knights and a bunch of archers. Vs Delhi Sultanate: Cry. Make a few spears to defend from raids. Separate a few knights to raid and leave the rest at home to defend. Knights should be enough to protect your archers from Ghazis, but Delhi's double production speed and the extra attack speed from the landmark can be quite scary. Try to not get stuck in Feudal Age for long. I haven't tried this, but opening with 2nd scout and getting extra sheep seems like a good idea, since Delhi's scout will usually try to steal the sheep on your side of the map. If you feel extra spicy, you can try stealing deer with Professional Scouts upgrade to safely get to Castle Age. Doing both secures enough safe food, but also forces Delhi's villagers away from their TC, making them more vulnerable to raids. Arbalétrier with Gambesons upgrade Gambesons and Mangonels should work nicely against Delhi's army. And once you get a Keep around your production to defend and make units cheaper, you should win easy. Vs Mongols: Cry harder. Build an outpost in Dark Age to protect gold vein. Separate a few knights to raid and leave the rest at home to defend. French Knights are better than mongol Keshik, so you don't need too many spears, just a few to get good trades and force the mongol archers to move forward. You can't outproduce a mongol player, you need to quickly transition to Castle Age and make an army of MAA + Arbalétrier + Springalds (if they also reach Castle Age)
5 School of Cavalry Villager,then Wood
School of Cavalry constantly producing Royal Knight. 1 Sheep Villager,then House
Rally,then Gold (6)
Rally,then Wood (10). Build Mill near Deer
At 150 Wood,then Archery Range. Make 4 Archers
Rally,then Gold (9). 4th House,then Blacksmith,then restart Archer production
With excess gold research upgrades: Wheelbarrow,then Steeled Arrow,then Iron Undermesh. Delay 1 Royal Knight for each upgrade
Take advantage from the pressure to gather Deer and Boar

Standard, flexible build: - Castle Age: Rally,then Food (16) and Gold (12) for FC. Research Survival Techniques,then Specialized Pick. Stop making units after you get a big enough army. - 2TC: Rally,then Wood (16) and Stone (5). Research Specialized Pick,then Double Broadax. You might have to stop producing Archer

All-in, Feudal push: Rally,then Wood (x). Research Siege Engineering and make rams. Research Double Broadax,then Survival Techniques. Eventually you can build second Archery Range to increase the production. If the all-in fails, periodically relocate Wood Villager,then Food for Castle Age. If you lost a big part of your army and can't keep the control of the map, consider making Farm
Royal Institute to finish the game in Castle Age. Guild Hall if you expect/want the game to go to Imperial Age. Move 10 Villagers,then Stone for an early Keep near your production buildings.
Gather 810 Stone for a Keep. Ideal army composition: Royal Knight Arbalétrier. Add Springald if against Mangonel

title: Japanese Kura Storehouse 3TC Boom
description: [NOT COMPLETE] -The core idea with this is to collect 1000 Stone early (2x TC + Daimyo Manor) and get 200 Gold for this passively. This means getting the missing 100 Gold for Feudal Age as well as 100 Gold for Double Broadaxe pretty early in Feudal. -We will then have 3TCs, +25% Farming and +15% Wood boost very early in the game and every opponent that is not also fully booming will be pretty much put all-in, so we only need to hold his Feudal aggression to sail to victory. -About TC placement: Since we will boom for Food under our upgraded Main TC with Farms, we want our 3 TCs pretty close together, and have the extra TCs cover chokepoints between forests. One TC should cover a Gold source, having a Stone source under a TC is nice if the map allows it, but not necessary. So priority is: 1st Wood > Gold > 2nd Wood > Stone. Other than these requirements keep the TCs as close together as possible and build your military production in the middle of them. -After the 3rd TC and Double Broadaxe are started, focus all your attention on building defensive Units (and Walls where they are efficient, i.e. <50 Wood for a full side to be covered). Do NOT be greedy any more than that and try to add on additional eco upgrades or build a Blacksmith. -VS Feudal Aggression: Once you can push back his army, get out the Daimyo Palace asap to boost your Farming to +50%. Then recheck his army and if he doesn't try to all-in you anymore go up to Castle Age and simply swarm him with Samurai while further Walling up your base. -VS Feudal Boom: Keep pumping out those triple Villagers and add on Daimyo Palace asap. This will give you such a massive boost in Food income that you will easily reach Castle Age first and can timing push him with a flood of Samurai.

Barracks,then Onna-Bugeisha
Barracks,then Onna-Bugeisha
Slowly upgrade the Onna-Bugeisha with Tatara Hizukuri Iron Undermesh,then Fitted Leatherwork
Match-up specific tips:
Abbasid Dynasty. Abbasid will likely boom on 2-3 TCs, so make sure your own 3TC booming is on point.
Ayyubids
Byzantines. They will either open Hippodrom into Horsemen pressure or Grand Winery into 2TC
China. Chinese will likely boom on 2-3 TCs, so make sure your own 3TC booming is on point.

Delhi Sultanate. Dehli will focus on Sacred Sites, so you need to have out units that can exert map control to combat this. Mobility is king here. So start out with the mobile all-purpose Onna-Bugeisha and add in Horseman if they add in too many Archers.

English. Longbows are even better against Onna-Bugeisha than Archers are and usually they will add Spears to protect their Longbows against Horseman. Build early Palisade Wall and Naginata Samurai to defend until you can outmass them.
French
Holy Roman Empire. Their Landsknechte are very dangerous for our preferred Melee Infantry mass style.
Japanese

Jeanne d'Arc. Using Spearman is decent defensively, but won't win you anything, especially after JD reaches her level 3 Cleave. Prioritize getting to Castle Age and mass Onna-Musha to hard counter JD and her Knights. Accompany them with Naginata Samurai or Mounted Samurai as a sturdy frontline. Always avoid fights if you can't snipe JD quickly to avoid her getting free XP. Once you have a lead, pressure as much as possible, so JD can't catch up and can't stockpile Cleave stacks.

Malians. Onna-Bugeisha + Horseman gives you a nice, highly mobile Feudal combo, that doesn't play into their arguably best unit, the Javelin Thrower. Their best bet is a combination of Donsos and Archers, maybe some Sofas too, but all of this loses hard to a spam of Castle Age Naginata Samurai Katana Bannerman. So defend with Onna-Bugeisha + Horseman while getting up to Castle Age, then add Barracks and Spam upgraded Naginata Samurai. Their Musofadi Warrior won't be enough if you're ahead on eco, since the first hit will get absorbed by Deflective Armor.
Mongols

Order of the Dragon. They will most likely open up with Horsemen and then add Archers. You need to build counter Units to them or build units that are generally good. Mass either Horseman or Naginata Samurai in Feudal Age. Horseman hard-counter their Archers and fights decently against their Horsemen. Their mobility gives you initiative on their Archers. Naginata Samurai are good because OOTD units have a higher attack, so their Deflective Armor mitigates more damage and they trade decently against both Archers and Horsemen. Their downside is no hard-countering and low mobility, so you should only use them as a defensive stepstone to a fast Castle Age. Go Castle Age via Temple of Equality to half the OOTD units' damage.
Ottomans

Rus. They will most likely build early Knights, so defensive Spearman are in order. Accompany them with Horseman to protect your Spears against Archers. You may also use the Horsemen to counterattack.
Zhu Xi's Legacy

title: New Player Guide to English
description: Very basic, no-frills English build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to build a balanced army in the Feudal Age and attack. This can be played on any land map against any civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games! There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build and attack: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Make more barracks and archery ranges for more units, get siege engineering from the blacksmith so you can make rams with your infantry, and keep your food villagers working by adding farms or putting them on deer or berries. 2. Go Castle Age! Put a few more villagers to gold and age up with the White Tower in a defensive location near or in your base. Once up, upgrade your existing units and create new units (which you can directly from the White Tower). Try Knights! Once you're feeling comfortable with this build, look for a more advanced and optimal build order. I recommend checking out a recent build order guide video from a pro player. Two good options are Beastyqt and Valdemar.

title: Early Aggro into 2TC
description: Inspired by Beasty's early aggro into 2TC french, I wanted to make something that could skip the archery range, and get a faster 2nd TC. description: This build order revolves around using the Imperial Hippodrome to train Horsemen alongside our Champions early to put pressure on the opponent's weak spots and gain map control. title: Beasty's 2TC Song Opening [S5] - copy
description: Very versatile. Check the video for extra tips regarding specifics like english counterplay, eco distribution, landmark and building placing, army comps etc.
author: raptorjesas
steps: Queue up IO Imperial Official and 2 vils. 6 starting villagers Villager chop wood Wood. Before vils drop wood, after IO is created, make a mill Mill (preferably next to berries), dont shift click the vils! IO Imperial Official supervises the mill while its being built so that the vils drop off wood immediately after they are done building and you get extra 20% from that wood. Gather food Food from sheep Sheep.
Next vil Villager builds a village Village next to the mill. Then gathers food Food.
Next vil Villager goes to straggler wood Wood, gathers only 3 and force drops off. Then he builds gold mine Mining Camp.
Next 2 vils Villager go to gold Gold, you want 3 vils mining gold total.
Next 3 vils Villager go to food Food. Remember to gather tax from mill once it gets to 40, then keep supervising mill.
Continue rallying Rally to food Food.

Either build Barbican Barbican of the Sun with 2 vils or Imp. Academy Imperial Academy with 3 vils. Use food vils. They return to food Food once they are done, or if you have already started the other landmark, go to wood.
Once you have 10 vils on food, rally Villager to straggler wood Wood. Keep rallying Rally to straggler wood Wood.
Build the second feudal landmark ( Imperial Academy or Barbican of the Sun ) with 4 vils from food. They go to wood Wood once they are done. You should leave 6 vils on food for now.
Once you have 160 gold Gold take all vils from gold to straggler wood Wood. Research wheelbarrow Wheelbarrow

Make second IO Imperial Official from Imp. Academy Imperial Academy. Once you have 14 vils Villager on wood Wood start rallying Rally to stone. Build a lumber camp Lumber Camp and supervise it with your IO Imperial Official. Use 4 wood vils to build eitther barracks Barracks or archery range Archery Range, they go mine stone Stone after they are done, supervise the stone mine too with the second IO Imperial Official.
Start producing up to 6-7 spearman/zhugenu Spearman Zhuge Nu. Remember to keep picking up tax constantly from all camps.

Make third IO Imperial Official. You can start making some small walls Palisade Wall with a single vil from wood Villager or a tower Outpost to protect resources/gain vision. Dont spend too much wood or second TC is gonna get delayed.
Build the second TC Town Center, use vils from stone.
Make the fourth IO Imperial Official. Three supervise each resource and one gathers tax. Reorganize your economy according to your game plan.

If you're going against an aggressive opponent: 15 vils on food Food, 15 on wood Wood, 6 on gold Gold, rally Rally both TCs to food Food and start producing a defensive army Spearman Zhuge Nu with its upgrades Blacksmith. Gradually prepare a farm Granary Farm transition. Eventually, when you have around 40 on food, you can start rallying to gold instead and you will "naturally" age up Castle Age. If opponent ages up, attack them and age up yourself.
If youre going against a passive opponent: Just age up to castle. Assign 6 vils Villager to gold Gold and move all but 6 vils from wood Wood to food Food.
If your opponent wasnt agressive, advance to castle with the Clocktower Astronomical Clocktower, use 8 vils to build it.

At this point start rallying Rally to gold Gold until you have 15 vils Villager on it and research imperial examinations Imperial Examinations because you will need a lot for unit and blacksmith upgrades Blacksmith, monks Monk and units. Create a stronger army Palace Guard Crossbowman with some nest of bees Nest of Bees and secure relics Monastery Relic if you can.

Stable Keep producing Keshik. Archery Range Keep producing Kipchak

We want to prolong Castle Age as much as possible to get our Stone related upgrades before saving up to Imperial Age. Edicts: Production Edict: Not very useful at this point since we can simply build more production buildings. Defensive Edict: Toggle it if you are fighting in range of a Fortified Outpost. Kharash Edict: Not worth at this point in the game. The +1 armor is barely noticeable against Imperial Age units. Stockyard Edict: The best by default. The extra Gold is very much needed for the army.
Research Ovoo Ceremony ASAP. Upgrade Keshik and Horseman if you already have a lot of them, otherwise skip that to get the other upgrades.

Production buildings: 1 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 3 Stables. Focus on producing Torguud and Handcannon Ashigaru, that will be the core of the army. Once you are at full population, spend Stone on upgrades (see next row).

Blacksmith: Biology,then Serpentine Powder,then Angled Surfaces,then Damascus Steel,then Master Smiths. With Stone: Ovoo Tithe,then Archery Range Reinforcements,then Stables Reinforcements,then Padded Armor,then Increased Supplies,then Steppe Lancers,then Glorious Charge

title: New Player Guide to Knights Templar
description: A very basic but uniquely KT build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to be aggressive in the Feudal Age with the Antioch age up and (predominantly) Sergeants on 1TC, both pilgrims and safe food. This build is intended to be viable on any land map against any civ (though some may need more Horsemen to counter Archers!) so you can get started with KT and then play around from there. There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Add more production be it for Sergeants or Horsemen and commit to your enemy's base. With Sergeants building damage, you shouldn't even need rams! 2. Go Castle Age! Thanks to a set-up food economy and pilgrim gold, we can go castle easily by just halting Sergeant production. Age up with Angevin Empire. Once up, upgrade your Sergeants/Horsemen and produce Heavy Spearmen to take the fight to your opponent. Once you're comfortable, you can look at adding in Dark Age aggression and/or trying different unit comps. There are plenty of KT guides out there to take inspiration from. Good luck!

title: Abbey of Kings Fast Castle → White Tower Timing by Swaggy Professor
description: Flexible Abbey of Kings Fast Castle into White Tower with adaptive Feudal defense. Early stone for Manor influence, optional pressure with Lords, and strong eco transition with Manors and Relics.
strategy: Abbey of Kings Fast Castle → White Tower Knight Pressure
author: Swaggy Professor
steps: Send **all villagers** to Sheep. Use Scout to circle base and find more sheep.
First **3 new villagers** build Mining Camp on Gold and a House near TC.
Next **3 villagers → Sheep ** (final 9 food / 3 gold). When resources allow, age up with using the **3 gold villagers**.
Send **2 food villagers → Stone ** and **4 → straggler trees**. Set TC Rally to Gold until 4 villagers there, then back to sheep.
After mining 100 Stone, send both stone vils → Wood. Once 175 Wood gathered, send the 4 straggler wood vils → Sheep.
After Feudal age-up: use 4 gold villagers to build Manor to influence Gold + Sheep (include Wood if close). Scout opponent’s base — if they’re passive, send Lord of Lancaster to harass exposed vils.
If facing early aggression, you can: - Place Manor beside Wood instead for Feudal defense. - Transition into military production buildings around it. - Defend with Lords or tower gold if needed.

Continue normal build if safe: maintain **7 gold / 2 wood / rest on food**. At ~6:20, start The White Tower with **8 food villagers** (send more if pressured). Place landmark near Gold or between gold + woodline.
While landmark builds, set TC Rally to Wood for remainder of game. Use 2–3 gold villagers to build 2 Stables nearby. Train 1 extra Lord of Lancaster from Abbey of Kings.
After aging up, eco layout: 10 food / 12 gold / 1 stone / rest wood. Start constant Knight production from stables.
If pressured: use spawned Men-at-Arms + Lords defensively. Otherwise, pressure with Knights + Lords to gain map control and relics.
Add Blacksmith + Monastery for relics and upgrades. Optional tech path: add Archery Range if enemy makes spears/crossbows.

If sheep run out → move to Berries or external food. Your 1 stone villager will have enough for another Manor → place near new food source to maintain influence on ≥10 vils. Always aim for 10+ vils under each manor for best passive bonus.

Keep producing units, complete eco upgrades, and build Farm clusters around manors. At this stage, your eco should be extremely strong with relics + manor passive income. You can close games with Knight/Lord pushes or safely go Imperial depending on map control.

title: Piqueros into Fast Castle
description: Apertura estándar por excelencia con Japoneses. Consiste en abrir con un cuartel temprano y producir 2 piqueros para denegar recursos vitales al rival (como el oro del Francés o las bayas del Bizantino) antes de transicionar rápidamente a un Fast Castle eficiente para dominar la partida con Samuráis Montados.
author: Alnitak
steps: 3 aldeanos iniciales a Food (ovejas). 2 aldeanos a Wood. El aldeano restante va a construir un Barracks inmediato. Manda tu explorador rápido a buscar el recurso clave del rival.
El aldeano que termina el Barracks construye una Farmhouse pegada a las bayas (para optimizar la recolección futura) y luego va a Food. Rally a Food.
Produce exactamente 2 Spearmen en cuanto termine el cuartel. Envíalos directamente a denegar el oro, las bayas o el recurso más expuesto de la base rival.
Mantén la recolección de Wood de tus 2 aldeanos hasta juntar exactamente 75 de madera en total. Esto cubrirá el coste del campamento minero y el Forge (Taguara).

Retira aldeanos de madera: deja solo 1 en Wood y mueve los otros a Gold para tener 3 en total. Desarrolla la mejora de Taguara en tu molino/bayas. Regresa el explorador a dejar ovejas en el Town Center.
Cuando el único aldeano de madera termine de talar su árbol individual, construye la segunda Farmhouse y muévelo a Food. Nos quedamos temporalmente con 0 en madera para priorizar el pase puro.
Al juntar 400 de comida y 200 de oro, inicia la transición: comienza a construir tu Kura Storehouse con sólo 2 aldeanos extraídos de Food.

Llegada a Feudal Age. Reubica inmediatamente los 2 constructores del hito y los nuevos aldeanos al oro hasta tener un total estable de 10 en Gold. Si tu rival no ejerce presión masiva en Feudal, no piques madera ni hagas torres defensivas.

Al acumular 1200 de comida y 600 de oro, inicia la transición: clava el hito Floating Gate con 8 aldeanos. Mueve inmediatamente 5 aldeanos de comida a talar los árboles sueltos que rodean tu Town Center (sin construir maderero) para conseguir 150 de madera rápidamente.

Remacro tras clickear el hito: manda 5 de los constructores a Gold (para un total de 12) y los otros 3 a Food (total 13). Con los 150 de madera de los árboles del TC, usa 3 o 4 aldeanos para construir un Stable inmediato. Rally general a Wood.

Llegada a Castle Age. Transición completa. Introduce tu primer Yorishiro de la Puerta Flotante en el Stable y arranca la producción constante de Samuráis Montados. Investiga inmediatamente la mejora Tatara (el +1 de daño de melé permite que tus caballeros maten aldeanos de solo dos golpes).

Construye una Archery Range y deposita allí tu segundo Yorishiro para spamear arqueros de forma masiva. Desarrolla el Portaestandarte de la Arquería. Manda a tus monjes a asegurar las Relic sueltas por el mapa, investiga la Carretilla 2 y ahoga económicamente al rival combinando caballería pesada y rango.

Make third IO Imperial Official. You can start making some small walls Palisade Wall with a single vil from wood Villager or a tower Outpost to protect resources/gain vision. Dont spend too much wood or second TC is gonna get delayed.
Build the second TC Town Center, use vils from stone.
Make the fourth IO Imperial Official. Three supervise each resource and one gathers tax. Reorganize your economy according to your game plan.

If you're going against an aggressive opponent: 15 vils on food Food, 15 on wood Wood, 6 on gold Gold, rally Rally both TCs to food Food and start producing a defensive army Spearman Zhuge Nu with its upgrades Blacksmith. If youre going against a passive opponent: Just age up to castle. Assign 6 vils Villager to gold Gold and move all but 6 vils from wood Wood to food Food.
If your opponent wasnt agressive, advance to castle with the Clocktower Astronomical Clocktower, use 8 vils to build it.

At this point start rallying Rally to gold Gold until you have 15 vils Villager on it and research imperial examinations Imperial Examinations because you will need a lot for unit and blacksmith upgrades Blacksmith, monks Monk and units. title: Tughlaq Fort Rush DONE RIGHT | Swaggy Professor
description: Forward Fort (Amir Warriors) with early Spear pressure into nonstop Archers and Healer Elephants. Use worker elephant drop-offs to mobilize eco and choke enemy resources.
author: Swaggy Professor
steps: 5 Villagers to straggler Wood, 1 to Sheep; TC Rally to Sheep. Starting worker elephant scouts around your Gold, then returns to it (acts as a drop-off). Scout heads toward enemy base to find exposed Gold or Berries
As soon as first 50 Wood is dropped: 1 wood vil builds Barracks, another builds House (simultaneously). Both builders go to Sheep after finishing.
Queue 2 Spearmen immediately and send them straight to opponent. The 3 remaining wood vils finish the straggler tree, then move to Gold where the worker elephant should be waiting with 1–2 Sheep
When you’ve gathered 100 Gold, send those 3 gold vils + the worker elephant to Stone to start banking for the Fort. Keep TC Rally on Food to finish Feudal resources.
Place Dome of the Faith with 3 Villagers. Transfer EVERY vil to Stone except 4 on Food. You should also have enough wood for another House with one of the 4 food vils.

Click the stone outcropping and track remaining stone. Once it goes a bit below ~800, force drop all stone into the worker elephant. Send your stone vils toward the enemy base to prep the forward Fort. Keep your 2 Spearmen causing idle time and guarding the Fort location.

Feudal completes: immediately start building the Tughluqabad Fort near enemy TC—close enough to choke gold/wood, but not in TC fire range so spears can protect vs torch. Select the Amir Warrior commander. Amir Warriors lose stats outside Fort attack range—place the Fort to cover enemy sheep/gold without losing too many stats.

Back home: landmark builders go to Sheep for a total of ~7 on food. Keep TC Rally on a straggler Wood to get 50 wood for a new worker elephant to station 4–5 vils on Gold (funds Healer Elephants + upgrades).
Rally Amir Warrior from the Fort into enemy food; try to kill sheep under TC and torch key buildings (e.g., House ). Drop 1–2 Archery Ranges as wood allows; start nonstop Archer production.
Queue first Healer Elephant to the Fort ASAP; when it arrives, actively hunt where the enemy moved their vils. Use leftover Spearman and home Barracks to defend vs enemy horsemen raids.

Upon second Healer Elephant arrival, start brief TC dives to force idle/kill vils; the pair can keep your army topped off while diving. Continue building House in a 4x4 grid (prep for later Food Fort).

Choke the map: take outer Berries and Deer. Keep massing. Archer + Healer Elephant. When you reach ~4 Healer Elephants and core techs, move many vils to Stone to set up a second Tughluqabad Fort at home and assign the Food commander (≈240 Food /min).

description: Esta build order, que es una adaptación al español de la "English Drush Into Heavy Feudal" creada por Valdemar1902, intensifica la agresividad de los ingleses aplicando una presión inmediata. Inicia con un Hombre de Armas en la Edad Oscura y continúa con Arqueros de Largo Alcance en la Edad Feudal. El propósito es conformar una fuerza de aproximadamente 35 unidades militares para el minuto 10. Si no alcanzas al menos 30 unidades en este tiempo, es recomendable practicar nuevamente la build order La gestión macroeconómica juega un papel crucial; la eficacia de esta estrategia radica en evitar el estancamiento por la creación de granjas, optando en su lugar por explotar la ventaja militar para ejercer presión sobre el adversario.

Construir House
Mover 2 Villagers de Gold a Wood y con 1 Villager construir Mill en Berries
Instantáneamente entrenar Spearman Longbowman y seguir entrenando
Investigar Wheelbarrow
Construir House

POST BUILD ORDER: Enfócate en tener cerca de 35 unidades militares en el minuto 10, Practica la build order de nuevo si no reúnes al menos 30 unidades militares. ¡El macro es altamente importante! Cerca del minuto 8-10 es cuando agregas nuevamente 3 Villagers en Gold para tener más mejoras. Dependiendo de cuantas Sheep reúnas, puedes mover más Villager a Berries. intenta no agregar Farm antes del min 8-9 para que puedas crear un ejército mayor y ejercer una mayor presión al oponente. Gestiona sabiamente tu macro, debes enfocarte primero en Wood y agregar Farm con Villager de Wood de forma continua hasta tener 3 sets de Farm. cuando tengas 3 es cuando podrás subir a Castle Age (no será necesario si terminas el juego en Feudal Age ). Cuando subas a Castle Age, SIEMPRE debes ir por King's Palace si vas por The White Tower probablemente ya perdiste el juego, recuerda gestionar tu macro en Gold para investigar mejoras militares y económicas. estarás en Castle Age por un tiempo.
