title: Pro Scout > FC > Horse Archers > Knights
description: This build relies on deer and relics. This has the advantage of very quickly overwhelming the enemy into a turtle by an FC aggression. No infantry units were produced so mobility is a huge advantage. Designed to work against civs that flow through turtle/boom->agression->boom since this builds flows through boom->agression->boom Beats: - HOL
author: piperunner
steps: Using the Golden Gate to get to pro scouts ASAP

- 2 vils make 2 hunting cabins simultaneously, then they return to F. - Wood vils will only do one round of gathering and then they will go on F. - To remember this, you will have one round of wood as soon as your 7th vil is produced. - The TC rally point will be on the chopped tree. - We make 1 scout from the first hunting cabin.
- 7th vil gathers one round of Wand makes a house then goes back on F.
- 1 vil will be in the queue and age 2 will be available by this time
The idea is to bank 100F to sell and get 150G from Golden Gate. 8 on W give us enough wood to get pro scouts.
- Age up with 4. We want to get to 8W vils and then rest go on F.
- Houses will be build using wood vils.
- The rest of the vils go on F. Age up will finish by 4.25.
- Instantly sell 100F. You just need 100F, so extra food should be used to make scouts. - Age up vils go to F. - Idle scouts can be used to burn enemy mils/houses.
- Build one wooden fortress on the woodline. Keep queuing scouts.
- 7 to 9 scouts will be needed. - If the enemy is being aggressive, pick your 2 packs first. If not, pick 1 of yours and 1 from his side.
- Walls, houses etc must always be built using the W vils since, gathering F from deer also gives us G. So using F vil will hurt eco x2.
- Age up with 8 vils and now remacro to W. We need exactly 15 on W. - The new vils go to F. - We get a wheelbarrow. - We get double broad axe
- We start making 3 archery ranges. Use F vils for this.
- Age up vils go to food. - At this point the macro is 50-50 on F and W. New vils go to food. - Make a few (6 horse archers), bank a little bit of W to make a monastery. - Get Forestery
- Use previously made scouts for tanking and horse archers to harass.
- Constant horse archers from 4 archery range will need 50-50 eco on F and W. - Prioritize picking up relics.

- Slightly shift toward a food prioritized eco. - Put down 3 stables. We will move into a knight comp. - Get knight veterancy upgrade. - Get horticulture upgrade. - Get +1 range attack, +1 range defence. - All this should be done while harassing and trying to do eco damage to the enemy.
- Start getting gold now since we want to make knights. - This has to be done while forcing the opponent to stay in their base and defend against your raids.
- Buy S for 2nd TC, use G vils to make TC. Send them back to G.
- Farm transition starts. Use W vils to add farms. - 8G vils will be constant, new vils go to W, and we keep adding farms. - We stick to horse archers and knights.
- The macro proportion will be 3:2:1 for F:W:G. Slightly leaning towards F.
- The unit comp is very food heavy so roughly around 20-minute mark,40+ vils should be on F, half on them on W, about 10 on G and 8 on S for a keep drop for map control.

steps: 5 Villagers,then Wood. 1 Villager builds Mill,then House,then Berries. First Villager builds Mosque,then Berries

Mosque cancel Piety and make 1 Scholar
1 Wood Villager,then Build Barracks
Make 2 Spearmen
Army composition: Ghazi Raider to raid. Spearman vs Lancer. Archer vs Spearman and Archer

Queue UPGRADES: Double Broadax, Professional Scouts, Survival Techniques, Horticulture, Specialized Pick. Tower of Victory: Iron Undermesh,then Steeled Arrow,then Bloomery,then Fitted Leatherwork,then Siege Engineering
Make Scholar at Mosque and queue Sanctity, Piety and All-Seeing Eye
1 Gold Villager,then Build Stable
Research Spearman Feudal Age while you spend Food on Ghazi Raider
1 Gold Villager,then Build Archery Range
Two options:

---------------------------------------- Feudal Age aggro -------------------------------------------. Rally,then Wood (16). Put 1 Scholar inside Archery Range once you start floating Wood and mass a big ball of Archer. Make enough Spearman to defend the Archer and spend the rest of the Food on Ghazi Raider. If you want to all-in, change Tower of Victory upgrade order to: Iron Undermesh,then Steeled Arrow,then Siege Engineering,then Bloomery,then Fitted Leatherwork. So you can start making Battering Ram early.

----------------------------------------- Fast Castle Age --------------------------------------------. Rally,then Gold (8). Make only units if necessary to defend. Build Palisade Wall with Spearman and Archer while Ghazi Raider raid enemy economy. Move 3 Wood Villager to Gold if you are not making Archer

Move Scholar to Sacred Site a few seconds before Sanctity finishes. If a Sacred Site is not safe, scort the Scholar with your army. Never risk loosing Scholar, they are very expensive without Dome of the Faith
After Sanctity is researched, spend Gold on Scholar (at least 5 before Castle Age )
Stable make Scout to grab Deer once Professional Scouts finishes
If you are forced to stay in Feudal Age for too long, train additional Scholar so you don't float over 600 Gold, or trade it for Food at a Market for a faster Castle Age.
Build small Palisade Wall around Relic to deny them from opponents playing for Fast Castle.
Make sure to have at least 2 of each Barracks Archery Range Stable by the time you age up to start producing Man-at-Arms + Crossbowman + Lancer at the same time that you get upgrades.
8 Food Villager and 4 Gold Villager,then Castle Age

House of Learning: Better in most situations. Good for scaling both the army and the economy. Compound of the Defender: Good in match-ups where you want to play defensive and boom your economy as soon as possible, extending Castle Age until you can safely go to Imperial Age
Move 2 Gold Villager to Food per Sacred Site captured.
Build Blacksmith
Train additional Scholar. At least 5 before Castle Age, but never going below 200 Gold, you will need it for units. Build second Mosque
Put 1 Scholar inside Stable right before landmark is completed
Ideal army composition: Man-at-Arms + Crossbowman. Add Ghazi Raider vs Crossbowman. Add Spearman vs Horseman and Lancer. Make a handful of Lancer to raid.
Stable with Scholar make Lancer nonstop.

Research: House of Learning: Honed Blades Hearty Rations Paiks Tranquil Venue Reinforced Foundations Mahouts. Compound of the Defender: Village Fortresses Boiling Oil Court Architects Slow-Burning Defenses. Mill, Lumber Camp, Mining Camp: Fertilization Lumber Preservation Acid Distillation. Mosque: Swiftness Herbal Medicine. Blacksmith: Balanced Projectiles Wedge Rivets Decarbonization Insulated Helm Military Academy Forced March

If you have enough economy, make Crossbowman and Man-at-Arms depending on the enemy army. Research Spearman, Archer and Ghazi Raider Castle Age upgrade with the second Barracks / Archery Range / Stable

Depending on how defensive the enemies are playing: Build Keep in your base to defend against raids. OR. Build Keep to protect key resources in the middle of the map. * Compound of the Defender: Build Stone Wall with infantry to protect your base. 3 Keeps is a good amount to stop gathering Stone. After that move Stone Villager,then Wood for Farm
See to the left. Ideal economy should look like this
Production buildings: 2 Barracks; 2 Archery Ranges; 2 Stables; 1 Siege Workshop
After technologies are done, garrison Scholar inside military buildings or move them out to heal units after fights.
Delay Farm transition as much as possible, gather from Berries and Deer instead.
We are making Hisar Academy for the final infantry army composition

Hisar Academy: for faster tempo (faster late game upgrades) and better food economy. Allows you to liberate population space for a bigger army while keeping high production of Man-at-Arms and Ghazi Raider. Palace of the Sultan: produces Sultan's Elite Tower Elephant, which are very strong, but not quite as strong as Handcannon Ashigaru with Tower of Victory
Make Scholar up to 20, but don't build more than 3 Mosques, the other will garrison on Hisar Academy.

Ideal army composition: Man-at-Arms + Handcannon Ashigaru + Ghazi Raider. Add Spearman / War Elephant vs Lancer. Add Mangonel vs big masses of Crossbowman / Handcannon Ashigaru. Although Ghazi Raider should be enough to deal with them.

Garrison Scholar inside Hisar Academy / Madrasa. Research: Hisar Academy / Madrasa: Elite Army Tactics Biology Serpentine Powder Siege Works Chemistry Court Architects Incendiary Arrows Silk Bowstrings. Don't forget about Mosque: Zeal Tithe Barns. Research all upgrades, both economic and military, even the ones from Dock if the map has water.
Build 1 Madrasa to speed up upgrades.

After unit upgrades, economic technologies, Elite Army Tactics and Biology are completed: Garrison a few Scholar inside military buildings. With this army composition, Scholar healing is not as important as if we were playing with elephants.
Build Palisade Wall / Stone Wall with your units as you push into the opponent's side of the map to protect reinforcements and control resources.
See to the left. Ideal economy should look like this
Production buildings: 10 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 10 Stables; 1 Siege Workshop

如果对面不打架，那你就直城，将六个农民 Villager 分配给黄金 Gold ，留下六个以外的所有伐木 Wood 的去吃肉 Food

Istanbul Imperial Palace: Is only better in maps where trade is viable or with the 2TC Vizier Point path. description: This guide presents what I consider a standard, tempo-focused build that allows you to raid your opponent very early by rushing two keshik and then transitioning smoothly into any follow-up strategy of your choosing. Really good in team games, especially on open maps, to counter knight civilizations by forcing them to play defensively instead of raiding your teammates. Check my other Mongol guides: - Dark Age horsemen aggro: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/ArOoVjCnfTLGeyonunH4 - 2TC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/6OjgNkyo1mxMzgSiJQBo

steps: While aging up, scout what the opponent is doing with Khan

The Silver Tree,then In very closed maps like Black Forest or Mountain Pass. Not the purpose of this guide and, loosing the ability to produce Khan’s Hunter is really bad in the long term.
1 Wood Villager,then Build Stable
Pack Stable and unpack it on Ovoo
Army composition: Raiding: Keshik + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter. All-in: Archer + Keshik + Khan’s Hunter + Battering Ram. Defending (2TC/Trade): Spearman + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter
Stable,then 2x Keshiks
Rally,then Wood (5)

Build Archery Range with 1 Wood Villager and move it inside Ovoo area of influence. OR --- vs French Jeanne d'Arc Byzantines ( Imperial Hippodrome ) Knights Templar Delhi Sultanate Mongols ---. Build,then Barracks (and later Archery Range )
Rally,then Gold (7)
Rally,then Food (15)
Produce Mangudai + Keshik to raid and Spearman to defend against cavalry.
Choose a follow-up:

--------------------------------------------- All-in ------------------------------------------------. If the closest opponent to your base built additional Town Center. Rally,then Wood (20). Research Double Broadax, Steeled Arrow, Iron Undermesh and Siege Engineering (in that order). Afterwards, move 3 Gold Villager to Food. If enemy is making Knight, build Barracks and make some Spearman. If you are floating Wood, add second Archery Range for more Archer. Army: Archer + Keshik + Khan’s Hunter + Battering Ram. Use Stone to double produce Keshik. [Optional] Right before attacking with Battering Ram, research Raid Bounty.

---------------------------------------- Economic (trade): ----------------------------------------. Rally,then Wood (15). Research Double Broadax, Steeled Arrow and Iron Undermesh. Build Barracks and produce Spearman and Mangudai to defend while you keep raiding with Keshik and Mangudai. Build 2 Markets and Outpost all over the trade route. Keep distracting the opponents with your cavalry army while you invest on Venetian Trader. 15 Venetian Traders is a good amount to stop at until your team has completely secured the trade route with Stone Wall. Try to keep a decently sized army but prioritize going Castle Age, otherwise Castle Age Knight and Man-at-Arms can just permanently dive your Town Center and kill all your Villager and Venetian Trader.

---------------------------------------- Economic (2TC): ------------------------------------------. Rally,then Wood (15). Research Double Broadax, Steeled Arrow and Iron Undermesh. Build Barracks and produce Spearman and Mangudai to defend while you keep raiding with Keshik and Mangudai. Build 2nd Town Center with 12 Wood Villager and then Rally to Food and Gold. Keep distracting the opponents with your cavalry army while you invest on economy. Build Outpost to buff and protect your Villager. Try to keep a decently sized army but prioritize going Castle Age, otherwise Castle Age Knight and Man-at-Arms can just permanently dive your Town Center and Outpost and idle your entire economy.

After you finish gathering from Sheep, move 10 Villagers to Deer, build and Outpost near them and research Survival Techniques. If you want extra safety, build an additional Outpost to have enough space to garrison all of them.
Remember to research Superior Mobility at some point to be able to reposition Deer Stones faster.

Build Ger and put it on Ovoo to research improved versions of economic upgrades. Prioritize Forestry,then Double Broadax,then Horticulture,then Specialized Pick,then Wheelbarrow. Don't research improved Specialized Pick if you have Venetian Trader

Kurultai: As a follow-up to a failed Feudal Age all-in, to defend against Castle Age all-ins or if trade is viable (good map control, allies are walling...). Steppe Redoubt: For Fast Imperial when trade is not viable (your team has no map control, your team is not walling, the enemies are making a lot of cavalry...).
Army composition: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Crossbowman + Khan’s Hunter + Mangonel

Change to an infantry based army with Spearman and Crossbowman, adding Man-at-Arms for extra tankiness on the frontline and Mangonel to kill big masses of Archer and Crossbowman. Both Mangudai and Keshik are terrible against Castle Age Knight, making basically every matchup unwinnable with them.

Start adding Pasture with 3 Villagers at a time and sending them to gather Sheep. Build them near your main Town Center leaving a 4x5 space in the center to fit a Prayer Tent which will buff their production speed thanks to Monastic Shrines. Build a total of 16 Pastures and place them in Ovoo / Prayer Tent / The White Stupa area of influence. That's enough to sustain 40 Villagers with all Horticulture upgrades (the improved one too).

Research: Ovoo: Whistling Arrows and, if you are going to push enemy base, Raid Bounty. Ger: Fertilization and Lumber Preservation. If you don't have Venetian Trader, also research Shaft Mining. Don't forget about relevant Blacksmith upgrades.
Castle Age is the right moment to research the improved versions of economic upgrades.
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production balance: 3 Barracks; 3 Archery Ranges; 1 Stable
Build Outpost around your resources (specially the Pasture ).

*Team games tip: When saving up to reach Imperial Age, move your buildings into your allies’ base and place the landmark in the safest spot. You’re already pausing production to save resources, so this won’t slow you down (much), and your Food Villager should have enough Sheep to get to 2400.

Khaganate Palace: If you didn't invest on economy (no trade or 2nd Town Center ) but still want to reach Imperial Age quickly, this landmark can help you in the early phases to repopulate your army and survive while you get key upgrades for your units. The White Stupa: Allows getting the improved versions of upgrades and Cannon Emplacement on your Outpost sooner. If you have high Venetian Trader count, it's not necessary.
Build 2nd Blacksmith inside Ovoo / Prayer Tent / The White Stupa area of influence.

Now it's the time to think about what late-game army composition you want to streamline which Imperial Age upgrades you will get: - Infantry: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Handcannon Ashigaru + Khan’s Hunter + Mangonel + Bombard. - Cavalry: Horseman / Keshik + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter
Army composition: - Infantry: Spearman + Man-at-Arms + Handcannon Ashigaru + Khan’s Hunter + Mangonel + Bombard. - Cavalry: Horseman / Keshik + Mangudai + Khan’s Hunter
Research elite upgrades for your units as soon as you age up. If you have Venetian Trader, also research Stone Commerce.

Blacksmith upgrades depending on army composition: - Infantry: Elite Army Tactics (regular),then Serpentine Powder,then Siege Works,then Chemistry. Also research on Siege Workshop: Adjustable Crossbars + Greased Axles. - Cavalry: Siha Bow Limbs (improved),then Incendiary Arrows,then Platecutter Point,then Silk Bowstrings,then Biology
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this: If possible, substitute Gold Villager for Venetian Trader
Production balance: (Infantry). 10 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 2 Siege Workshops. (Cavalry). 5 Archery Ranges; 10 Stables

Save up Stone for improved versions of: - Infantry: Elite Army Tactics,then Greased Axles,then Siege Works. - Cavalry: Siha Bow Limbs,then Biology,then Steppe Lancers. Remember to eventually research *Pax Mongolica* and Court Architects. If you have Venetian Trader, prioritize Stone Commerce after Elite Army Tactics / Biology. Other improved upgrades that are worth getting are: Military Academy, Whistling Arrows, Stone Bounty, Raid Bounty, Textiles, Tithe Barns (if you have Relic ). Also, upgrade your Outpost with Cannon Emplacement (starting by the ones in your base).

title: Ayyubids 1TC Desert Raider Rush
description: This time I came up with the build myself and I am very proud of it, it works very well On plat3+ this may not work due to the fact that the opponent will know how to counter Raiders and will start producing mass archers earlier, they are cheaper so he will have too many Archers and then you have to back off, Age up and Ghulam rush with rams It also doesn't work vs mass Zhuge Nu (this two games was painful) idk what to do vs them maybe Manjaniq/Ghulam/Lancer rush Fuedal Age up start 2:25, finish 4:15 in the 10th minute you produced at least 20 Desert Raiders in the 12th minute you produced 30 Desert Raiders (you'll lose a few in the fight) Castle Age up start 15:40, finish 16:43 I produced 55 Raiders This build requires a lot of micro with Raiders You need to kite melee units with bows and kill the cavalry with swords if they are alone without spearmen and archers otherwise also kite with bows Your scout is supposted to locate exposed resources and gives vision If you cover everything around TC ( focus on gold) enemy should just surrender if not you will be in Age III when the opponent is in Age II IN MY CASE the opponents just give up because they lose a lot of villagers and have no gold, sometimes I have to start producing a couple of spearmen to make 3/4 rams In my opinion, the best wing order is this: 1. 1TC Camel Raider Rush Master Smiths -> Advancement -> Advisors 1. Fast Castle into mass army Ghulam/Lancers In this build make only like 2-5 Horseman/Desert Raiders Growth/Master Smiths -> Advancement -> Advisors (if you didn't win in castle) The goal is to enter age 3 produce army and win as soon as possible, so Growth will be better choice overtime 3 vills gather between 102-124res/min BUT Master Smiths gives upgrades that Raiders use becauase they are melee and ranges and saves us 4min (if one blacksmith), 500gold, 100 food and 100 wood. 3 vills from Growth need 6-7 mins to gather that resources then 4 min to research them Advancement saves us 350 food and 150 gold. So we have 450 food, 100 wood and 650 gold more. 2. Late game full potencial (best in LONG team games not 1v1) Master Smiths -> Growth -> Advisors -> Logistics (if game is long enough) Master Smith just because there is nothing more to choose. Growth gives us 8 vills that will speed up age IV Advisors 7 Atabeg gives 20% more HP (stacks with Biology very well) so lancers have 343 HP instead of 294 Logistics gives Dervish (monks) aoe heal and 50% more heal

Next 150 Wood build Blacksmith and queue up all techs

If getting heavily attacked make 1x Military building that counters your opponent. (I'm looking at you English + French mains). Barracks If attacked by = Royal Knight. Stable vs Longbowman Man-at-Arms Zhuge Nu. Archery Range vs Just don't, they cost a lot of Wood and will force you to stay in Feudal.

The Castle should be placed in your base if getting heavily attacked or on outer recourses if possible (Best spot is next to Stone and any other resource to keep making Castle ). ( remember to keep making Scholar because we want 20x on age 4)

Here is where the fun begins (Remember to queue up all economic techs ASAP). If enemy is passive take 5x Scholars and rush to get all Relic ASAP, if not you can do that later after building an army. Split 8x Gold 8x Wood 8x Stone and rest on Food
By this point you should have 1x Barracks 1x Archery Range 1x Siege Workshop with 1x Scholar on each.

Army Comp Section. ONLY take fights under Outpost or Castle. Man-at-Arms + Spearman if VS Royal Knight. Man-at-Arms + Crossbowman if VS Man-at-Arms Onna-Bugeisha. Mainly focus on Man-at-Arms and add a bit of Spearman / Crossbowman if needed because MAA are better defending under Outpost + Castle. 2-3 Mangonels Only if enemy is pushing with a lot of infantry. 2-3 Springalds Only if enemy is pushing with Siege of its own. If possible try to avoid making Siege because we want to get to Age 4 ASAP.
Age 4 with 10x Villagers,then Hisar Academy and place all of your Scholar inside, our goal is 20x. (Remember to queue up all economic techs ASAP)

At this point I cant continue because you have to adapt to the game that you are in but keep making Scholar to heal troops and if you want place 5x on Dome of the Faith for giga fast upgrades since the more upgrades you have the more Food you will generate from Hisar Academy.

title: French | Chamber of Commerce
description: Greedy opener with lots of economic upgrades and Chamber of Comerce landmark. Optimized to start knight production as soon as possible. With tips for both 1v1 and team games.
author: Jockxtar
steps: 6 Villagers,then Sheep. Scout around base searching for Deer
First Villager,then Build House,then Sheep

As soon as you find the Deer, move 5 Sheep Villager to Deer. Build the Mill first and research Survival Techniques and Wheelbarrow. Pull the Deer close to the Mill with the Scout before sending him to scout the map.
Rally,then Sheep (2 more; total of 9 on Food )
Rally,then Straggler Tree (9)
3 Gold Villager and 2 Sheep Villager,then Build Chamber of Commerce (they go back to the same resource). 2 Sheep Villager,then Straggler Tree
1 Straggler Tree Villager,then Build Lumber Camp and research Forestry. Change Rally to main Wood
1 Straggler Tree Villager,then Build House
The initial position of Chamber of Commerce doesn't matter, place it between Sheep and Gold for a faster age up. Rally Chamber of Commerce to a neutral Market
3 Build Villager,then Gold and 2 Build Villager,then Sheep
Research Double Broadax
Rally,then Sheep (14)
4 Wood Villager,then Build Stable
Produce Royal Knight nonstop
Build Outpost on Deer. If you scout enemy cavalry going to your base, build it fast with all 5 Villagers

Don't forget to Build House when needed. Build second Stable. Then Build a Market in a corner of the map (reroute Venetian Trader once finished). Spend Wood on Palisade Wall and economic upgrades ( Specialized Pick and Horticulture ). Build Blacksmith to research Iron Undermesh. And, finally, start producing Venetian Trader

Rally to Wood and Gold, if you need more Food for production or to go Castle Age, switch a few Venetian Trader to Food, but don't put more than 14 Villagers or you will run out of Sheep and Deer too quickly.

1v1 tips: Never do this build order against civs that play aggressive in Dark Age like Mongols or against Feudal Age Royal Knight civs like French, Jeanne d'Arc, Golden Horde, Rus. Aggression from any other civilization should be relatively easy to deal with as long as you position your army correctly to protect your Venetian Trader. Horseman can be annoying to deal with, but a few Palisade Wall should be enough to build time for your Royal Knight to close the gap. Against 2TC strategies, focus on producing Venetian Trader instead of army so you don't fall behind economically. Make just enough Royal Knight to force your opponent to play defensively. Against FC strategies, make just enough Royal Knight to threaten your opponent and try to reach Castle Age quickly as well. Team game tips: If the enemy team has Mongols, never do this build order. If the enemy team has Feudal Age Royal Knight civs ( French Jeanne d'Arc Golden Horde Rus ) use your Royal Knight defensively until you outnumber your opponent, which should happen at around minute 9 and then split a few Royal Knight to raid while keeping the rest defending. If the enemy team attacks your Venetian Trader with Horseman, the only possible way to defend is to build Palisade Wall early.
Royal Institute is the best choice since we are already booming our economy with Venetian Trader. Researching Merchant Guilds early will give us an even bigger boost than Guild Hall will ever do.
Mine Stone while aging up to quickly build Keep in the middle of your Stable

Royal Institute order: Merchant Guilds,then Royal Bloodlines,then Enlistment Incentives,then Cantled Saddles. Prioritize upgrading your Royal Knight (and Archer in 1v1). Also research economic upgrades and Wedge Rivets (and Balanced Projectiles in 1v1)

description: Very basic, no-frills HRE build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to build a balanced army (1-1-1) in the Feudal Age and attack. This can be played on any land map against any civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games! There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Add more production, make MAA, and get siege engineering from the Meinwerk so you can make rams with your infantry, and keep your food villagers working by adding farms or putting them on deer or berries. 2. Go Castle Age! Put a few more villagers to gold and age up with the Burgrave Palace. Once up, upgrade your existing units and overwhelm your opponent with super-upgraded MAA (+2 ranged armour, Two-Handed Weapons, Heavy Maces and +50% charge damage from the Burgrave itself!) Once you're feeling comfortable with this build, look for more advanced and optimal build orders. HRE are very versatile and can be played pretty much every way, particularly having a very strong Fast Castle. Try Aachen Chapel and/or Regnitz Cathedral landmarks - they're a bit harder to use but very strong and a lot of fun. I recommend checking out a recent build order guide video from a pro player. Two good options are Beastyqt and Valdemar.

You can dog-fight a long Feudal Age, which if you survive the start (you can build a few Outpost too) you should be ahead and win. If you lose map control just pull more villagers on Gold to support commandary units production and upgrades. If the opponent is passive and booms himself, you can produce just a few Chevalier Confrere for map control and poking and then rush Castle Age for Relic and upgrades. Or if the opponent rushes Castle Age, then make sure you get some army before aging up yourself, possibly harassing his Gold and above all else contesting the Relic. Make Chevalier Confrere + Spearman against Knights; Serjeant against infantry comps; Hospitaller Knight + Archer against archer comps; OR Chevalier Confrere + Archer META. steps: Cistern placement isn't super important as your 2nd cistern will cover the rest of the resources. Rally Order: Dark: Food: 7. Gold: 3. As I Build Winery: Wood: 9. Feudal: Food: 14. Castle: Gold: 10-15. Food: 20+. End Game: (Alternate Rally = Gold / Food )
5 Villagers on Sheep ( Rally Villager until 7 on Sheep ). 1 Villager build Cistern to cover Gold Berries Sheep (if possible). and 1 House as well. Move builder to Gold and build Mining Camp.
Rally Villager until 3 on Gold then Rally Sheep until Feudal Age
Drop off resources and build Grand Winery with 5 Sheep Villager on the Berries.
Rally Wood and create Lumber Camp until 9 Villagers (after 9 on rally Food )

Be very active with your javelin throwers against passive or Fast Castle players as they are fast and have good ranged armor. You can also tower your Olive Grove around the Grand Winery for safety, although, you can wait with the upgrades until you get mangonel emplacement in castle.
Research Double Broadax (Lumber) + Wheelbarrow (Mill/Winery). Build a 2nd Cistern and Aqueduct connect. Build a House
Barracks then Mercenary House with Silk Road Mercenary Contract (Merc House). Rally all military units (F1 then Right Click)
Horticulture (Winery) + Forestry (Lumber Camp)
Start making Olive Grove. Continue making these until 8+ or more depending on how long the feudal age is. (I aim to have 10 farms by min 9)
Build Blacksmith
2 Monks + all the veterancies and eco upgrades + Varangian Guard etc. Research ASAP: Veteran Contract (Merc House) + Iron Undermesh (Blacksmith) + Steeled Arrow (Blacksmith)
Age up with Golden Horn Tower and get 3rd Cistern when 150 Stone. Rally on Gold until 10-15
Age up with Palatine School if needed.

Around this time my macro is very food and gold heavy to produce Javelin Thrower, Varangian Guard and Crossbowman. Your macro might be different to what your game requires, so disconnect from the build order here. You are playing the relic phase in castle, then you decide on 1tc full aggro or 2tc long game.

Have Fun!

Queue 4 Spearmen in total
First Spearman is out and you can start harassing Gold and Deer
Start gathering Gold for Feudal Age
Build Lancaster Castle / Abbey of Kings with 3 Villagers

title: Lancaster Spear Rush → Manors → Hobelar Power Spike
description: Spearman rush into fast Manors; Castle power spike with Hobelars (Hill Training).
author: Swaggy Professor
steps: 3 Villagers to Sheep, 2 to straggler Wood, 1 designated builder (Barracks → House). Set TC Rally to Sheep until 6 on food. Scout scouts back of base first (find closest Deer ), then toward enemy
When builder finishes House (after wood is available), move him to stragglers (now 2 on wood → 3). Rally stays on Sheep until 6 on food
As wood reaches 150, place Barracks with the builder villager. After 50 more wood, place another House with a wood villager
Queue 3 Spearmen with no idle time (force-drop sheep if needed)
Rally to Wood until 5 total on stragglers. When first straggler tree is chopped, send 3 from wood to build Mining Camp on Gold (2 wood / 3 gold)
Switch rally back to Sheep until 10 on food. Keep Spearman pushing remaining deer toward TC as needed
Start aging with Lancaster Castle using 3 gold villagers. As construction begins: send 4 from food to Stone and 3 more to Wood. Keep TC rally on Wood until 12 on wood

Feudal completes. Immediately start building Manor with your gold villagers. Use spears aggressively now: deny enemy Deer (vs Pro Scouts), Gold (vs Fast Castle), or defend your own vs heavy knight civs
After mining 300 Stone, move those villagers to Gold. After chopping 600 Wood, move ALL wood villagers to Food
Set TC Rally to Gold until you reach 10 miners total, then switch back to Food

Just before 8:00, take 10 food villagers to build King's College. Send +4 more villagers to Gold (14 total on gold). Rally to Wood and place Stable with a food villager. Queue Veteran Demilancer as soon as you can afford it (harass Pro Scouts/gold/exposed vils; do not dive TC/towers)
Castle completes: queue Veteran Hobelar Upgrade and drop Monastery. Research Hill Training from King's College (Hobelar train time → 8s, powerful charge)
Queue Double Broadax and Specialized Pick upgrades; place Mill → Wheelbarrow. Add a 2nd Stable; produce Hobelar nonstop. Build Blacksmith; prioritize ranged armor → then other upgrades as needed
Keep producing units non-stop; queue Spearman with home Barracks if enemy raids with cavalry
Build Monastery and start gathering Relic

description: Now that pro scouts is nerfed, 2TC Kremlin is back to being more relevant. author: TyrusLunarspear
steps: Queue up Villager. Send 5 Villagers to gather 50 Wood from a Straggler Tree then send them to Sheep. Send 1 Villager to the woodline and build Hunting Cabin then House then goes to Sheep. Rally to woodline
First Villager that pops out builds another Hunting Cabin covering different trees then goes to Sheep. Remember to send 5 Wood Villager to Sheep. Rally to Sheep
Queue up a Scout when first Hunting Cabin finishes. Rally onto Sheep until age-up
Rally to the chopped Straggler Tree until 3 on Wood

4 Villagers go to build Kremlin, try to build it close to Deer and Wood, if you can push the deer to it. If you can't, you can place it on the Stone. 3 Food go to gather Stone, build a Mining Camp. 3 Wood Villager on Straggler Tree go to Stone after they finish gathering, also build a House. Rally to Stone until you have 8 on stone
At this point you should start pushing the Deer if you can with 3 Scouts
Rally to Straggler Tree

From here, you need to make the decision: Fast Castle - you send 2 Wood Villager to Gold, then aim for a split of about 22 Food 3 Wood 11 Gold, age up with High Trade House and play for Horse Archer. Feudal Play - About even between Food and Wood, with about 7 Gold, You can even try to go for Professional Scouts at this point if you have map control for resources denial
Age up Villager go to Wood near Kremlin, build a Lumber Camp. Also kill the Deer with Scout
You should have enough Stone (350), re-macro to Wood until you have 400
You should have enough Wood to build a Town Center on Deer with 8 Villagers
Rally to Gold until 3

title: New Player Guide to English - copy
description: Very basic, no-frills English build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to build a balanced army in the Feudal Age and attack. This can be played on any land map against any civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games! There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build and attack: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Make more barracks and archery ranges for more units, get siege engineering from the blacksmith so you can make rams with your infantry, and keep your food villagers working by adding farms or putting them on deer or berries. 2. Go Castle Age! Put a few more villagers to gold and age up with the White Tower in a defensive location near or in your base. Once up, upgrade your existing units and create new units (which you can directly from the White Tower). Try Knights! Once you're feeling comfortable with this build, look for a more advanced and optimal build order. I recommend checking out a recent build order guide video from a pro player. Two good options are Beastyqt and Valdemar.

description: HRE Burger used to be tied mainly to all inning the opponent. Since the latest patch, the monastery can be used as a mini Aachen Chapel. Meanwhile, special Meinwerk techs and Burger melee infantry charge bonus are available. A second prelate in feudal boosts additional vills, while in early castle it can speed up relic gathering. Placement of sheep, lumber camp and gold mine should allow prelates to inspire as many vills as possible. Farm transition can be started around the first monastery. Overall you sacrifice eco. But, you also save a lot of wood, which you can use to gather food, gold and stone with additional vills. Stone could be used for an arrow slit in case you build a tower. Start researching necessary Meinwerk-technologies during building Burgraf. E.g. if you intend to flood MAA start research of Iron Undermesh. Shortly after Age Up get Wedge Rivets. Thus, you can idle opponents TC. This build will probably only be viable in certain matchups. Especially, castle age macro may need to be adapted according to needs, e.g. in case spearmen are needed instead of Man at Arms and so on.

author: kkuuuu
steps: 細節: (1) 建造 Aqueduct 時, 不要緊貼着主城中吃 Sheep 的方向, 會導致 Sheep Villager 空閒1-2秒 (此說法來自Beastyqt). (2) 偵查時留意更近的中立市場 Market 的僱傭兵, 可以使用某些強力單位, 如希帕西 Sipahi on Royal Knight ， Arbalétrier 也是不錯的後排. (3) 三個水池至少要有一個 Cistern 覆蓋第一木區 Wood
開局2-0-1-3, 並且. (1) Rally to Food; (2) 1個 Food Villager 建造 House, 同時建有2個 Mining Camp; (3) 三個建築完工後會有足夠石頭, 用1個 Food Villager 建造 Cistern; 水池優先覆蓋 Stone 和 Food, 加上 Gold 為最優.
用1個 Food Villager 建造 Cistern, 二水池覆蓋 Gold. (如果一水池已覆蓋 Gold, 則覆蓋 Berries )
用1個 Food Villager 建造 Cistern, 二水池覆蓋 Berries. (如果二水池已覆蓋 Berries, 則放在後方 或 覆蓋第二木區 Wood )
用建造三水池的 Villager 連接 Aqueduct, 建完去 Wood
Rally 去散木 Straggler Tree
5個 Villager 建造 Grand Winery, 放在 Berries 旁且與主城之間留出種田的空間, 建完去 Berries
用1個 Stone Villager 建造 Cistern 並連上 Aqueduct, 四水池外圍剛好覆蓋第二片 Berries, 要盡量靠近主城. 建完去 Berries 或 Food
繼續 Rally Wood

細節: (1) 當建造較遠的水池時, 可以先建 Aqueduct 拉過去, 再建 Cistern. 更快捷和安全. (2) 關於僱傭兵之家 Mercenary House 的合同選擇, 此流程不能選 Eastern Mercenary Contract (大招, 需要特殊流程), 一般在 Silk Road Mercenary Contract 與 Western Mercenary Contract 之間選. Silk Road Mercenary Contract 好打馬族(小心特色轉白板), Western Mercenary Contract 萬金油, 多人局的合同選擇應盡量避免特色兵種相撞, 合同選擇不要看帝王兵! (3) 在研究重要科技時記得 Cistern 切辨證法加速, 如老練、精銳科技, Numeri, Ferocious Speed 或經濟科技 Wheelbarrow Double Broadax Horticulture. (4) 為了快速切 Cistern 光環, 建議使用切視角快捷鍵, 主要是軍事產能所在的 Cistern (默認ctrl+F1保存視角位置, shift+F1切到視角位置). (5) 科技類建築如 Blacksmith University, 應建在2本地標 Grand Winery 所在的水池 Cistern 光環的邊緣, 只要建築有一格在光環內就能吃到加成. 而這個水池 Cistern 可以長期保持辨證法, 加速科研. (3本出 Monk 搶 Relic 要切回去). (6) 帝王的地標無腦選 Foreign Engineering Company, 另一個是区. 帝王的橄欖油留給蜂巢炮和皇家加農炮, 前排用本家兵.
Grand Winery 建成後, 所有 Sheep Villager 移到第一片 Berries (可提前操作)
用1個 Stone Villager 建造 Cistern 並連上 Aqueduct, 五水池的位置根據地圖而靈活變化, 建完去 Wood. ( Cistern 的位置一般可以選擇第二片金礦 Gold, 第二片木區 Wood, 第三片 Berries 或 安全的後方)
所有 Stone Villager 轉到 Gold, 繼續 Rally Wood
流程總結: (1) 此流程在建成五水池後已經結束, 後續需根據對局情況和偵查訊息進行調整. (2) 此流程必需在5分鐘的時候拍下第五座水池 Cistern 並留有70金, 如不一致需自行檢查流程中步驟是否出問題了. (3) 以下將給出通用打法思路(兩本壓制接上城)
依次建造 Stable 或 Barracks on Mercenary House on Wheelbarrow on House. 合同選擇 Western Mercenary Contract, 打 馬弓 或 叉弓 壓制
補充多一個軍事產能 Stable 或 Barracks, 也可以改為建造 Blacksmith 研究 Siege Engineering (打一波)
重新調配 Rally Food, 先保證有15+軍事單位, 再上城
10個 Food Villager 建造 Golden Horn Tower, 重新調配. 保證4農伐木 Wood, 10農挖金 Gold (若3本打純步兵 Limitanei Varangian Guard Crossbowman, 只需8農), 其余吃肉 Food

author: Zubatch
steps: Send **all villagers** to Sheep. Use Scout to circle base and find more sheep.
First **3 new villagers** build Mining Camp on Gold and a House near TC.
Next **3 villagers → Sheep ** (final 9 food / 3 gold). When resources allow, age up with using the **3 gold villagers**.
Send **2 food villagers → Stone ** and **4 → straggler trees**. Set TC Rally to Gold until 4 villagers there, then back to sheep.
After mining 100 Stone, send both stone vils → Wood. Once 175 Wood gathered, send the 4 straggler wood vils → Sheep.
After mining 100 Stone, send both stone vils → Wood. Once 175 Wood gathered, send the 4 straggler wood vils → Sheep.
After Feudal age-up: use 4 gold villagers to build Manor to influence Gold + Sheep (include Wood if close). Scout opponent’s base — if they’re passive, send Lord of Lancaster to harass exposed vils.
If facing early aggression, you can: - Place Manor beside Wood instead for Feudal defense. - Transition into military production buildings around it. - Defend with Lords or tower gold if needed.

Continue normal build if safe: maintain **7 gold / 2 wood / rest on food**. At ~6:20, start The White Tower with **8 food villagers** (send more if pressured). Place landmark near Gold or between gold + woodline.
While landmark builds, set TC Rally to Wood for remainder of game. Use 2–3 gold villagers to build 2 Stables nearby. Train 1 extra Lord of Lancaster from Abbey of Kings.
After aging up, eco layout: 10 food / 12 gold / 1 stone / rest wood. Start constant Knight production from stables.
If pressured: use spawned Men-at-Arms + Lords defensively. Otherwise, pressure with Knights + Lords to gain map control and relics.
Add Blacksmith + Monastery for relics and upgrades. Optional tech path: add Archery Range if enemy makes spears/crossbows.

If sheep run out → move to Berries or external food. Your 1 stone villager will have enough for another Manor → place near new food source to maintain influence on ≥10 vils. Always aim for 10+ vils under each manor for best passive bonus.

Keep producing units, complete eco upgrades, and build Farm clusters around manors. At this stage, your eco should be extremely strong with relics + manor passive income. You can close games with Knight/Lord pushes or safely go Imperial depending on map control.

The barracks Builder Villager builds then Archery Range and Blacksmith afterwards.
Train 1st Hospitaller Knight and Archer while always prioritizing Villager production! Hide military units in your base.
Build a House

Scout Scout your enemy's base to find a weak point for Tower rush and attack! (either Berries or Straggler Tree or Gold )

@5:40: You should have 2 Hospitaller Knights and ~5 Archers +/- Spearman; pull 2 Villagers from Wood and ATTACK!

OPTIONAL: If you are certain that you'll manage to get a Outpost up, then mine 50 Stone to upgrade it Arrowslits!
@6:20: Build a Outpost and protect your 2 Villagers; Rally to Wood!
@ next 125 Gold (from Pilgrim): research the next upgrade from Blacksmith depending on your situation.
Build 1-2 Battering Rams ASAP and target down enemy production buildings ( Barracks Archery Range Stable ) and/or Outpost!!!
Build more Archery Range OR/AND 2. Barracks (if opponent spams Horseman )
If you have the map control and your opponent is busy defending, go out on Deer or Boar!
Research Sanctuary if you have spare Food and Wood (This is expensive! Evaluate the investment critically!)

If you have dealt enough damage but can't finish up the game, continue containing your opponent and re-balance your economy to Age-up Castle Age -,then either Angevin Empire against mass cavalry for quick finish or Republic of Genoa for any other situation.

If the opponent has Knight, research Spearman veterancy upgrades and, eventually, Billmen. If the opponent also reaches Castle Age and starts producing Crossbowman, make Hobelar to counter them.

Don't forget to add the remaining 3 Lords of Lancaster for the bonus health. If one of your units gets low, move it back to heal at Abbey of Kings. If you have good micro, by doing this you will reach critical mass even quicker.
Rally,then Stone (5). Keep those 5 Villagers on Stone constantly so that you may build the remaining 6 Manors and, later, additional Keep to boost your Earl's Guard damage.

Research Wedge Rivets to dive enemy Town Center and destroy their economy and base.

Production building proportions: 3 Barracks; 1 Stable
Build Farm as you start running out of natural sources of Food.

Wynguard Palace: Has fast and cost-efficient unit producion of melee infantry, cavalry and gunpowder siege; providing more long-term value. Berkshire Palace: To secure control of important parts of the map, lock an opponent inside their base or defend your own if you are on the back foot.
Army composition: Earl's Guard + Knight + Lord of Lancaster. Add Spearman to counter Knight. Add Hobelar to counter Crossbowman and Springald
Research Scutage and Throwing Dagger Drills ASAP

(Slowly start building Farm, specially if you are short on Sheep. If you still have enough Sheep, you can delay the building of Farm, but avoid running out of Sheep to start building Farm )

Queue up 2 Longbowmen immediately and send them to harass the enemy Villager. The goal is to force your enemy to build military buildings and produce units, and not necessarily kill Villager. Build a Blacksmith with a Villager from Wood
Research Steeled Arrow and Iron Undermesh when your have enough resources
Send 2 Villagers to Food

When you reach Feudal Age Feudal Age research fresh foodstuffs Fresh Foodstuffs. Also research eco upgrades: specialized pick Specialized Pick, wheelbarrow Wheelbarrow, survival techniques Survival Techniques and horticulture Horticulture in this order.
Once you get 8 villagers Villager on wood Wood. Rally Rally to sheep Sheep until age up.

If enemy sees your ghulams Ghulam he is probably going to counter you. There are 2 answers to this problem. 1. Prevent it by trying to hide them from the enemy and attacking Attack once you have enough of them. 2. But you will probably be in a bad spot because you invested everything in ghulams Ghulam.
Research fertile crescent Fertile Crescent, shaft mining Shaft Mining, fertilization Fertilization and lumber preservation Lumber Preservation in the given order.

title: New Player Guide to Chinese
description: As basic as possible Chinese build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to be aggressive in the Feudal Age with a huge mass of horsemen and archer because of our insane economy and production speed. This can be played on any land map against any civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games! There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build and attack: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Make more production for more units, get siege engineering from the blacksmith so you can make rams with your infantry, and keep your food villagers working by taking all the food on the map (can use Barbican to secure!) 2. Go Castle Age! Put a few villagers to gold if needed, pause unit production a bit, and age up with the Imperial Palace. Upgrade your horsemen/archers if you have a mass, supervise and train lancers, and go kill your opponent with an incredibly strong unit composition. Against feudal knight civs, you will want to alter this build and go spear + horsemen in Feudal instead. Check out Pt2 of the below video for more info.

description: This Build Order is meant to have a strong economy while still producing Longbowmen and rush in Feudal Age. It’s not like the all-in Longbomen rush version, but it is designed to get advantage of the cheaper farms, gathering speed bonus around the mills, preventing the risk of sending your villagers to berries and deer and keep them safer, and develop a good economy for longer games with the opportunity of swapping unit production depending on your enemy’s army composition. This Build Order was created by Beastyqt.

(Slowly start building Farm, specially if you are short on Sheep. If you still have enough Sheep, you can delay the building of Farm, but avoid running out of Sheep to start building Farm )

Queue up 2 Longbowmen immediately and send them to harass the enemy Villager. The goal is to force your enemy to build military buildings and produce units, and not necessarily kill Villager. If your enemy start producing units, send your Longbowman back and do not lose them. Skip this step if you are playing against cavalry civs.
Research Double Broadax and Horticulture when you have enough resources
Depending on your enemy’s army composition or military buildings, build a Barracks or Stable with a vil from Wood and start producing Spearman / Horseman
Start producing Longbowman again alongside with Spearman / Horseman
Build a Blacksmith with a Villager from Wood
Research Steeled Arrow and Iron Undermesh when your have enough resources
Send 2 Villagers to Food
Send 3 Villagers to Wood

Around min 7:30, send your army to the enemy. Don’t stop producing units. You can also send a Villager to build Outpost at your enemy’s base. The goal is not destroy your enemy at this moment, but to harass his economy
Rally Villager to Food

Or if the opponent rushes Castle Age, then make sure you get some army before aging up yourself, possibly harassing his Gold and above all else contesting the Relic. Make Chevalier Confrere + Spearman against Knights; Serjeant against infantry comps; Hospitaller Knight + Archer against archer comps; OR Chevalier Confrere + Archer META. Civs with great archers (Byzantines Byzantines, English English, House of Sad Times House of Lancaster ) or if you think it is best thing to do in your given situation e.g alot of enemy spears on on on. - Build Archery Range and Stable and produce Yumi Ashigaru (Yumi) and Yari (Yari). - Build Oda Clan Daimyo Estate right beside both production buildings when resources allow it, and produce Daimyo (Daimyo) when building is finished. - Research Higoyumi (Higoyumi) when you can

title: 1TC proxy barracks Hospitalier rush - individual
description: a very aggressive hospitalier rush build which has emerged on ladder this season. Made much stronger by hospitalier move speed buff, piligrim tech cost reductions, and people getting more and more used to KT being a 2TC civ.
author: B-SON
steps: 6 Villagers on Food, next 2 Villagers on Wood on straggler tree. Build House with one of food villagers.
next 3 Villagers on Gold
next 1 Villager on Food; next 1 Villager on Wood; next Villager goes out on the map to eventually build proxy barracks. Make sure your Scout circles around enemy base to see where his Gold is.
start age-up with Knights Hospitaller
immediately after age up, transfer 4 vills from Food on Wood (use straggler tree). The goal is to gather 350 wood until age up finishes for Barracks and Safe Passage

use Villager out on the map to build proxy Barracks, on the map, preferably close to opponent's Gold, but also aim for position close to the middle of the map, from which it's easy to rally units anywhere you need. After finishing building, Villager goes on Wood

From here, everything depends on what opponent does. Primarily you use Hospitaller Knight + Archer to efficiently trade with opponent's army, Make sure to use hold position micro as much as possible to get heals during the fight. Any non-all-in trades are good, as you can use Hospitaller Knight to completely heal up your army outside combat, while opponent in a lot of cases can't do the same.
after age up finishes - immediately start producing Hospitaller Knight, at home research Safe Passage, transfer 4 Villagers back on Food

go up to 10 Villagers on Food, transfer 5 of them on closest Deer once you start banking resources. Keep up Hospitaller Knight production. Add second proxy Barracks once you have enough Wood. Start saturating Gold more after this.
Rally Wood til 8
Rally Gold til 5. Rally Food

from here, you should be able to consistently pump out Hospitaller Knight from two barracks and pressure opponent's resources, while Safe Passage provides extra gold for upgrades. If opponent tries to defend resources with Outpost - just hold-position Hospitaller Knight under it. Make sure you scout for any attempts to sneak resources out on the map and send Hospitaller Knight there if it's discovered.

after previous step, the build becomes more flexible, but you should start saturating Wood more, as you'll need a lot of extra buildings. Very common response from opponents are Archer, adding your own Archery Range Archery Range Archer in response is effective (use proxy builder Villager to build next to opponent's base). Add Outpost on your resources in case of counter-raids. Build Blacksmith and get Iron Undermesh ASAP. Research Steeled Arrow once you have enough archers.

If opponent doesn't lose in feudal, eventually you will need to age up. Possible options include Kingdom of Castile and Angevin Empire, depending on what units you think you will need. Angevin Empire provides Heavy Spearman which is very good against any Horseman attempts to counter your archers. Against very large amounts of Archer (also, depending on the civ, possible inclusions of ranged cav) - going Kingdom of Castile and Genitour can be a good option: Hospitaller Knight form a solid frontline, while Genitour poke everything to death.

If the game stabilizes - prioritize Monastery, get as many Relic as possible; start gathering Stone to secure at least one sacred site with Fortress, play standard game from there. Extra note: this build is not recommended at all into: French Macedonian Dynasty Jeanne d'Arc - they have pretty strong early feudal tempo and they outscale your army in long feudal; Be careful vs: Mongols Malians Delhi Sultanate Ottomans Rus English Ayyubids - I think these civs have tools to deal with this build more or less effectively, although if they blindly go for greedy build orders and try to defend with Outpost - they can easily lose. Otherwise you can just not commit as hard into feudal and go for earlier castle age. Knights Templar mirror can also be very tricky, strongly depends on what they age up with and what build they're going for. In other matchups this build should work well.
Get Wedge Rivets and veteran upgrades ASAP, use your age up of choice to add relevant units. Usually you can find a timing to all-in opponent after all upgrades are done.

Move 2 more villagers to Stone. Goal: 7 on stone for fast 600 stone.

After Fortress: keep 3-4 on Stone for 2nd Fortress later, rest to Gold/Wood. Keep producing units and defend route.
No 2TC. Boom via Pilgrim gold + map control. Add farms when sheep runs low. Save for Castle Age.
Click Castle Age when ready. After Castle: capture Sacred Site and scale Fortresses.

title: 2TC Ottoman
description: 2TC Ottoman Beasty guide (February 2024) - Can be play +- vs any civ Matchups: - English - hardest - they push too fast with LB and military school produces spearman - Zhu Xi and China - rough
author: Swing
steps: Start: 5 Villagers Stone 1 Villager Sheep Food. Rally TC to food until 9 Villagers Sheep Food. Goal is to get 50 stone mined (=1 run without building mining camp,then enough stone for military school)

Move 5 Villagers Stone to Wood (until 50 wood = with 5 villagers it means 1 run). Move 2 Villagers Sheep Food to build Military School (build military buildings in back of your base to not lose it if pushed). Wood villagers are then moved to food, workers that were building military school too and one of them builds house

Move 5 Villagers Wood to Sheep Food. When military school is finished,then 1 Villager from Military School builds House (do not build house where you are going to build military buildings so they are in blacksmith bonus range). 1 Villager from House goes to Sheep Food (so there will be 9 vills on food). Change TC rally point to Gold until 3 Villagers. Our target at this stage is to have 9 food and 3 gold vills
When 9 Villagers Sheep Food and 3 Villagers Gold (until 200 gold). Rally TC to food until age up
When 200 Gold move 3 Villagers Gold to Wood

Age up with Twin Minaret Medrese with 5 Villagers from Sheep Food. - Build Twin Minaret right next to TC but not too close to berries, so workers on Minaret are not in rage of berries. - Do not build it in the place where you will place military buildings. Twin Minaret can support 5 Villagers. When Horticulture researched, reduce it to 4 Villagers, when Fertilization researched, reduce them to 3 Villagers or just keep 4 all the time to make it easier
During age up, move 4 Villagers Sheep Food to Wood and build Lumber Camp. Rally TC to Wood until 8. Chop 2 Straggler Tree next to TC
1 Villager Wood builds House then moves to build Mining Camp at Stone. When 2 trees chopped, move 5 Villagers Wood to Stone

5 Villagers from age up stay on Twin Minaret Medrese (see more above about villagers on Minaret). Switch Military School to Sipahi and harras. Move 4 Villagers from Sheep Food to Wood. Rally TC to Stone until 650 Stone for 2TC. 350 stone is for 2TC and 300 is for military schools
Build 2TC with 8 Villagers on Gold. Rally TC to wood

When 650 Stone move Villager Stone to Wood and Sheep Food. Workers that were building 2TC go to Gold. Rally TC to food. Rally 2TC to gold. Target at this stage is to have 8 on wood, 8 on gold and rest on food with TC rally point to food
1 Villager Wood builds Military School and Blacksmith. Get Wheelbarrow and Double Broadax. Build House. Then get Horticulture and Iron Undermesh

What to do next. - We can age up to Castle (with 8 villagers). or. - Stables and knights. or. - barracks, archer ranges and MAA (we do not want to produce janissaries until enemy has cavalry). or. - if opponent has cavalry we want to age up and get janissaries. or. - get relics
Vizier points. With first Vizier Point we get sheeps, so we can place 2TC on gold because we have safe food. With second Vizier Point we get +1 military schools

Vs some civs. English Do not go military school that soon if you play against English and instead age up quicker. Rus If against Rus - you can kill him some wolfs with spearman to deny bounty. French Jeanne d'Arc Be annoying at their gold with spearman. Abbasid Dynasty Be annoying at gold and stone. Knight civs ( Jeanne d'Arc French Rus ). - When we age up, we make barracks and upgrade spearman to defend

steps: Ideal 100 man army Composition, Templar Brother 40. Genoese Crossbowmen 20. Hospitaller Knights 20. Spearmen 10. Trebuchets 10
Send all 6 starting Villager to Sheep.

build Town Center 2nd TC on Deer with Stone Villager. After 2TC placed: Villager stay on Deer. Build Granary. Research Wheelbarrow Wheelbarrow.

Build Barracks Barracks - start producing Hospitaller Knights. Build Blacksmith Blacksmith. Build Market market
Continue filling both TCs: food, wood, small gold top-up. Both TCs should NEVER idle from here forward. Queue Castle Age at ~30 pop with solid Fortress income.
Age up 3 With Genoese Crossbowmen. Build Archery Range Archery Range - start producing Genoese Crossbowmen. Build Stable Stable - produce Templar Brothers.
Research melee armor in BS
Start for Second Fortress
build 2nd Keep. After 2nd Fortress placed: reassign Stone Villager back to Sheep and Gold. Research Fanaticism Fanaticism in monestary
Army: Hospitaller Knights (front) + Genoese Crossbowmen (back) + Templar Brothers.
3v3: Consider dropping 3rd Town Center TC now to accelerate to 100 vills faster. Continue pushing to 65 vills before queuing age up.
Queue Imperial Age - aim for ~40-45 pop. Stop building military briefly - let both TCs run uninterrupted until ~85 vills.

AGE UP: Choose Teutonic Order Commanderie - all gold units gain +2 melee armor instantly! Build Siege Workshop Siege Workshop -. Deploy Trebuchets onto Keep Fortress emplacements - fires an extra projectile!
Upgrade commanderie units to Elite (200 Food / 400 Gold - still ~half normal cost). New Villager: food on gold on wood priority. Consider 3rd Keep Fortress for max Pilgrim group size and map control.

Resume full army production with income to sustain it. Push to 100 Villagers. Target final split: ~46 food / 27 wood / 21-24 gold. Army push: Templar Brothers + Genoese Crossbowmen + Hospitaller Knights + Trebuchets on Fortresses.

100 Villagers cap reached. Full eco achieved. All Gold units now have +2 melee armor from Teutonic Order - push team fights with Fortress Trebuchet support. Sacred sites + Pilgrim gold income is now snowballing massively. WIN.

Build Blacksmith. Research Iron Undermesh Steeled Arrow Bloomery Fitted Leatherwork Siege Engineering. Consecrate = Town Center on School of Cavalry on Archery Range. Research Survival Techniques (go on Deer )

From now on, the match depends on the enemy’s response and your plans. Make your choices according to that. Keep building Military Buildings to keep pressure on your enemy, or go for a second Town Center to try to boom and age up to Castle Age. Level up Jeanne d'Arc - Woman-at-Arms to Jeanne d'Arc - Knight depending on your enemy’s army composition ( Champion Companions if your opponent is going Spearman - Archer, or Rider Companions if your opponent is going Crossbowman )

author: Prostor
steps: - Town Center etrafındaki 3 Straggler Tree 'ı toplamak istiyoruz. Binaları 3 Straggler Tree 'ı yok etmeyecek şekilde kur. - Twin Minaret Medrese 'yi Berries 'den uzağa kurmamız gerekiyor. 4 Villagers 'yi Food 'ten çek. Wood 'a yolla.
200 Stone toplayınca 2 Villagers 'yi Gold 'a gönder. 100 Stone kasada duracak ama 3. Military School basabildiğimiz anda basmamızı sağlayacak.
Rally | 12 Wood olana kadar

GENEL BİLGİ. -Sürekli olarak Sipahi üretmek istiyoruz. Osmanlının erken oyunda en güçlü yönü Sipahi üretebilmesidir. Oyunun en güçlü hafif atlısıdır. -Eğer Feodal Çağ'da kalıp rakibi yenmeyi düşünüyorsak Sipahi + Archer şeklinde ordu kurmamız gerekiyor. French ve Jeanne d'Arc, Royal Knight üretebildiği için bu ikisine karşı oynarken Feodal Çağ'da Sipahi + Spearman şeklinde ordu daha etkili olacaktır. Rus, Knight üretiyorsa eğer Spearman basılmalıdır. -Kaynaklar yettiği zaman sırasıyla Double Broadax + Horticulture + Wheelbarrow ekonomi geliştirmesi almak istiyoruz. -Askeri teknoloji olarak sırasıyla Steeled Arrow + Iron Undermesh + Siege Engineering araştırmamız gerekiyor. Archer üretmiyorsak eğer Iron Undermesh + Siege Engineering şeklinde araştırma yapıyoruz. -Askeri üstünlüğü ele geçirdiğimiz zaman rakibin kaynaklarını engellemeye çalışmalıyız. Gold veya Wood kaynakları Town Center korumasında uzakta kaldığı için bunlara odaklanmalıyız. Eğer rakibin Town Center korumasında Sheep kalmadıysa önceliğimiz Food kaynaklarını engellemek olmalı. - Siege Engineering araştırmasıyla Battering Ram üretip rakibin Gold 'da Outpost varsa ona yoksa House ve Archery Range, Stable, Barracks gibi askeri üretim binalarını hedef alabiliriz. - Blacksmith etkisinde bulunan yapılar çağlara göre %20, %30 ve %40 daha hızlı üretim yapar. Imperial Age 'a Istanbul Observatory ile çıkıldıysa bu etki %100 olur. Bu hızlı üretim etkisi. Military School ve Mehmed Imperial Armory yapılarını da etkiler. Daha hızlı şekilde daha fazla ücretsiz birim üretmemizi sağlar. -Oyun sonu ordumuz Sipahi + Janissary + Great Bombard şeklinde olmalıdır. ASKERİ OKUL. - Dark Age 'da sadece Spearman üretebiliyor. - Feudal Age 'da Sipahi veya Archer ürettiriyoruz. Sipahi, Food ağırlıklı olduğu için Food korumamızı sağlıyor ama üretmesi çok uzun sürmesi dezavantaj oluyor. Wood az bulunan haritalarda Archer tercih ediyoruz. - Castle Age 'da rakip Feodal Çağdaysa veya Spearman ağırlıklı orduya sahipse Man-at-Arms iyi tercih. Zırhlı birimler getiriyorsa Crossbowman iyi tercih. Advanced Academy puanını aldıktan sonra Janissary iyi tercih. Lancer çok yavaş çıktığı için tercih etmiyorum ama üretilebilir. - Imperial Age 'da Janissary hem atlı birimlere ekstra vurması hem de genel hasarı yüksek olması sebebiyle en iyi seçenek. - Mehter saniye/kaynak olarak diğerlerinden daha verimlidir. Oyun sonu 1 Military School, Mehter üretiminde bırakılabilir. TOPHANE-İ AMİRE. - Castle Age 'da rakip ordusu ağırlıklı olarak yakın dövüşçü yayalardan oluşuyorsa ( Spearman, Man-at-Arms vb.) Springald üretmeliyiz. Herhangi menzilli birim ağırlıklıysa Mangonel üretmeliyiz. - Imperial Age 'da Great Bombard üreteceğiz. VEZİR PUANLARI. -Puanları öğrenene kadar, Anatolian Hills ⮞ Military Campus ⮞ Advanced Academy ⮞ Janissary Company ⮞şeklinde alabilirsiniz. - Field Work Yoğun Feodal Çağ çatışması yaşanıyorsa, 2 Imams çıkarılıp toplu iyileştirme kullanarak savaşlardan galip çıkabiliriz. Veya Kale Çağına çıktığımızda hızlı bir şekilde Relic toplamak için de kullanılabilir. - Anatolian Hills Çatışmanın yoğun olmadığı veya Food kaynaklarının yetersiz, korunaksız olduğu durumlarda tercih edilebilir. - Mehter Drums Mehterlere, askerleri hızlandırma özelliği verdiği için Horse Archer, Mangudai, Camel Archer gibi birimleri yakalamak için kullanılabilir. - Military Campus ve Advanced Academy Askeri okulları güçlendirdiği için her oyun almayı istiyoruz. - Siege Crews Kuşatma ağırlıklı oynadığımız maçlarda, kuşatma makinelerini güçlendirdiği için iyi bir tercihdir. - Janissary Company ve Anlık asker üretip kendimizi savunmak veya oyunu bitirmek için kullanılabilir. - Trade Bags Ticaret yaptığımız maçlarda %40 altın gelirini arttırdığı için alınması şarttır. - Pax Ottomana 2 Şehir Merkezi kurduysak ve anlık Villager sayısını yükseltmek istiyorsak alınabilir. - Extensive Fortifications Rakip Kale Çağına geçtiyse ve zırhlı birimler getiriyorsa kendimi savunmak için alınabilir. Veya takım oyunlarında ticaret kuruluysa ve Sea Gate Castle ile İmparatorluk Çağına geçtiysek ticaret yollarına daha ucuza ve daha güçlü Keep 'ler kurmak için alınabilir.

Feudal Age geçtik. Twin Minaret Medrese 'de 5 Villagers çalıştırmamız gerek. Sheep 'dan 1 Villager çekip Twin Minaret Medrese 'yi kuran 4 Villagers ile birlikte Twin Minaret Medrese 'den Berries topla.

Sheep 'dan 2 Villagers çekip aynı anda Military School + Stable kur. Sipahi üretmeye başla. Ardından Blacksmith kurup üretim hızını arttıracağız ve Military School 'lar daha hızlı çalışmaya başlayacak.

title: kirA's Delhi MAA all-in
description: As discussed here: https://www.reddit.com/r/aoe4/comments/1b7vj9g/from_gold_ii_to_conqueror_i_in_19_days/
author: kirA
steps: Queue second Scout and Villager s. Get as many sheep as possible!
Send 5 Villagers to closest Straggler Tree, 1 Villager to start building Mill on Berries, followed by building a Mosque and a House.

When Straggler Tree Villager get 10 wood each, have them finish constructing the Mill without dropping wood off, get all upgrades in (from Mosque too) and switch them to Food. Rally first Villager to House and second to Berries.
Rally 3 Villagers to Gold. First one will build Mining Camp.
Rally 3 Villagers to the Straggler Tree, that's already chopped.
Take 4 Berries Villager and have them construct Tower of Victory, shift-queue them back to Berries.
Rally 2 Villagers to main woodline and build Lumber Camp House, shift-queue 3 Villagers from Straggler Tree to main woodline. Queue all upgrades.
Rally 3 Villagers to Gold. Whenever at 130 gold queue a Scholar, if needed, cancel upgrades and requeue them behind the Scholar. Get 5 in total and rally them inside the mosque!
Cancel economy upgrades that haven't finished ( Survival Techniques and Forestry ) and queue all Feudal upgrades.
Think. Do you expect feudal pressure? YES: Rally 1-2 extra Villager on Gold and build Outpost to defend it, before rallying to Food. NO: Rally to Berries, followed by Sheep until Castle Age.
Take 1 Wood Villager and build Blacksmith and a House. Send back to Wood and whenever enough resources, take 1 Wood Villager to build second Blacksmith, another House, and 2 Barracks.

Get blacksmith upgrades. You will get 3 before Castle Age. Think. Do you expect pressure? YES: Steeled Arrow Iron Undermesh Bloomery. NO: Iron Undermesh Balanced Projectiles Bloomery. 100% NO: Iron Undermesh Bloomery Fitted Leatherwork

Take 4 Gold Villager and ~10 Food Villager to build House of Learning. Shift queue 3 Villagers back to Gold, rest to Sheep. If you're not pressured and enemy is in their base. Shift queue a couple of age up Villager to make Mill on map Berries or Deer
Send 2 Scholars to 2 Barracks. Rally military to weak spot of enemy base.
Keep rallying Villager to Food.
From Blacksmith: Get Honed Blades Wedge Rivets Forced March immediately. Decarbonization Hearty Rations to follow. Queue all economic upgrades!
Print Man-at-Arms.

Build House, Market. From the Market you can balance your eco. It should be pretty balanced, but you might need to sell Wood for either Gold or Food depending on how your game has gone up to this point. Also, you might run low on Food during transition from Sheep to map Berries and Deer.

Keep printing Man-at-Arms. Main purpose is to idle enemy economy and push them into defence which allows you to take map control. When the first three military upgrades have finished, search for an opening to either take Sacred Site or Relic with the Scholar in your Mosque.
Build third Barracks and boost it with a Scholar.

Keep printing Man-at-Arms. Think! Is enemy locked into their base and villagers idle in TC? YES: Kill vills outside of TC, keep pressure on base, but search for eco outside of base. NO: Spread your MAA into enemy woodline, food, gold, stone so they have multiple places to focus on, try to get them to idle everywhere. 100% NO: They pushed you back. Rally to 2/3 of the way to their base, so they can't counterattack without you seeing it. Use Forced March to get your units there faster in greater numbers. Kill the counterattack (they should struggle for resources, so you should be ahead) and push their base again with 20+ Man-at-Arms. Don't forget to move vills to new food sources. You will use them up FAST.

Goal during age up is to analyze whether you have to make units ( Chevalier Confrere ) or if you have enough safety to rush straight to Imperial Age

4 from food build Grand Winery Grand Winery near Berries (Risky play; 8 vills, fast winery into immediate empowered Berries )

Rally to Straggler Tree until 10, then to Food, build Olive Grove when available!(Around 8 mins you should have about 10+ Olive Grove ). Build Cistern near Berries + Wood and Grand Winery and connect Cistern s. Move Sheep to Berries after Grand Winery. Research Wheelbarrow, Double Broadax, Horticulture, and Border Settlements ( Adapt as needed! )

Optionally begin building Palisade Wall s in good positions! If vs English build Outpost on Berries and Palisade Wall. Build Mercenary House near non-winery Cistern. If vs English build Archery Range, else build Stable or Barracks near Cistern (Barracks if against knights, otherwise Stables). Western Mercenary Contract for Longbow, If against English, then Silk Road Mercenary Contract for Javelin, or Eastern Mercenary Contract vs early all-in MAA

Start spamming Horseman or Limitanei. ( Horseman + Archer + Longbowman is good against most, Limitanei + Archer + Longbowman instead VS Knights). Upgrade Horseman if you have more than 10 (Same with other unit types!). Build Blacksmith near WINERY Cistern ( Timing around 7 minutes ). Research: Iron Undermesh Steeled Arrow Bloomery Fitted Leatherwork, and Specialized Pick ( Adapt as needed, not locked in, all not needed!). (Use Dialectus to speed up!). Rally to Gold at 18-21 Food to prepare for age up, then adjust as needed!
Golden Horn Tower Golden Horn Tower with 6 from Wood. Consider building more Palisade Wall to secure base and additional resources, and if military is small!

Build Barracks Barracks Barracks to prepare for Varangian guards DURING OR BEFORE AGE UP! Spam Varangian Guard Varangian Guard Varangian Guard + Crossbowman + Longbowman and/or Archer. Crossbowman if they go MAA. Get Blacksmith Upgrades, and others!! Build and connect Cistern when you can on more resources! Consider Market and neutral market for mercenaries!
8-12+ Food Vills for Age-up, choose final landmark based on needs! Palatine School for mass soldiers, Foreign Engineering Company for powerful siege

Additional Tips: Keep a scout up for military use, a counter to Byzantine are Mangos to deal with their Varangian Guard, springalds need the scout's vision to snipe. Use longbows around resources to get vision if you dont have Border Settlements or Outpost up. You want to make Outpost on Berries if they are facing your enemy. Make Outpost on the Gold if no forward Berries. In feudal, start with a Barracks to make Limitanei vs knight civs ( Jeanne d'Arc French Rus Mongols ) then go into Mercenary House. (+1 and +2 ranged upgrades are insanely important, your longbows are basically crossbows for dealing with anything living and mechanical, with good splits during fights, you can whittle down mangonels too very quickly). Consider your timings. You can make a lot of units in castle and push, but when you approach 200/200 it is time for imperial. Another timing is your age 4 Longbowmen upgrade that makes them do serious damage again vs age 3 opponent. Varangian age 4 upgrade is also insane. In higher ranked games, it's typically over in under 20 min. Generally you should have 2 production buildings at near the. same time you finish age up and be making army non stop. Transition to castle with a purpose, because you are at a disadvantage in early castle if you don't have the resources to use it. Also never float resources, keep everything under 300 when not planning to use those resources immediately! Solid additional tips: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1i9ZrtievRYPquOD0fYgDC71pSZpDZ6iY2TzYcQOF59I/edit?gid=2112505777#gid=2112505777. ( Many tips courtesy of Vlademar and Beasty )

Continue building Eco, finish upgrades( University ), use Cistern more offensively when needed. Market boom! Build Springald and use Ranged to pick off Crossbowman to defend Varangian Guard, same comp as castle! Mass Cataphract + Mangonel / Longbowman + Numeri possible if rich on Gold. Limitanei + Horseman for low Gold / getting into late Imperial Age

Alternative Horse Rush: Imperial Hippodrome,then Cistern of the First Hill,then Palatine School for mass Horseman + Cataphract!!HEAVY GOLD REQUIREMENTS!! Raid a lot + Expilatores to make a fast Imperial Age possible!

title: Beastyqt Abbasid Military Wing
description: Beastys Vid outlines what Wing to pick depending on your situation and matchup. Go trade wing if there is a trade post in the back of your base, easily reach- and defendable. Hard against cavalery based civ like French, Dehli, Jean D'arc and Rus. Go culture cing against English to advance easier into Castle Age. You can usually defend against early rush, but English becomes dangerous with a critical mass in long Feudal. Culture Wing let's you keep producing units and age up at the same time. Another scenario are maps with fishing, which allows you to age up faster with culture wing. Go military wing against strong early aggression like against Ottomans or English. Once you get your units from Military Wing, use them to harass your opponent for as long as possible. This is bad against English because of longbow and Rus because of Kremlin.

Get Wheelbarrow asap then Double Broadax. Once you got enough gold for that, transfer Villager from Gold to Stone. While you do that, unlock Golden Age Tier 1 by connecting your buildings with House even if not population capped and Barracks. Research hardened spearmen. After that, if you got 8 on stone, rally onto wood.

Build 2nd Town Center on Deer to secure Food. Try to defend other ressources with placement. While building 2nd Town Center, research Fresh Foodstuffs. The build 2 Archery Ranges. Put Villager building 2nd Town Center on Deer when finished.

Put 3 to 5 on gold Villager onto Gold for upgrades like Survival Techniques if you get at least 2 Deer pack, Horticulture, Boot Camp, Steeled Arrow, Forestry. Then rally 1 Town Center onto Food, the other onto Wood. Start producing units, depending on what opponent does and add military buildings. Add a few Camel Archer if the opponent goes for cavalry.

Start walling your base, specially where you are planning to build your farms. For now, Palisade Wall are enough, but later on you want to be extra safe with Stone Wall.
Astronomical Clocktower first to start producing Nest of Bees
Ideal army: Spearman / Palace Guard + Zhuge Nu / Crossbowman + Lancer + Nest of Bees

Produce a strong army while you try to pick up Relic (if any remains). If the enemy is turtling you can make smaller army and focus on the next goal.

title: Rus | Pro scouts Kremlin
description: Pro scout build order variation with Kremlin instead of Golden Gate for more safety in the early game. Very flexible, can be followed with any strategy. Better for open maps against agressive civs and in team games when your base spawns at the front.
author: Jockxtar
steps: This is the standard Professional Scouts opening. First Scout goes to steal Sheep on the enemy side, second Scout scouts the area around your base quickly to not idle your Villager.
Send 5 Villagers to gather 50 Wood from a Straggler Tree then go to Sheep. 1 Villager build Hunting Cabin on first woodline then House then goes to Sheep
Rally,then near Wood (not to chop, it will build)
First Villager builds 2nd Hunting Cabin on opposite woodline ( or to the side of the first one opposite the first Hunting Cabin )
Rally,then Sheep (13)

Rally,then Straggler Tree (10)

Remacro 4 Villagers onto Straggler Tree
House
4 Straggler Tree Villager,then Build Mining Camp Gold
Produce a third Scout
Army composition: Spearman + Archer early to protect Scout. Knight + Archer later to put pressure and gain control of the map. Add Spearman vs Knight
4 Villagers Build Kremlin,then Build Lumber Camp
Rally,then Food (16)

Gradually produce Scout with excess Food until you have 8. 7 Scouts will get the Deer, move them close to them before Professional Scouts finishes. 8th Scout will stay at the enemy base checking what they do
Research Professional Scouts. Force drop Gold if necessary

Build Barracks or Archery Range or Stable depending on the matchup. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Barracks is the safest option since Horseman and Knight are the most typical counter to Professional Scouts. Archery Range vs Ayyubids ( Desert Raider ), Mongols ( Mangudai ) and Abbasid Dynasty ( Military Wing ). Stable if the opponent is also playing greedy and doesn't have units early. Great counter to FC openings to raid and deny Relic

Once Professional Scouts is researched, start collecting the Deer. Depending on the matchup you might want to move all Scout together, or send one or two to each Deer pack. Don't forget to research Survival Techniques
If you float Gold research Double Broadax and Wheelbarrow
Now remacro towards anything you want:

---------------------------------------------- All-in: --------------------------------------------. If you don't have it already, Build Stable to produce Knight. Then Build Archery Range to produce Archer. Make mass Knight + Archer. Research Double Broadax,then Steeled Arrow,then Siege Engineering,then Iron Undermesh. Add Battering Ram to close the game
Final production and economy: With 2 Stables and 4 Archery Ranges. Add Barracks and produce Spearman to counter Knight

----------------------------------------------- 2 TC: ---------------------------------------------. 10 Wood Villager and 10 Stone Villager will get the resources for a Town Center in about 1 minute. Afterwards focus on Food and Wood for Spearman + Archer to defend, unless the opponent is also playing greedy, in which case you can make Knight to raid and deny Relic
See to the left. Remacro to this. Main Town Center Rally,then Deer / Gold. 2nd Town Center Rally,then Wood
