Get temples and priests to get relics. Own the map with mangudai, harass their vils and trade, build towers for vision. Add pastures BEFORE deer run out, It is not a sin to get berries as Mongol either. Keep moving the Steppe Rebout when gold runs out. Keep Oovoo active if it runs out of stone. Add trade when it is safe to, you don't want to give them back map control by running back and forth to your own trade line over and over
a fairly good balance for castle armies (xbow, keshik, horsemen), rebalance as needed.

End game notes, - Don't build mass keshik if they go mass xbow: building horsemen is not a sin. - Don't build mass mangudai in castle, xbow is a great unit even though they don't have a horse. - you can make a few mangudai later for harass but they are not good for your main army. - still build some khan hunters in castle, they give your xbows more range ^^. - you can build a market without building traders earlier if you want to rebalance your eco. - remember to add more and more production buildings, you don't want to lose the game with 10k resources chillin in the bank. - Khaganate Palace is the preferred endgame LM, give better units and they are free, you can get stone with oovoo, trader upgrade, or just buying from the market, you can also get the oovoo boost on your temples instead of the landmark. - in imperial don't skimp on the hand cannoneers, mongol have good hand cannoneers, and they get the bonus from the knah hunters

title: Templar Feudal Fortress and Knights from Temu [WIP]
description: This build tries to increase your defense against Feudal Rushers & to safeguard the Pilgrims in the Feudal Age. It is a slight shift from Crackedy's 2TC build as it is reallocating the Stone for Stone Walls for the Fortress Influence ability to defend the Capital TC. This might not be worth it.
author: goldplayer_lol
steps: Age up with 15 Villagers choosing the Kingdom of France commanderie
Move Sheep a bit away from Town Center, about one unit. 6 Villagers on Sheep
Pick a Villager and [Shift] order to build Mining Camp and House near Gold, but right click on Sheep again to keep on food. Rally the next 2 Villagers from TC to Gold
First Villager builds Mining Camp and mines Gold
Second Villager builds House and mines Gold. Take Rally Point to individual Straggler Tree for the next 3 Villagers
9 Villagers and Scout; Pop Cap is reached but the House is being built
While getting ready to build Mining Camp on Stone with Villager on Gold when 50 Wood and 200 Gold (Shift order if the Gold behind Wood collection)
Rally next ~4-5 Villagers to Sheep (depends on your timing)
Point your Pilgrims from Town Center to a Sacred Site in the mean time
Send 5 Villagers from Sheep to Stone (after dropping Food to Town Center )
Send remaining Villager from Sheep to Wood. Don't chop more than 3 Straggler Tree in Dark Age

Collect 200-270 Stone, take 5 Villagers to Gold and 2 Villagers to Food. Collect enough wood for Stable, House and Safe Passage, (about 300 Wood ) take all to Food. Hold onto Stone to build Stone Wall near your Town Center in Feudal. Your Safe Passage is going to be worth between 2-3 Villagers depending on how much gold they generate every minute. You should assume for the worst until your pilgrims have safely make it to the Sacred Site.

When delaying your 2nd Town Center and Fortress (cause you're about to get rushed), you need to secure your Gold from Sacred Site and Mining Camp with the help of a few Stone Wall with the Arrowslits from Knights Templar Town Center 's "Fortress Influence. You should try to build Stone Wall between your Town Center and the resource you think is most vulnerable. This is going to be your gold in the case of this build. Still, you can build a 2nd Stone Wall between Wood and Deer if they're close to increase your defense if need be. Stone Wall could be deceptively unimportant to destroy with enemy Battering Ram if they're disconnected from surroundings, so wall length worth of 100 Stone near your resources (preferably with a Stone Wall Gate which is worth 35 Stone so your Villager can climb up, to emulate a Outpost ). Don't fight out of the influence's range. Using Stone Wall like beefier Outpost has the benefit of safeguarding idling Villager closer to the resources, and you can possibly get more than 5 Villagers on top of Stone Wall if its long enough. Remember that the trade-off is Villager can still take ranged damage but at a reduced rate atop Stone Wall. Don't forget to close the gates!!! You can produce roughly 4-5 Chevalier Confreres at the same time you can build a Town Center, so delaying it for a minute or two in terms of Wood gathering ups your military pop and lets you defend with Cavalry + Arrowslits under the influence of your Town Center and Stone Wall, or to provide company to your Safe Passage with what is kind of budget Knights.
Build Stable with 2 Villagers from Gold. Rally Town Center to Wood and Food, alternating until you've given 3 Villagers more to each
Get ready to build 1 House and Stone Wall with the Villager that went to Wood
Produce 1 Chevalier Confrere towards your desired Rally Point
Research Safe Passage when able
Produce 1 Chevalier Confrere more towards your desired Rally Point. Build Stone Wall near your Gold with 2 Villagers. Get ready to move 2 Villagers from Gold to Wood as Pilgrims reach Sacred Site
Produce 1 Chevalier Confrere more towards your desired Rally Point
This is the latest time you can build a 2nd House
The next few Villager should be split between Gold and Food as you try to get an Castle Age advantage over the Rushing enemy. Your 2nd Pilgrim should be spawnin soon.

You can play into the Fortress Influence ability if you keep building Stone Wall near your Town Center and Fortress on the Pilgrimage route you choose to defend. The point isn't to make a highway out of Stone Wall but to use them efficiently so your economy isn't out of balance. Aging up with either Kingdom of Castile or Angevin Empire plays well with what your defense needs at the moment. Either give your Fortress more health if the opponent has Counterweight Trebuchet away from the Sacred Site, or if there's a massing army near the Sacred Site give your army more damage and regeneration. Oh and building a 2nd Town Center at some point would be good. But remember that the Town Center you build don't have the Fortress Inluence ability.

title: 2 TC Sengoku Daimyo - Yakov
description: Best 2 TC Build For Sengoku - Into Mass of Mouted Samurai / Spear or Yuumi.
author: yakov
steps: 1 Villager Builds Matsuri at Gold. 2 Villagers to Wood. 3 Villagers to Gold. When the 3 Villagers have gathered the Gold and are returning to the Town Center, have them finish the Matsuri and drop off the Gold, then buy the Wood and buy 1 Yatai. Rally Sheep Until Age II
The Yatai leaves around 56 seconds, send the 1 to Boar or Deer with Berries (Only if Deer is with Berries ). The second Sheep Villager builds Farmhouse

After Farmhouse, send 2 Villagers Wood 1 to Sheep and other to Gold. For every 130 Gold, go to the Matsuri and buy Wood, then produce another Yatai, up to a total of 3 Yatai. 2 Yatai go outside de map 1 for Boar, 1 more safe (close to base) and the 3 Yatai goes into your base, getting Sheep AND Berries
After 200 Gold move all Gold Villager to Wood
Take 2 Villagers from Sheep and Feudal Age with Ryokan side with Town Center. Also 5 Villagers from Sheep to Stone, Builds Forge
Let only 1 Villager in Sheep send all the rest to Wood. Rally 1x Villager to Stone until 6 on Stone and them Rally Wood
When 300 Stone move all Villager to Wood until second Town Center
Take 9 Villagers Wood and builds the second Town Center, Feudal Age Villager go to Food, at this mark you are feudal with 2TC

This build is designed to secure two Town Center and reach the Feudal Age before the 6-minute mark. If you want to play aggressively in the Feudal Age, keep 5 Villagers on Gold and split the rest 1:1 between Food and Wood ( Rally one Town Center to Food and the other to Wood ). If you want to advance to Age III, split Villager 1:1 between Food and Gold while keeping 5 on Wood ( Rally one TC to Food and the other to Gold ). The best Feudal Age composition is Spearman with Yumi Ashigaru or ( Yari with Yumi Ashigaru ) When transitioning to Castle Age, the best composition is Mounted Samurai with Tanegashima Ashigaru; however, if the enemy fields many Spearman to counter your Mounted Samurai, consider massing Springald. Always choose the Takeda Clan Daimyo Estate or Oda Clan Daimyo Estate (Cavalry and Archery bonuses). Choose the Hojo Clan Daimyo Estate if you plan to field large numbers of Spearman instead of Yumi Ashigaru. Advancing to Imperial Age isn't worth it for this civilization, as it serves only to buff your Daimyo ' power; do so only in long games with excess resources, and aim to finish the match in Castle Age

Rus has high Food gather rate, so can easily spam heavy Food units like Knight Horseman Horse Archer Man-at-Arms. Wooden Fortress are very powerful. You can build Arrowslits, Castle Turret, and Springald Emplacement on them and be very safe against raids. Stone can be quickly bought at The Golden Gate for Wooden Fortress emplacements, Town Center, or Keep, without having to mine it. High Trade House is generally better than Abbey of the Trinity, but you can go Abbey of the Trinity or build Monastery to quickly gather Relic upon reaching Castle Age. Rally back to Sheep once buildings are completed until Feudal Age.
Once you've got 200 Gold move 2 Villagers from Gold to Wood.
Build a Lumber Camp near your woods.
Age up with the Aachen Chapel or Meinwerk Palace using 2 Villagers.
During Aachen Chapel or Meinwerk Palace construction move 4 Villagers to build a Mining Camp near Stone.
Rally on Wood until Feudal Age.
You want the second Town Center near Deer. Try to do it depending the match up and how you feel.
Once you've got enough ressources build a second Town Center using all Wood and Stone villagers.
Once Town Center constructed, split your Villager to Wood and Gold.
If you can build a Mill near your Deer. And if you want you can research Survival Techniques depending of your game.
Burgrave Palace is here to handle with more ease this All-in.
Gather ressources and defend if needed with Barracks.
Gather ressources until Castle Age is available.
Use 6 Villagers for Burgrave Palace construction.
If needed construct Blacksmith from Iron Undermesh against ennemy Gilded Archer.

Military Academy is here to boost your Burgrave Palace. Remember to use your emergency repairs if you are attacked. You can use Gilded Man-at-Arms to defend your buildings. Once Deer and Berries are consumed you can switch to Farm. If you survived the All-in, tech as needed and crush your ennemy. Wheelbarrow Specialized Pick Horticulture for eco tech to start. Fitted Leatherwork for military tech to start. The more you know: Steeled Arrow improve your Town Center attacks.
Once Burgrave Palace completed, research at your Blacksmith,then Military Academy.
Build Mill near Deer to gather food using 5 Villagers. You can add a Outpost to help on the defend of those buildings.

title: Byzantine 1 TC Aggression (Beasty)
description: Fast aggression build for neutral market mercenary
author: Fenil
steps: 2 Villagers,then build House and Mining Camp on Stone. 1 Villager,then build Mining Camp on Gold. rally on Food
build Cistern prio ( Stone on Food on Wood ) then into Food
on 8 on Food one to Gold
build Cistern on Berries and Aqueduct
Grand Winery near on Berries
rally on Wood

title: BO Golden Horder
author: Azogs_
steps: 4 Villagers ➤ Food. 1 Villager ➤ Ovoo ➤ Ger Gold. +2 Villagers + Rally ➤ Food
Build ➤ Golden Tent. +2 Villagers ➤ Gold
Wheelbarrow dès que possible
Feudal Age ➤. 5 Villagers Food ➤ Wood. 1 Villager Food ➤ Gold
150 Wood ➤ Stable avec 3 Villagers Food
12 Villagers Food ➤ Rally Wood
Batu Khan + Torguud + Keshik
2eme Ovoo

title: Rus Pro Scout - Season 10 & 11 - Beasty
author: Krayt
steps: Get 50 Wood with 5 Villagers and with the last Villager then Build Hunting Cabin and House
7th Villager Build another Hunting Cabin
Rally on Sheep and produce 2 Scouts
Build The Golden Gate with 4 Villagers (return to Food after)
Leave 4 Villagers on Food and get 8 Villagers on Wood and Build Lumber Camp
If need to escort scouts whil pro scouting, get 10 Villagers to Wood and Build Archery Range later
Sell Wood to Gold to research Professional Scouts and produce up to 6-7 Scouts
If ennemy counters you with spearman, Build Archery Range and produce Archer. Or if he counters you with knight or horseman, Build Barracks and produce Spearman
Start pro scouting and research Survival Techniques and build Wooden Fortress close to your Lumber Camp. All the excessive Wood is sold to The Golden Gate to age up
Build High Trade House with Food Villager
Rally on Wood for military buildings and Monastery. Get Double Broadax and Wheelbarrow
If the ennemy is massing Archer,then produce a lot of Man-at-Arms and get Wedge Rivets. Otherwise produce Horse Archer and get Relic

While having Horse Archer. If ennemy have a lot of ranged units: get Horseman. If ennemy have a diverse army: get Knight. If ennemy have a lot of spearman: get Man-at-Arms. If ennemy have a lot of cavalry: get Spearman and/or Crossbowman. Adapt to always counter ennemy army

title: Sengoku Opener (Beasty opener)
description: Classic two Yatai opener for Sengoku to transition smoothly into feudal and either go for agression or fast castle.
author: Drumz
steps: The idea is to build 2 Yatai top slowly starting to ramp up your Matsuri. Note that you may have to deposit some food/wood manually to have the correct numbers (see video)
5 Villagers,then Wood. 1 Villager,then Matsuri (near wood and gold + space for farms),then Wood. Rally,then Deer or Sheep (until 8). If you go on Deer, kill one with your Scout
Bring Sheep on Berries side of the TC
If you go on Deer: Build Farmhouse near corpse. Else: Farmhouse then Rally,then Sheep
If are on Deer,then Manual deposit. Build Yatai ( Boar if possible)
Reasearch Tawara
Second Yatai try to maximize Food ( Berries and Sheep )
Once you have at least 100 Wood. All Wood Villager,then Forge,then Gold
Once 8 Villagers on Food. Rally,then Wood. Build Farmhouse on Food
Start aging up with 4 Food Villager. Ryokan easier, Koka Township can be busted if correctly used
Move 4 Gold Villager,then Wood. Rally,then Wood

From here you have 2 choices: Going for feudal aggression (Split go 12 on Wood, 14 on Food ). Going for FC, keep producing units, split accordingly 15 Food, 8 Gold. Note that Oda Clan Daimyo Estate and Takeda Clan Daimyo Estate combination is REALLY strong but Hojo Clan Daimyo Estate is easier to play
Age up Villager go back to Food
Start building Barracks / Archery Range / Stable (near Ryokan if builded) to counter enemy units
Remacro according (move Wood to Stone ). Rally,then Stone
Build first Hojo Clan Daimyo Estate or Oda Clan Daimyo Estate or Takeda Clan Daimyo Estate near production building with Stone Villager. Choose according to enemy comp

title: 2TC Templar
author: Birteet
steps: Age up with 15 Villagers with Age Up Ally Principality of Antioch
6x Villagers on Sheep
rally 2x Villagers build House and Mining Camp on Gold
rally 3x Villagers chop individual Straggler Tree close to each other
after gathering 100 Gold send your 2 Villagers from Gold to Stone
rally Villager on to Sheep
at 02:25 send 5x Villagers from Sheep to Stone
at 15x Villagers send remaining Villager from Sheep to Wood. Don't chop more than 3 Straggler Tree in Dark Age
Use the age up interval to scout your opponents base and pre queue villager commands Wood Vils will be sent on to sheep after age up.
excess Wood used to build Farm aim to research Horticulture and Survival Techniques and Professional Scouts and Wheelbarrow as soon as possible
send 7x Villagers from Stone to build Town Center on Deer
send 4x Villagers from Wood to Sheep
rally 3x Villagers to Wood
Your Town Center is completed send building Villager to Deer
research Safe Passage and rally 2x Villagers to Wood and research Sanctuary
send 2x Villagers from Sheep to build 1x Archery Range build Archer
1x Archery Range build Archer and 1x Stable build Horseman and 1x Barracks build Spearman
rally Villager to Stone and Wood

title: 2024 Ayyubids Castle Rush [Beasty]
description: Fast Castle Build Order based on Beasty's March 7th, 2024 guide. Focused on first build order covered in video (delayed production of military units). Be sure to watch video to see different adaptations based on your choices in House of Wisdom and opponent playstyles. Tried to include more info than necessary to help new players to Ayyubid (myself).
author: snoasis
steps: All 6 villagers Villager to berries Berries (2 villagers Villager build mill Mill ). *** Try to not completely exhaust berries. Future age-up will provide bonus to berry bushes that still remain
Send next villager Villager to berries Berries (Build 1 House on the way)
Send next villager Villager to gold Gold (Build mine Mining Camp on the way)
Rally next 3 villagers Villager to gold Gold (Build House of Wisdom House of Wisdom on the way)
Rally villagers Villager to straggler trees Straggler Tree until 4 vills on wood (Need wood for outposts Outpost. Depending on Civ you're playing against, gather enough wood for 1-2 outposts)

Feudal Age Age up to Feudal with appropriate Wing. - Reinforcements Reinforcement (Bonus Military Wing): Good against horse Civs (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP). - Master Smiths Master Smiths: Good against archers Civs. - Growth Growth (Bonus Economic Wing): Save for Castle age up (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP). ----------------------------------------------------------------------. - Logistics Logistics (Bonus Culture Wing): Save for Castle age up if against Civs that prioritize Relics, otherwise, save for Imperial age up. - Advancement Advancement (Bonus Culture Wing): Save for later (when a quick age up can be decisive)
Send wood villagers Wood Villager to stone Stone (One trip provides enough stone (50) to upgrade 1 outpost Outpost )
Rally Rally villagers Villager to food Food. *** Try to not completely exhaust berries. Future age-up will provide bonus to berry bushes that still remain
Send stone villagers Stone Villager back to wood Wood
Send Desert Raider Desert Raider from House of Wisdom House of Wisdom to harass (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP)
Rally villagers Villager to food Food. *** Try to not completely exhaust berries. Future age-up will provide bonus to berry bushes that still remain
Send berry villagers Berries Villager (should be around 7-8) to gold Gold

Castle Age Age up to Castle with appropriate Wing. - Growth Growth (Bonus Economic Wing): Get 8 villagers on age up, best in 90% of scenarios. Rally Rally to berries Berries (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP). - Logistics Logistics (Bonus Culture Wing): Great if against Civs that prioritize Relics. ----------------------------------------------------------------------. - Advancement Advancement (Bonus Culture Wing): Save for when a quick age up can be decisive
Rally villagers Villager to wood Wood until 12 (Build Lumber Camp when necessary)
Get eco upgrades Wheelbarrow + Double Broadax + Specialized Pick. Rally villagers Villager to food Food until 18. ***MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP***
Build Stables x2 Stables Stable
Immediately queue Camel Lancers Camel Lancer and harass
Rally villagers Villager to wood Wood
Build Mosque Mosque (consider building 2) and get relics Relic (1 Relic = 2 Villagers on Gold). ***If opponent is massing units and playing aggressively, prioritize military production buildings
Build blacksmith Blacksmith get appropriate upgrades ( Iron Undermesh + Bloomery + etc)
Upgrade to Veteran Camel Lancers Camel Lancer at stables Stable
Rally villagers Villager to gold Gold
Depending on how the game is being played at this point, prioritize military production Stable Archery Range Barracks or build 2nd Town Center or 3rd TC Town Center Town Center to boom.

If opponent is attacking actively in Feudal with spearman Spearman and archers Archery Range, don't build Camel Lancers Camel Lancer. Instead, build barracks Barracks and Ghulam Ghulam to break out. Add Archery Range Archer Crossbowman to support. Camel Lancers Camel Lancer in general are better because than Ghulam Ghulam because you can more easily harass and keep your opponent on defense. Don't forget to build siege Siege Workshop units, specifically Manjaniq's Manjaniq

title: HRE 2 TC Burgrave - Valdemar
description: Counter: Infantry Civs (Malians. Ottomans, Abbasid)
author: Hetfield90
steps: 3 Villagers Food / 3 Villagers (1 Build House, 2 Build Mining Camp ) then on Gold / Town Center Rally Food
3 Villagers from Gold Build Mining Camp at Stone / 1 Villager from Food to Stone / 2 Villagers from Food to Wood / 2 Villagers from Food Build Aachen Chapel / Town Center Rally Wood
Inspire Food is important
4 Villagers from Stone and 10 Villagers from Wood Build Town Center / 2 Villagers from Aachen Chapel to Wood / Town Center Rally Food
14 who built Town Center,then 4 Villagers to Gold / 10 Villagers to Wood
1st Town Center Rally Food / 2nd Town Center Rally Gold / 2 from Wood build Farm add more from Sheep when enough Wood
2 from Food to Stone and Build House / 1 Villager from Wood Build Mill
if needed add a Outpost and Palisade Wall / add House when reaching pop cap / research Wheelbarrow
2nd Town Center Rally Wood
Use closest villagrs to add what's necessary like House, Outpost, Palisade Wall
8-10 from Food Build Burgrave Palace / 1 from Food Build Blacksmith
Research Iron Undermesh
Get Relics when it's safe / if not safe make units with Burgrave first and protect prelates

title: 1TC Winery + Longbows ->Fast Castle Varangian
author: Koouka95
steps: 5 Villagers on Sheep ( Rally Villager until 7 on Sheep ). 1 Villager build Cistern then House on side of tc opposite Berries.
Rally Villager until 3 on Gold then Rally Sheep until Feudal Age
Drop off resources and build Grand Winery with 4 Sheep Villager on the Berries.
See to the left. Remacro.
Age II Macro:: Put all 8 Villagers Food on Berries next to Grand Winery. Rally 8 total Villager on Wood. Research Wheelbarrow from Grand Winery
1 Villager builds House + Cistern (connect)+ Mercenary House
Get following upgrades when possible Double Broadax Specialized Pick Border Settlements Forestry Horticulture. Get "Western Contract" and Make "Longbows" always when you have 500 Oil.
Start making Olive Grove around Grand Winery towards Town Center for safety.
Go heavy on gold when over 600 Food to get Castle Age. At around 8 mins you should have about 10 Olive Groves. Keep making them as you gather more Wood

When you have a good Olive Grove setup, you go age 3. You should have enough "Longbows" and/or Limitanei to defend aggression. Go up with Golden Horn Tower. Gather with 10+ Villager on Gold when aging. You need a ton of gold for upgrades and units. Prep Blacksmith for upgrades on ageup.
Make Barracks before age 3 to spam Varangian Guard. Gold use:: Veteran Contract Balanced Projectiles Wedge Rivets. Monk for Relic (Produce Monk from Grand Winery ). Add another Cistern for Level 3.
Keep adding Olive Grove and build more Barracks so you can spam Varangian Guard + Longbows

Additional Tips: Use longbows around resources to get vision if you dont have Border Settlements or Outpost up. You want to make Outpost on Berries if they are facing your enemy. Make Outpost on the Gold if no forward Berries. ------------. Be smart about your walling. Dont wall too much to conserve resources. Just wall where necessary to make it easier to defend with only longbows. ------------. In the feudal age, start with a Barracks to make Limitanei vs knight rush civs ( Jeanne d'Arc French Rus Mongols ) then after go into Mercenary House. ------------. +1 and +2 ranged upgrades are insanely important, Your longbows are basically crossbows for dealing with anything living and mechanical (yes, with good splits during fights, you can whittle down mangonels too very quickly). -----------. Consider your timings. You can make a lot of units in castle and push, but when you approach 200/200 it is time for imperial. Another timing is your age 4 Longbowmen upgrade that makes them do serious damage again vs age 3 opponent. Varangian age 4 upgrade is also insane (depending on your numbers)

title: ENG | 1TC | Feudal Aggression | Council Hall
description: Credits to gabrieljustware. I just added my flavour. :) Gameplan: - Build the two farms in the back of TC - Don't rush attack with spear and arch - Slowly add farms with extra wood and depending on how many sheep you got - Build economy to build army and never stop, keeping your enemy in feudal - Try to deny resources with army
author: exe
steps: 2 Villagers Farm in the back of Town Center. 4 Villagers on Sheep. Rally Sheep (until 7)
Build House Mining Camp. Rally Gold (until 3)
Rally Wood (until 3)
Rally Food (until Feudal Age )
Feudal Age with Council Hall with 3 Villagers from Food. Rally Food (until 5)
Build Mill. Rally Wood (until 18)
Build Lumber Camp. Research Wheelbarrow
Build Villager back to Food. Train 2 Longbowmen and Attack. Do not lose your Longbowman. Try to force the opponent into units and turn back
Build Barracks and House with 1 Villager from Wood. Research Double Broadax
Train Spearman Longbowman. Research Horticulture
Build Blacksmith and research Steeled Arrow. Slowly add Farm with extra Wood. Rally Gold (until 5)
Attack with ~5 Spearmen and ~10 Longbowmen and 1 Villager to build Outpost. Continue training Spearman Longbowman. Research Iron Undermesh. Rally Wood (until 18)
Eventually add another Barracks and train Man-at-Arms
Focus on denying Food or Wood. Transition to Castle Age while producing units

title: 兰开斯特-copy（中文版）
description: Simple Build Order - 3 Manors into Rush by Aussie Drongo
steps: 开局 6 Villagers 吃 Sheep 然后生产 3 Villagers 建造1个 Mining Camp 挖 Gold 以及建造 1 House
补3农吃肉 Rally Sheep,准备上本，拉3农金建造地标
3农金建造 Abbey of Kings,建造完成后建造 Manor
上本过程中调配3农肉 Villager 去 Mining Camp Stone
上本过程中调配3农肉 Villager 去 Lumber Camp Wood ，后续补木
补到8农木 Rally Wood
建造地标那3农,再补一个 Manor ，shift回羊
TC集结 Rally Gold ，
当石矿剩余900时候，补一个 Manor
调配2个吃羊 Villager 去挖 Gold
1伐木农拍下 Stable ，侦察对面是什么产能，补 Barracks ，. 马叉可以打马弓，领主可以打叉弓，肉马叉不断，小马骚扰

补 Blacksmith 出骑兵的话,then Iron Undermesh 点远防 Iron Undermesh,then 点近攻 Bloomery. Bloomery 出弓箭手的话点 Steeled Arrow 远攻. 点 Wheelbarrow Double Broadax. 补 Archery Range. 补 Barracks. 补 Archery Range. 4产能不停. 研究科技 Billmen. 补5产能 1马厩 2兵营 2靶场
7.30 就可以出击了 ，小兵质量比较高。. 对面直城可以9.30-10.00左右抓Timing

title: Mongol Mangudai & Khan Hunters BO
author: Tomioka2003
steps: 5 Villagers to Sheep and Rally to Sheep till 7 Villagers. 1 Build Ovoo on Stone
After 7 Villagers on Sheep, Rally to Gold till 3 Villagers. Rally to Sheep till Feudal Age
You can also go 4 if you want to gather wood faster to make Archery Range
Build Deer Stones from 4 Food Villager, Rally on Food till 5 Villagers. Shift 3 Food Villager to Wood
Rally Villager on Wood
Deer Stones Villager go back to Sheep. 1 or 2 Wood Villager Build an Archery Range on Ovoo. Rally Villager on Gold till 5

Villager building Archery Range go back to Wood. Instantly queue 2x Mangudai from Archery Range and harass, also make Khan’s Hunter at some point. NOTE - DO NOT MAKE Mangudai against English. Research Wheelbarrow
Produce Villager on Food. Build a Market and start trading (if the opponent is going Fast Castle you can go two Market and be greedy while harassing the opponent}
Shift 4 Food Villager to Wood to get wood for Venetian Trader
Rally few Villager on Gold. Research Double Broadax
keep Rally on Food (You can shift the Food Villager to other Resources like Wood or Gold depending on what you need the most

Make Blacksmith and research Steeled Arrow or Iron Undermesh. Keep Spamming Mangudai and harass, if the opponent retaliates back with archers make Keshik or Archer since you get buff with Khan and Khan’s Hunter

title: HRE Fast Castle
author: Datrosher
steps: Q 3 Villagers. 3 Villagers Sheep. 2 Villagers Gold Prelate and send back to Food. 1 Villager Build House,then Gold
Rally Food
4 Villagers from Food,then Build Aachen Chapel
From Aachen Chapel 2 Villagers Gold 2 Villagers Food
Prelate Aachen Chapel
1 Villager from Food Build House and Back to Food
2 rounds of Sheep
8 Villagers Build Regnitz Cathedral
Reassign macro Villager
Queu Prelate
Rally Wood
As soon as affordable 1 Villager from Wood Build Stable
Queue Prelate and Royal Knight
Villager Build Regnitz Cathedral go back to Food
8 Villagers from Sheep go to Deer
Survival Techniques
Collect relics
As soon as affordable 2nd Stable with 1 Villager from Food

title: Beasty Season 10 Byzantine
description: Longbows + Limitanai
author: Googles
steps: Make sure Cistern covers Berries
1 Villager House + Mining Camp Gold. 1 Villager Mining Camp Stone. Rally on Sheep until 6
Villager Food Build Cistern. Rally on Gold until 2
Rally on Sheep until Ageup
4 Villagers Food on Grand Winery. 2 Villagers Food on Straggler Tree. Rally on same Straggler Tree
Only need to collect 1 Straggler Tree before moving to woodline. Move all 4 Sheep Villager to Berries slightly before ageup completes
Villager Wood Build Lumber Camp THEN on House
Villager Wood Build Cistern (you wont instantly have stone to connect but will have by the time it finishes building so make sure to micro the vill to build aqueduct)
Ageup finishes (1 villager building Cistern with aqeuduct going back to Wood)
Horticulture + Double Broadax
After 8 Villagers Wood change Rally on Berries. Villager Wood Build Mercenary House THEN Barracks
Western Mercenary Contract for Longbowman production
Villager Stone Build Cistern. Villager Wood Build House
After 13 Villagers Food change Rally on Gold
5 Villagers Wood Build Outpost + Mill on new Berries

title: Abba 4TC into Camel riders
author: Gissa777
steps: Mill Berries #2 Rally Gold Food House of Wisdom House Rally Mining Camp
Rally #6 Wood Mining Camp Stone 6 Wood Rally Stone 150 gold pull off gold
8 Fertile Crescent Fresh Foodstuffs Rally Stone Per 1 Extra TC +2 food, stone villagers make TC #2 and #3
TC 1 Rally Wood, TC 2 Rally Stone, TC 3 Stone or Deer, TC 4 Gold, first rally stone wood after 4 TC rush castle or make units when you scout enemy doing feudal push.
Town Center Stone Town Center Deer Town Center Gold Town Center Golden Age Tier 1
3 Rally Wood 1 Rally Gold
Culture Wing 3x Rally Wood Farm 1x Rally Gold Golden Age Tier 2 Abba vs Abba mirror greed to IMP

+ 5 Stables Blacksmith If enemy has no Abba fight castle otherwise greed IMP

Citty planning upgrade for production speed, Crosscut Saw University Biology Boiling Oil Stable Stable Stable Stable Stable Stable. Keep
Crosscut Saw

title: Byzantines
description: New meta
author: Peen
steps: 5 Villagers to Food and Rally 1 Villager to Food
1 Villager Build House then goes to Stone
Rally 2 Villagers to Gold
1 Villager makes Cistern next to Town Center keep Rally onto Food
once Gold hits 3900 left then take 4 Villagers off Food make Grand Winery next to Berries
3 Villagers from Food to Straggler Tree then Rally to Straggler Tree
once enough Wood build Lumber Camp then send Villager to Wood
take 1 Villager from Gold to Build House
1 Villager from Stone Build Cistern

title: HRE Pro Scouts - Based on Vortix
description: The strongest civ in the game can use Pro Scouts, here is how
author: TyrusLunarspear
steps: So far this is the very basic regular HRE start.
3 Villagers to Sheep. 3 Villagers to Gold (build House + Mining Camp ). Rally to Food until Feudal Age
Once buildings are completed and all Gold Villager are gathering, you send your Prelate to inspire the 3 Villagers ONCE, then back to Food Villager
Aachen Chapel with 4 Food Villager all the way on with 2 tiles between Wood and Town Center Feudal Age
Very important to inspire a second time with the prelate
send 1 Food Villager to Straggler Tree. Rally to Straggler Tree and then to wood-line until you have produces 4 Villagers like this

send your Prelate to inspire the 3 Villagers ONCE, then back to Food Villager (this is the second time we do this in the build order). Send 1 Wood Villager to build Mill next to Berries and then back to wood
I took it from his stream, right here - https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2454295868?t=7818s
Age up Villager go to wood-line. Rally to Sheep
Research Professional Scouts
Send 2 Wood Villager to build a Stable, then to build a Barracks, then back to Wood. When Stable are done, queue up 3 more Scout
Research Survival Techniques and start pro scouting. Don't forget to set the drop point of each of your scouts to the Aachen Chapel.

title: Papercut's 2 TC 2 Manor - Copy for me to understand series
description: Lancaster Castle, Manor, 2nd TC then 2nd manor build from RTS_Papercut Some of the timings corrected with testing - but of course can be a little bit better if executed perfectly than shown here Have fun!
author: murtuk
steps: 6 on Sheep with 1 Build House. Rally to Gold until 3
Now Rally to Sheep until age up
Start Feudal Age Lancaster Castle with 3 Gold vils back to Build Manor. Leave 3 on Food and send others to 5 Stone 1 Wood. Rally Wood
Feudal Age finishes at 4:05. All Wood vils (7 vil) and age upper (3 vil) go build Manor on Wood then gather Wood
1st Manor ready
When having 400 Wood 300 Stone start Build 2nd Town Center. Stop gathering Stone when having 100 extra(700 left on node) (for a 2nd manor)
2nd TC ready, Have at least 5-6 on Food to produce from both TC
Can make 2nd Manor on other resource. Make production buildings and respond to enemy

title: Ottoman Personal
author: Bluesmoke
steps: All Villager To Straggler Tree Then 1 Gold 1 Stone 2 Sheep Then Rally To Food
Once Hit 150 Wood Stone Move Straggler Tree Villager To Food and Build Military School With One Of those Villagers
Send Military School Villager To Gold Then at 3 minute mark upgrade using 4 Food Villager and build Twin Minaret Medrese
Leave Only 4 Villagers On Food Then Send remainder to Straggler Tree and Rally to Straggler Tree
Once Hit 100 Stone Transfer Villager To Gold For 3 total
Once You Hit Feudal take those 4 villagers and put them on Berries and build another Military School and make Sipahi
When you Hit 10 villagers on Wood Rally Back to Sheep and build a Blacksmith and two Stable
Get Horticulture and Double Broadax as soon as possible - Use Vizier Points On Either Field Work or Sheep Option (favor sheep)
Get Black Smith Upgrades With Gold
Keep Building Sipahi and get one Mehter and use its aura (villagers, spears, archers for use case)
When Wanting To Go to Castle Age Grab almost every Wood Villager and move them to gold - choose Mehmed Imperial Armory and make Springald
Upgrade Your Units at this point - collect Relics with Imans (If you feel like it) and move some villagers back to stone (from wood)
Start building more Military School and making Sipahi and Janissary Spend Vizer points on Military Campus Then Advanced Academy or Janissary Company

title: I love China Sm (Pro Scout)
description: The Villager #'s aren't perfect as it can vary based on map/opponent civ/how quickly you can macro - more of just an outline that you can play around with!
author: Yony
steps: Timing/Villager count will vary based on map - if you age up with only 11 on Sheep, just queue 1 more village onto sheep before switching to wood. VERY IMPORTANT: It's essential to place your Mill in an area where it and future Lumber Camp can be influenced by the Imperial Academy as this will be your main source of gold for a bit. Sometimes it's not easy to get all these buildings to fit in one area so honestly just try your best.
5 Villagers to Straggler Tree to collect 50 Wood, then to Sheep, 1 Villager to build Mill behind TC and next to wood line
Once 5 Wood Villager collect 50 wood, 1 Villager to build Village next to Mill, then that Villager to Sheep
Rally Gold until 3, then Rally Sheep until Feudal Age
Age up with 4 Sheep Villager,then Imperial Academy
4 age up Villager will go on Wood, Rally Wood until 12 - Rally to the first tree you chopped down for quick gathering. Gather the Straggler Tree until second Imperial Official pops out

This is the end of the build order, but from here there are many options on how to proceed with the game: 1. Pro Scout into Fast Castle - If you are under ZERO pressure from opponent (i.e. they are playing a fast castle civ), you can remacro onto Food Gold, go Imperial Palace, and make Lancer + Archer or Spearman and Palace Guard + Archer. 2. Feudal All In - You can keep the Stable Imperial Official and pump out Horseman and Archer and just try to end the game right away. 3. Fast Song Dynasty - During Feudal, you can make Barbican of the Sun to get Song Dynasty for Zhuge Nu and Granary and all in this way as well, I usually like to go Song at some point during the game because Zhuge Nu go brr and Granary are crucial in mid-late game once you have run out of deer. Really just go crazy with it idk man i love this civ
Immediately queue Imperial Official until you have 4/4, first will supervise Mill (collect and drop off 40 Gold with first Imperial Official before supervising).

When second Imperial Official pops out, pull all Straggler Tree Villager to make a Lumber Camp and have Imperial Official supervise while building - any Wood the Villager are carrying will be boosted once Lumber Camp is completed
Third Imperial Official can just be left to roam and collect Gold from buildings. Build a Stable ASAP to produce Scout for Professional Scouts
As you approach the 300 Gold needed for Professional Scouts, pull all Gold Villager onto Wood, then Rally Sheep
Fourth Imperial Official will supervise Stable for fast Scout production (make 4-6)
Once Professional Scouts is researched, next upgrade will be Imperial Examinations (Very easy to forget as it's inside the landmark but very important!!!)

title: Fast 2 TC Knights Templar! - copy
description: Flexible fast 2 TC Build order for Knights Templar to either transition into lategame or commit to feudal age!
author: Javert
steps: Age up with 15 Villagers with Age Up Ally of your choice (no impact on BO) Kingdom of France Knights Hospitaller Principality of Antioch
6 Villagers on Sheep
first 2 Villagers build House and Mining Camp on Gold
next 3 Villagers chop individual Straggler Tree close to each other

title: New Player Guide to Golden Horde
description: As basic as possible (it looks scarier than it is!) Golden Horde build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to be aggressive in the Feudal Age with Torguud, Archer & Spear/Kharash while slowly going to the Castle Age. This can be played on any land map against any* civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games! Once you get Castle, you can look to end the game early with the help of Muscovy Yasak +2 ranged armour on your Torguud, MAA, and Rus Tributes, or you can save stone and later go for Barracks Reinforcements which is a huge power-spike where the Golden Horde really becomes a horde. *Against feudal knight civs like French, you will want to alter this build and go Spearmen + Torguud in Feudal instead of massing Archers, even adding in Keshik if they mass their own Archers. Check out Pt2 of the below video for more info.

Optionally instead of Torguud in Castle, you can use Stone for faster Rus Tribute (they get Muscovy Yasak too) or save it for Barracks Reinforcements. Good luck!

title: Zhu Xi | Feudal aggro
description: Super aggressive opener with constant unit production. Works in team games. Put a lot of pressure into the enemy with an easy transition into a full all-in or a Castle age up. I'm kinda of a noob, the guides I write are mostly my experience/intuition and meant for personal use, so take them with a grain of salt.
author: Jockxtar
steps: Don't forget to Collect Tax everytime the Mill accumulates 40 taxes to build the landmarks earlier.
Rally,then Sheep (7). Send 5 Villagers to chop 10 Wood each from Straggler Tree. DON'T DROP Wood ON Town Center! Move Sheep near Berries
Build Mill near Berries with all Villager and Supervise it with Imperial Official before it finishes. This makes them drop off 60 Wood. Rally,then Sheep (7)
Next Villager,then Village,then Mining Camp Gold; then goes mine Gold
Rally,then Gold (3)
Rally,then Wood (12)

Scout groups of resources with Scout for ideal Meditation Gardens placement. Prioritize depending on your strategy: - Feudal aggression: Food,then Wood,then Gold. - Greedy/Long term value: Gold,then Stone,then Food,then Wood
Age up timing will vary a lot depending on how far you build Meditation Gardens. If you want to place it very far away, build it with 2 Villagers instead.
Build Meditation Gardens with 1 Food Villager, later he will go back to Food
Town Center,then 2nd Imperial Official to Collect Tax,then Supervise Wood
With the gold from taxes, research Wheelbarrow
Consider making Palace Guard instead of Spearman to counter Archer and Horseman more efficiently (albeit it's more expensive, but having just a handful can make your frontline quite more durable).
Archery Range ASAP with Wood Villager. Constantly produce Zhuge Nu and Spearman. As you save up Wood, build Barracks and Blacksmith
Third Imperial Official to Collect Tax,then Supervise Blacksmith. Rally,then Gold (5)
After building Archery Range, Barracks and Blacksmith, move 5 Wood,then Food
Research Steeled Arrow,then Iron Undermesh

Option 1: All-in. Rally,then Wood (30); Imperial Official Supervise Archery Range; research Double Broadax and Siege Engineering. Make up to 3 Battering Rams, make sure to replace the ones that get destroyed. Once you accumulate 600 Wood, save some Food and Gold for Jiangnan Tower. After reaching Song Dinasty, make more military buildings and start the farm transition.

Option 2: FC. Rally,then Food (20); Imperial Official Supervise Gold; research Horticulture / Survival Techniques. Keep making units, but only enough to put pressure, you still need to save up Food for Castle Age.
Shaolin Monastery for Shaolin Monk. Excellent at tanking damage for your Zhuge Nu and Crossbowman, but also to pick up Relic
Save some more Food and Gold to build Jiangnan Tower (Song Dinasty) if you haven't already
Gather Wood for Farm

Ideal army: Palace Guard / Shaolin Monk + Zhuge Nu / Crossbowman. Shaolin Monk to tank Crossbowman; Palace Guard to tank everything else. Add Spearman to counter cavalry. Make 2 or 3 Nests of Bees to counter ranged units. Add Horseman to counter Mangonel
Keep gathering Wood for Farm
Try to not loose units, this will be the moment you are at your weakest.

Once you have somewhere around 30 Farms, you should be able to keep a very high production rate and take back the control of the game. Once you stabilize, build Mount Lu Academy to unlock Yuan Dinasty (10% discount on all units) and go to max population. The combination of Yuan Dinasty's discount and the strong farm economy should allow you to constantly trade units with your opponents and win by outproducing them. Get the last upgrades and save for Imperial Age
Temple of the Sun always first, since it gives immediate value. Since your army by this point should be mostly infantry, put it on "Divine Haste" or "Divine Vitality" to get the most out of it.
Ideal army: Imperial Guard + Zhuge Nu + Nest of Bees / Bombard. Add Yuan Raider for raiding and killing siege. Add Shaolin Monk to tank Crossbowman
Once you finish setting up your economy and you get the normal upgrades, build Zhu Xi's Library for the post-late-game upgrades.

Research Dynastic Protectors and then choose between 10000 Bolts or Cloud of Terror. Advanced Administration is not too terrible if you don't have relics and can't trade, but it's very situational and requires good base planning (lots of military buildings surrounding Jiangnan Tower or Town Center ). Roar of the Dragon right now is too weak to even consider giving up on the other options.
Temple of the Sun: "Divine Vitality" when not in combat to heal units. : "Divine Charge" when fighting and raiding. : "Divine Defense" when sieging down keeps.

2 Build Castle Age Villager,then Farm. 4 Build Castle Age Villager,then Sheep. 6 Build Castle Age Villager,then Wood. Queue Knight ASAP and use them to raid and distract the opponent. If you have the King alive, move them together.
Rally,then Wood

Keep adding Farm gradually until you have 5 full packs (total of 40). Then Rally,then Gold until you have 15 Villagers mining. Then Rally,then Wood and keep adding Farm and production buildings.
See to the left. Ideal economy
Production buildings: 2 Barracks; 2 Archery Ranges; 1 Stable. ( The White Tower counts as 2 of any kind)

The goal during Castle Age is to apply a lot of pressure with our superior Food economy to damage our opponent and slow down their scaling while we get ready to go Imperial Age. We can also add Counterweight Trebuchet to finish our opponent if we have a big lead, but going Imperial Age is always ideal with English.
Remember to research Network of Citadels at The White Tower / Keep
TL;DR: If ahead: Wynguard Palace. If tied or behind: Berkshire Palace

Wynguard Palace: If you have secured map control in Castle Age and have access to Gold, this landmark will allow you to snowball the game and to compete with the strongest late game civilizations toe to toe. Berkshire Palace: If things are tied, this landmark is super good at securing map control and key resources. Also, if you are behind and at risk of getting all-in by your opponent, this landmark will save you.

Army composition: Man-at-Arms / Wynguard Footmen + Longbowman / Wynguard Ranger. Add Horseman and Mangonel vs Crossbowman. Add Crossbowman / Handcannon Ashigaru vs Knight. Add Spearman vs Knight + Crossbowman armies
Immediately research Enclosures. Prioritize Longbowman and Man-at-Arms elite upgrades.
Build University: Elite Army Tactics,then Incendiary Arrows,then Silk Bowstrings
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production balance: 10 Barracks; 10 Archery Ranges; 5 Stables; 3 Siege Workshops
Push forward slowly while building Outpost and Keep, slowly creeping closer and closer to the enemy base, so that you always benefit from the bonus attack speed.

After researching Incendiary Arrows and Silk Bowstrings at University, Longbowman / Wynguard Ranger counter siege units, even Mangonel, and their high base damage makes them quite competent against cavalry and armored units as well.

title: OOTD Early Pressure into Swabia Boom
description: [JUST BEGINNING TO WRITE THIS GUIDE, IT IS NOT NEARLY COMPLETE!] -OOTD's early boom is slower than HRE's, mainly because of lesser worker boost (25% instead of 40%) and Aachen Chapel also only fills to 35% instead of 40%) -But OOTD still has the most broken lategame booming tool called the Palace of Swabia. The weird part about this landmark is, if you boom towards it with 2-3 TCs, then you already won't really need the Villager printing anymore, or at least not as much. So the best way to go about it is a slow boom, where you keep building Villagers at all time fromt 1 TC and get all eco upgrades as early as possible. -You use all your excess resources (that are not used for increasing eco) for units, to pressure your opponent and starving him of the possibility of booming himself. -The advantage of this is, that you can catch greedy or unprepared opponents off guard with your early Horsemen and Archers and even get quick wins. -What you should do when you are ahead: --Only if you can finish him for sure, go for Rams and finish him. --If you're not sure if you can finish him, pull back, stop unit production and quickly get to the next Age + veterancy upgrades before resuming your pressure. -What you need to focus on: --Do not lose units, pull them back before they die. -The Gilded Horsemen are to be seen as Early Knights and can take on those pretty much 1:1 but with the added bonus of being 20% faster than Knights.

Spearman vs Gilded Archer: 14/16/18 Hits. Horseman vs Gilded Horseman: 25/28/32 Hits. Horseman vs Gilded Archer: 7/7/8 Hits. Gilded Horseman vs Archer: Gilded Horseman vs Spearman: Gilded Horseman vs Horseman: Gilded Archer vs Archer: Gilded Archer vs Spearman: Gilded Archer vs Horseman:
If opponent builds Spearmen, build as many Gilded Archer as possible and use them in the middle and use your Gilded Horseman as flank raiders. Careful to not let your Horsemen fight Spearmen.

Castle Age. Normally go Burgrave Palace to build cheap Gilded Landsknecht, because all of his (non-siege) counter Units to your Gilded Horseman + Gilded Archer are melee (namely Spearmen, Horsemen, MAA, Knights) and will take heavy cleave blows from your Landsknechte. Only go Regnitz Cathedral if you have a lot of deeply wounded Gilded Units while clicking up, so you can build 1-2 Monks to quickly heal them up and resume your pressure before your opponent has time to add a TC or Landmark.

-- Dealing with Archer counters (Siege and Unique) --. VS Mangonel: Mangonels are much less of a problem as for other Archer Civs (more HP, fewer UnitS), but they are still dangerous. The obvious luxury choice is building a few Springald, but if you can't afford it just try to dive them with your Gilded Horseman and split the Gilded Archer. VS Malian/Byzantine Javelin Thrower: Possibly the nastiest Unit to play against with t his style. You need to dive them with your Gilded Horseman. But if he is any good, he will have Donsos/Limitanei inside of his Javelins, so you need to try to snipe most of them with the Gilded Archer first before diving in and resetting the Javelin count. These two matchups are most likely slightly unfavored.

-- Dealing with Horseman counters (Unique) --. VS Abbasid/Ayyubid Camels: A main nuisance is their Camel Unease debuff, so if there are only a few Camel Units mixed in, try to focus them to remove the -20% damage debuff on all your Gilded Horseman. If they mass Camel Units, consider the following adaptations: VS Camel Riders / Camel Rider,then add in Gilded Landsknecht / Gilded Crossbowman. VS Camel Raider,then focus them with Gilded Archer. VS Camel Archer,then focus them with Gilded Archer + Gilded Horseman. VS Janissary: Focus them with the Gilded Archer. If the path is clear, also dive in with the Gilded Horseman and they will trade quite well, but never fight anything else than the Janissaries with your Horsemen while in their range.

Lastly, another OOTD counter is Japanese, because of their Buddhist Monks that can half your Units' DPS. But this is not as much of a problem for our Gilded Horseman + Gilded Archer style, since they are smaller Units. But an OOTD player going for Gilded Knight / Gilded Handcannoneer / Gilded Landsknecht is in big trouble if they bring in these Monks. Just snipe their Monks and try to fall back until the debuffs have fallen off. If you can't avoid the fight, shuffle the debuffed Units to the front so they die first, so you lose less DPS.

See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:

Make a big army, fight a lot with your opponent before they can set up their economy and slowly grab Relic and capture Sacred Site. Our goal now is to slow down the game to get Vizier Point until our economy is strong enough to go Imperial Age comfortably.

Vizier Point Advanced Academy,then *,then Siege Crews. *For the 4th Vizier Point, you can choose any upgrade you want, but it's too early to really benefit from Siege Crews, so leave that one for last. My recommendations: - Mehter Drums increases your army movement speed, which is tremendously useful in team games (large maps). - Janissary Company can help you turn around a complicated situation or get an edge over the opponent's army and start a snowball effect. - Pax Ottomana on 1 Town Center is helpful, but not that great. On 2 Town Centers though, it's a massive boost that allows you to reach optimal Villager count just as quickly as if you had started the game with the additional Town Center.
Istanbul Observatory: Always the best choice. Sea Gate Castle: Only if you desperately need to protect your base from an incoming all-in OR if you are trading (which we are not doing in this guide).

Army composition: Man-at-Arms + Sipahi + Janissary + Mehter + Great Bombard. OR (vs Lancer + Archer ). Spearman + Lancer + Crossbowman + Mehter + Mangonel. Add Ribauldequin if enemy is making melee units only
Upgrade Sipahi to elite. If enemy is not making a lot of Archer, also upgrade Janissary to elite and research Janissary Guns. Otherwise upgrade Crossbowman to elite.
University: Biology (,then Incendiary Arrows ),then Elite Army Tactics,then Chemistry,then Siege Works. Incendiary Arrows only if you are making Crossbowman instead of Janissary
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this: Once you have a good bank of resources, you can delete Villager thanks to Military School free units.
Production balance: 5 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 5 Stables; 2 Siege Workshops

Once you are close to max population, gather a lot of Wood and do the Farm transition. You can keep reinforcing your army slowly thanks to Military School and Mehmed Imperial Armory, so the impact should be lower than for other civilizations.

Another scenario are maps with fishing, which allows you to age up faster with culture wing. Go military wing against strong early aggression like against Ottomans or English. title: S11-适合新手的神罗教程
description: 目标是建立一个平衡的军队（1-1-1）在封建时代和攻击。这可以在任何陆地地图上对抗任何文明，让你在任何游戏中站稳脚跟，然后从那里出发。也适用于团队游戏！ 完成以下构建后，有两个推荐的选择： 1. 全力以赴！增加产量，制造MAA，从Meinwerk获得攻城工程，这样你就可以用你的步兵制造公羊，并通过增加农场或把它们放在鹿或浆果上来保持你的食物村民的工作。 2. 去城堡时代吧！让更多的村民去挖黄金，城堡时代选择伯格雷夫宫。一旦上升，升级你现有的单位和压倒你的对手与超级升级的MAA（+2远程装甲，双手武器，重型狼牙棒和+50%的充电伤害从Burgrave本身！） 一旦你对这个构建感到舒适，寻找更高级和最佳的构建顺序。HRE非常多才多艺，几乎可以用任何方式玩，特别是有一个非常强大的快速城堡。试试亚琛教堂和/或雷格尼茨大教堂地标-它们有点难用，但非常坚固，而且很有趣。我建议你去看看一个专业玩家最近的构建指令指南视频。Beastyqt和Valdemar是两个不错的选择。

title: HRE On Enlightened Horizon
description: The optimal start to Enlightened Horizon requires us to build an early barracks, capture the merchant camp and go destroy the wolves den. While rather straight forward, for HRE the build order looks somewhat different, since the wolf den is not enough for them to age up. I've made this build specifically for HRE specifically on this map, and it allows you to start researching Pro Scouts only 15 seconds after the normal time you would with a regular build order, only here you already have a barracks and 3 spears.
author: TyrusLunarspear
steps: 5 Villagers to Straggler Tree. Send Scout to the merchant camp, with 1 Villager. Queue up Villager and Rally to Sheep until there are 8 in total (this happens at about minute 01:25)

Make sure your Scout is standing in the capture range until the Villager arrives. When it does, build a House and queue up a Barracks. Make sure the villagers stays inside the capture zone while building. He will finish capturing by the time the barracks is built.
Take 3 Villagers from Straggler Tree once they deposit Wood once and send them to Sheep
The Villager on the merchant camp goes to Sheep, Queue up a Spearman, build 3 in total

Rally to Gold, next Villager to come out of Town Center will also build a Mining Camp. By now the 2 Straggler Tree Villager probably finished gathering from it, make sure they go to another nearby Straggler Tree.
Once you collected enough Wood to build all 3 Spearmen, Mining Camp and a second House, you will send Villager on Straggler Tree to Gold. Make sure you build the second House. Rally to Sheep
Start attacking the wolves den. Once the two wolves pop out, draw them away with 1 of your Spearman, leaving 2 to attack. Your Scout should have returned by this point.
The wolf den should now be burning, and you should have enough resources to age-up with Aachen Chapel. Send 6 Food Villager to build it.
This is a good time to check if you opponent also started with a barracks. If no, you can easily kill their wolves den and capture their merchant camp.
send 1 Food Villager to the cut down Straggler Tree. Rally to Straggler Tree and then to wood-line until you have produces 4 Villagers like this
Send 1 Food Villager to build a Mill on Berries. You should have a surplus of Food to allow this downtime.
Remacro, the split is noted to the left. Rally to Sheep
Research Professional Scouts
Send 2 Wood Villager to build a Stable. When Stable are done, queue up 3 more Scout
Research Survival Techniques and start pro scouting. Don't forget to set the drop point of each of your scouts to the Aachen Chapel.

author: Tags
steps: - Build Twin Minaret right next to TC but not too close to berries, so workers on Minaret are not in rage of berries. - Do not build it in the place where you will place military buildings. Twin Minaret can support 5 Villagers. When Horticulture researched, reduce it to 4 Villagers, when Fertilization researched, reduce them to 3 Villagers or just keep 4 all the time to make it easier
Start: 5 Villagers Stone 1 Villager Sheep Food. Rally TC to food until 9 Villagers Sheep Food. Goal is to get 50 stone mined

Move 5 Villagers Stone to Wood (until 50 wood). Move 2 Villagers Sheep Food to build Military School. Wood villagers are then moved to food, workers that were building military school too and one of them builds house

Move 5 Villagers Wood to Sheep Food. When military school is finished,then 1 Villager from Military School builds House. 1 Villager from House goes to Sheep Food (so there will be 9 vills on food). Change TC rally point to Gold until 3 Villagers. Our target at this stage is to have 9 food and 3 gold vills
When 9 Villagers Sheep Food and 3 Villagers Gold (until 200 gold). Rally TC to food until age up
When 200 Gold move 3 Villagers Gold to Wood
Age up with Twin Minaret Medrese with 4 Villagers from Sheep Food
During age up, move 4 Villagers Sheep Food to Wood and build Lumber Camp. Rally TC to Wood until 8. Chop 2 Straggler Tree next to TC
1 Villager Wood builds House then moves to build Mining Camp at Stone. When 2 trees chopped, move 5 Villagers Wood to Stone

5 Villagers from age up stay on Twin Minaret Medrese (see more above about villagers on Minaret). Switch Military School to Sipahi and harras. Move 4 Villagers from Sheep Food to Wood. Rally TC to Stone until 650 Stone for 2TC. 350 stone is for 2TC and 300 is for military schools
Build 2TC with 8 Villagers Stone near Gold. Rally TC to wood

When 650 Stone move Villager Stone to Wood and Sheep Food. Workers that were building 2TC go to Gold. Rally TC to food. Rally 2TC to gold. Target at this stage is to have 8 on wood, 8 on gold and rest on food with TC rally point to food
1 Villager Wood builds Military School and Blacksmith. Get Wheelbarrow and Double Broadax. Build House. Then get Horticulture and Iron Undermesh

What to do next. - We can age up to Castle (with 8 villagers). or. - Stables and knights. or. - barracks, archer ranges and MAA (we do not want to produce janissaries until enemy has cavalry). or. - if opponent has cavalry we want to age up and get janissaries. or. - get relics
Vizier points. With first Vizier Point we get sheeps, so we can place 2TC on gold because we have safe food. With second Vizier Point we get +1 military schools

Vs some civs. English Do not go military school that soon if you play against English and instead age up quicker. Rus If against Rus - you can kill him some wolfs with spearman to deny bounty. French Jeanne d'Arc Be annoying at their gold with spearman. Abbasid Dynasty Be annoying at gold and stone. Knight civs ( Jeanne d'Arc French Rus ). - When we age up, we make barracks and upgrade spearman to defend

title: BeastyQT Castle Rush with HRE in Season 6 AOE4 - import
description: A guide to help with HRE castle rushing in Season 6 by BeastyQT
author: Ehounds
steps: 3 Villagers on food and 3 on gold ASAP. Prelate moved to inspire ALL gold Villager and then immediately back to inspire food. First new Villager will build House then Rally Sheep.
should be able to Feudal Age here. Once you have 8 Villagers on Food, Rally Straggler Tree then Wood.
Feudal Age Aachen Chapel with 4 Food Villager and Rally them back to Food. Focus on food/wood for Aachen Chapel placement.
After we have found a good spot to place Aachen Chapel, Rally to Straggler Tree and move 1 Food Villager to Straggler Tree. Shift rally to Wood next to chapel.
Once we get 6 Wood Villager, have 1 Gold Villager build an Outpost on Gold. Then Town Center Rally Food. Have 1 Wood Villager put down another House. Then back on Wood.

Prelate goes inside Aachen Chapel as age up is finished. Rally Gold until we have 5 on Gold. Then Rally Food. 4 Wood Villager will go straight to Stone. DO NOT BUILD A MINING CAMP. They will complete ONE mining cycle and then Rally Food. 2 Wood Villager will build a Stable / Barracks OR build a 2nd Outpost to cover your resources. Don't do both at this time. Then back to Wood.

By this time our Stone Villager will have finished one cycle of mining and will go on Food. Our 2 Villagers that were building Barracks / Stable OR 2nd Outpost will go back on Wood. If we built Military Buildings, make 3-5 spearmen but don't go crazy. Remember our goal is to leave Feudal Age asap and the longer we are fighting we worse our odds of winning. Get Arrowslits for your towers. Build a Mill at Berries and a Lumber Camp for upgrades.
These are the numbers we are trying to end Feudal Age with.

Castle Age Regnitz Cathedral with 8 Food Villager. Then Town Center Rally Wood. It is now that we will start getting our economy upgrades. start with Double Broadax and Specialized Pick. Make Blacksmith and Market so you can buy food to age up if needed. Start making Prelate to head to Relic so you can grab them once the age up starts.

START GETTING RELICS Relic as soon as you hit Castle Age! Sacred Site too if you can. Keep Town Center Rally Wood.Start looking to get Forestry, Wheelbarrow and Military Academy.Focus on getting Food however you can. Start building Farm with excess wood, but if Deer are accessible grab them too.

Play and adapt. Build whatever other military buildings you need. The best army to go as HRE as you hit Castle Age are Knight as there is a good chance no one else has age 3 knights at this time in the game. Use your discretion however, as we are almost always going to be using Man-at-Arms as our late game comp as that is our best unit once fully upgraded.

Keep a few Villager on Gold, hopefully getting some from Relic and Sacred Site. Get any unit upgrade as needed and your remaining economy upgrades. Try to get to Imperial Age before 16:00 minutes if possible and good luck!

title: CrackedyHere Zhu Xi's Legacy Song Dynasty and 5:10 2TC

steps: Scout needs to look around base a little bit to look for good spots for Meditation Gardens (not included in video, described further in the step at 2:15). Note that Zhu Xi's Legacy starts with 5 villagers, 1 scout, and 1 Imperial Official.
4 Villagers,then Berries
1 Villager,then Build Mill (on Berries ). One villager builds a mill on the berries.
3 Sheep,1 Imperial Official,then Mill. Move the three sheep to the mill and make the Imperial Official supervise the mill.
6 Villagers,then Sheep. Mill should be finishing up. First produced villager and all other villagers (6 total) start collecting the sheep at the mill.
Rally x2,then Gold. Villager,then House,then Mining Camp. Rally next two villagers to gold. The first one will make a house then a mining camp at the gold.
Rally x3,then Sheep. Rally next 3 villagers to sheep at the mill

Mill Villager,then Mill,then Sheep. Imperial Official,then Mill Gold,then Town Center,then Mill. Force dropoff of all villagers to the mill and make them go back to sheep. After this, have the imperial official grab the gold from the mill, drop off at the Town Center, then resume supervision of the mill.
Rally,then Wood. Rally villagers to wood on the treeline. The first one will make a lumber camp at 2:20, and the rally will stay on wood until the 3:40 step.

1 Mill Villager,then Meditation Gardens. One of the sheep villagers from the mill should build the Meditation Gardens landmark. If you get a berry patch, you only need 3 villagers on food. Ideally you want berries, stone, and wood to make the second TC the fastest. If you can't, then try for stone and wood.
New Villager,then Lumber Camp Wood. The next villager that comes out will build a lumber camp on the wood. This is the first of two villagers rallied to wood.

Mill Villager,then Mill,then Sheep. Imperial Official,then Mill Gold,then Town Center,then Mill. Force dropoff of all villagers to the mill and make them go back to sheep. After this, have the imperial official grab the gold from the mill, drop off at the Town Center, then resume supervision of the mill.

2x Villagers Mining Camp Gold,then Wood. Two villagers from gold can dropoff and head to wood. Between this final dropoff that should be happening around now (~140 gold) and future tax income, you should be able to have enough gold for the second landmark later on.

Mill Villager,then Mill,then Sheep. Imperial Official,then Mill Gold,then Lumber Camp Gold,then Town Center,then Mining Camp Stone. Force dropoff of all villagers to the mill and make them go back to sheep. After this, have the imperial official grab the gold from the mill, AND the lumber camp this time, drop off at the Town Center, then send to supervise the mining camp for stone built in the next step.
Rally,then Stone
3x Villagers Sheep,then Build Mining Camp. 2x Villagers Sheep,then Stone. Move 5 villagers off of sheep to the stone. Three build a mining camp on stone, two start mining stone.

1x Villager Meditation Gardens,then Stone. After the Meditation Gardens finish, move that villager that was building them onto stone. NOTE: If you don't have berries in range of Meditation Gardens, you'll need to leave 4 on sheep instead of 3.
2x Villagers Wood,then Jiangnan Tower. Two villagers from wood build the Jiangnan Tower landmark

3x Villagers Mining Camp,then Stone. Imperial Official,then Mining Camp Stone. Mining camp on stone finishes. The villagers building it should now be mining stone. The Imperial Official should be supervising the stone mining camp.
Rally,then Jiangnan Tower. Start rallying villagers to build the Jiangnan Tower
Rally,then Sheep. Villager Jiangnan Tower,then Sheep. Start rallying to sheep and send the villagers building the Jiangan tower to sheep as well.

7x Villagers Stone,then Mining Camp,then Build Town Center. Depending on your Meditation Gardens, you should have the resources for second TC now. Force your 7 stone villagers to dropoff and then build a second TC.
Make appropriate production building(s) next, and keep in mind the Jiangnan Tower will be spawning a villager from creating the TC and units from building any production buildings.

title: Zhu Xi's Legacy - Pro Scouts Opener

author: Myriad
steps: 5 starting Villager go to the closest Straggler Tree (straggler tree) beside your Town Center and start chopping it.

When the 5 Villagers gathered 10 Wood each, select them (use box select, or Ctrl + Click on 1), along with your new 6th Villager and build a Mill BEFORE they drop off at the TC, one tile away from your Town Center. Quickly select your Imperial Official and Supervise the Mill before the Villager s finish building it. Meanwhile, bring your starting Sheep close to the Mill
7th Villager builds Village towards Gold then Mining Camp.

Re- Rally your Town Center to Sheep.
Collect tax from Mill using Imperial Official when at or close to 40. Drop off at Town Center then Supervise Mill again.

Keep only 5 Villagers on Sheep excess goes to previously half chopped Straggler Tree. Re- Rally Town Center to Straggler Tree
Build Lumber Camp on Wood line with all Straggler Tree Villager when you have 50. Re- Rally Town Center to Wood line.
Que up additional Imperial Official to train after your next Villager that comes out around 3:00.
2nd IO collects taxes from Mill and Mining Camp then Supervises Lumber Camp.

- The hardest part of the build order is the 2nd step, when you have to quickly place the Mill without the Villager dropping off the Wood at the Town Center whilst rapidly Supervising the Mill blueprint before the Villager drop off food at it. Practice in AI Skirmish is recommended. - The best resource combination to get with Meditation Gardens is Berries and Gold. If have the option of getting 3 other resources instead of just Berries and Gold, you should opt for that. More resources are better. Sometimes you can't get both Berries and Gold, in which case, go for at least Food and something else, or Gold and something else. <b on DO NOT</b on go too far on the map for Meditation Gardens. If you go slightly far, it's better to age up with 3 Villagers. <b on ** Make sure to fix all of the scouts drop off location to the Mill instead of the Town Center. **. GLHF. </b on
2 Meditation Gardens Villager go to Wood. Wood Imperial Official collects more taxes. Re- Rally Town Center to Food Sheep.
When you have 75 Wood and 275 Gold, research Professional Scouts. When you have another 150 Wood, 1 Wood Villager builds Stable.
Idle Imperial Official Supervises Stable. Produce as many Scout as necessary, and start bringing in Deer. Research Survival Techniques.

From here, make production buildings for units to counter whatever units your opponent is making. The least you will need is 1-2 Horsemen to be annoying, sometimes you might need Zhuge Nu against Spears and sometimes Spearman against Knights. Go Castle Age when you have secured most of the deer.

GENEL BİLGİ. -Sürekli olarak Sipahi üretmek istiyoruz. Oyunun en güçlü hafif atlısıdır. -Kaynaklar artmaya başladığı zaman öncelikle ekonomi geliştirmeleri ve askeri geliştirmeleri almak istiyoruz. - Blacksmith etkisinde bulunan yapılar çağlara göre %20, %30 ve %40 daha hızlı üretim yapar. Imperial Age 'a Istanbul Observatory ile çıkıldıysa bu etki %100 olur. Bu hızlı üretim etkisi. Military School ve Mehmed Imperial Armory yapılarını da etkiler. Daha hızlı şekilde daha fazla ücretsiz birim üretmemizi sağlar. -Oyun sonu ordumuz Sipahi + Janissary + Great Bombard şeklinde olmalıdır. ASKERİ OKUL. - Dark Age 'da sadece Spearman üretebiliyor. - Feudal Age 'da Sipahi veya Archer ürettiriyoruz. Sipahi, Food ağırlıklı olduğu için Food korumamızı sağlıyor ama üretmesi çok uzun sürmesi dezavantaj oluyor. Wood az bulunan haritalarda Archer tercih ediyoruz. - Castle Age 'da rakip Feodal Çağdaysa veya Spearman ağırlıklı orduya sahipse Man-at-Arms iyi tercih. Zırhlı birimler getiriyorsa Crossbowman iyi tercih. Advanced Academy puanını aldıktan sonra Janissary iyi tercih. Lancer çok yavaş çıktığı için tercih etmiyorum ama üretilebilir. - Imperial Age 'da Janissary hem atlı birimlere ekstra vurması hem de genel hasarı yüksek olması sebebiyle en iyi seçenek. - Mehter saniye/kaynak olarak diğerlerinden daha verimlidir. Oyun sonu 1 Military School, Mehter üretiminde bırakılabilir. TOPHANE-İ AMİRE. - Castle Age 'da rakip ordusu ağırlıklı olarak yakın dövüşçü yayalardan oluşuyorsa ( Spearman, Man-at-Arms vb.) Springald üretmeliyiz. Herhangi menzilli birim ağırlıklıysa Mangonel üretmeliyiz. - Imperial Age 'da Great Bombard üreteceğiz. VEZİR PUANLARI. -Puanları öğrenene kadar, Field Work ⮞ Military Campus ⮞ Advanced Academy ⮞ Janissary Company ⮞şeklinde alabilirsiniz. - Field Work 2 Imams Kale Çağına çıktığımızda hızlı bir şekilde Relic toplamamız için alınması şart. - Anatolian Hills Food kaynaklarımız yetersiz, korunaksız olduğu durumlarda tercih edilebilir. - Mehter Drums Mehterlere, askerleri hızlandırma özelliği verdiği için Horse Archer, Mangudai, Camel Archer gibi birimleri yakalamak için kullanılabilir. - Military Campus ve Advanced Academy Askeri okulları güçlendirdiği için her oyun almayı istiyoruz. - Siege Crews Kuşatma ağırlıklı oynadığımız maçlarda, kuşatma makinelerini güçlendirdiği için iyi bir tercihdir. - Janissary Company ve Anlık asker üretip kendimizi savunmak veya oyunu bitirmek için kullanılabilir. - Trade Bags Ticaret yaptığımız maçlarda %40 altın gelirini arttırdığı için alınması şarttır. - Pax Ottomana 2 Şehir Merkezi kurduysak ve anlık Villager sayısını yükseltmek istiyorsak alınabilir. - Extensive Fortifications Rakip Kale Çağına geçtiyse ve zırhlı birimler getiriyorsa kendimizi savunmak için alınabilir. Veya takım oyunlarında ticaret kuruluysa ve Sea Gate Castle ile İmparatorluk Çağına geçtiysek ticaret yollarına daha ucuza ve daha güçlü Keep 'ler kurmak için alınabilir.

Feudal Age geçtik. Önceliğimiz Lancer üretmek ve 2 Imams ile Relic toplamak. 10-15 tane Lancer üreterek haritayı kontrol etmeye çalışacağız ve Imam 'ları koruyacağız. Relic topladıktan sonra Sipahi üretmeye geri dönmeli ve Gold 'ı başka birimler için harcamalıyız.

Mehmed Imperial Armory 'den,rakip ordusu ağırlıklı olarak yakın dövüşçü yayalardan oluşuyorsa ( Spearman, Man-at-Arms vb.) Springald üretmeliyiz. Herhangi menzilli birim ağırlıklıysa Mangonel üretmeliyiz.
Rakip ağırlıklı Man-at-Arms 'den oluşuyorsa Sipahi + Crossbowman üretmek istiyoruz. Geriye kalan tüm ordulara karşı en güçlü ordumuz Sipahi + Janissary şeklinde olacaktır.
Açılış burada bitiyor. Buradan sonrasında oyunun durumuna göre kararlar almanız gerekiyor. Fırsatını buldukça Military School kurmalıyız ve ücretsiz kuşatma makineleriyle rakibe baskı oluşturmalıyız.

Build Villager,then Build Blacksmith
Build Villager,then Build Barracks

10 Sheep Villager,then Castle Age

Mehmed Imperial Armory: 是标准配置，适用于所有情况，包括建造顺序、对战、地图、队伍组成……始终是不错的选择。. Istanbul Imperial Palace: 仅在可交易的地图或进行双线作战时效果更佳。这样，你可以玩得更贪婪，用 Janissary Company /获得一些免费单位进行防守，同时还能剩下一些 Vizier Point 用于更重要的升级，例如 Military Campus 、和 Advanced Academy 。 Siege Crews Trade Bags

Produce 1 Mehter on Stable and then Sipahi or Spearman to defend
Research Horticulture / Survival Techniques
请记住， Steeled Arrow 升级不会影响 Janissary

不停地生产 Lancer ，并 Mehter 加速 Vizier Point 1。. 如果有多余的 Food ，也生产 Man-at-Arms / 。暂时延迟升级。 Spearman

Town Center Rally,then Food (40)
如果敌人有很多 Archer ，则产生 Crossbowman 和 Lancer 而不是 Janissary 和 Sipahi
Production buildings: 1 Barracks; 2 Archery Ranges; 2 Stables; 4 Military Schools
一旦达到350 Stone ， Town Center 就在基地后方建造第二层，以保护未来的 Farm 部署。理想情况下，最好靠近 Wood 。
See to the left. 理想的经济平衡应该是这样的：

Make a big army, fight a lot with your opponent before they can set up their economy and slowly grab Relic and capture Sacred Site. Our goal now is to slow down the game to get Vizier Point until our economy is strong enough to go Imperial Age comfortably.

Vizier Point Advanced Academy,then *,then Siege Crews. *对于第四个 Vizier Point ，您可以选择任何您想要的升级，但现在真正受益还为时过早 Siege Crews ，所以把它留到最后。我的建议：. - Mehter Drums 提高您的军队移动速度，这在团队游戏（大型地图）中非常有用。. - Janissary Company 可以帮助您扭转复杂的局面或获得对敌方军队的优势并开始滚雪球效应。. - Pax Ottomana 1 Town Center 有帮助，但不是那么好。然而，在 2 上，它是一个巨大的提升，可以让您像在游戏开始时使用额外的 一样快速 Town Center 达到最佳数量。 Villager Town Center
Istanbul Observatory: Always the best choice. Sea Gate Castle: Only if you desperately need to protect your base from an incoming all-in OR if you are trading (which we are not doing in this guide).
Upgrade Sipahi to elite. If enemy is not making a lot of Archer, also upgrade Janissary to elite and research Janissary Guns. Otherwise upgrade Crossbowman to elite.
University: Biology (,then Incendiary Arrows ),then Elite Army Tactics,then Chemistry,then Siege Works. Incendiary Arrows only if you are making Crossbowman instead of Janissary
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this: Once you have a good bank of resources, you can delete Villager thanks to Military School free units.
Production balance: 5 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 5 Stables; 2 Siege Workshops

Once you are close to max population, gather a lot of Wood and do the Farm transition. You can keep reinforcing your army slowly thanks to Military School and Mehmed Imperial Armory, so the impact should be lower than for other civilizations.

title: Learning RTS - English Team Games - Mass Longbow Feudal Attack
description: This build is for players new to the RTS Genre. The build is specifically made to eliminate excessive fiddling within your economy typical of higher level builds. This simplifies the macro-management and allows the player to learn to rotate between their base, scout, and army by giving them simple numbers to hit for their macro. The intended play style is as follows - team games feudal ram push only, ideally with three players. One experienced player should be a cavalry civ, next experienced player should be in charge of rams and melee units, and the new RTS player should use this build to mass longbows and support the ram rush. Ideally, the new player shouldn't have to make and control spears or rams in order to eliminate complexity. The goal is to boil the game down to an enjoyable loop with a strong enough attack that the new player is contributing and can therefore enjoy the game. I would recommend 40 to 50 games using this BO while mastering the basics of the RTS Genre. It's critical to be rotating between your 1) economy, 2) scout, and 3) army **consistently** while executing this build order, as it will form the foundation by which you will approach RTS and especially AoE4 specifically. As a rule of thumb for new players: Each VILLAGER produces approximately 40 of ANY RESOURCE PER MINUTE without upgrades. With upgrades the number can push north of 50 resources per minute.
