steps: Please note: rally numbers for Villager are simplified in this portion of the game for new players to reduce friction. This is also why instructions are extra specific.
Start 6 Villagers on Sheep. Build a House next to Town Center with 1 Villager. Shift-click the building Villager back to Sheep
Rally 2 Villagers to Sheep
Rally 3 Villagers to Gold. The rally should be shift-clicked through a Mining Camp on your Gold
Rally 3 Villagers to Wood. The rally should be shift-clicked through a Lumber Camp on your Wood. Look to bring your Scout back around this time with the Sheep you found.
Age to Feudal Age with Council Hall using 3 Villagers from your Sheep. Shift-click these villagers back to sheep.
Keep Villager Rally on Wood while ageing up to Feudal Age with Council Hall
Build House with 1 Villager from Wood
Finish ageing up to Feudal Age, 3 Villagers go back to Sheep

Keep BALANCING your economy and producing Longbowman and press the attack. As you repeatedly execute this build order, your goal is to build intuition for how to balance your economy. This understanding is critical in carrying your gameplay to the next level and and building towards whatever you are trying to do in each of your games.
Research Double Broadax from your Lumber Camp as soon as you hit Feudal Age

Keep 2 Villagers queued up in your Town Center at any given time. Use rest of your Food to continuously produce Longbowman from your Council Hall and Rally within your base. HOTKEY YOUR PRODUCTION! Build Blacksmith with 1 Villager from Wood

Take 1 Villager from Sheep and build a Mill and 1 Farm as close as possible to your Town Center with enough room to be able to make 8 Farms around it. **IMPORTANT** - If you ended up getting less that 6 Sheep in the beginning of the game, you need need to take villagers that would be gathering from sheep and build Farm with them instead. You will have to build House sooner now due to Longbowman production. Don't get pop capped!
You should have around 6-8 Longbowmen. Move out of your base to harass under supervision of your Scout. Research Horticulture from your Mill. Research Steeled Arrow from your Blacksmith

Keep Villager Rally on Wood until you reach 13 villagers on Wood. This is our magic number for Feudal: 8 Food 13 Wood 3 Gold. We will still keep our Villager Rally on Wood. From here on out, anything beyond 13 villagers should be redistributed to other resources, starting with building more Farm s near your Mill. Continue the Longbowman production. If you have control of the map, change the Rally of the Longbowman to reinforce just behind your units attacking the enemy.

***CRITICAL LEARNING STEP***: BALANCING your Wood rallied Villager. Continuously OBSERVE your Food and Wood as you keep producing more Longbowman. Which resource are you banking so much that you can't even spend it? At this point in the game, you will come up extra on Wood. That means you add more Farm. If your food is climbing too fast, then you keep your Villager on Wood. Don't be shy to add as many Farm as you need, you can easily get up to 16+ Farm in a feudal push.
Research Iron Undermesh from your Blacksmith. Keep adding Farm as needed to balance your economy
Look to add 1 Archery Range to speed up Longbowman production. Research Wheelbarrow from your Mill

Add 1 extra Villager to Gold. We want to start banking Gold after this in case your push doesn't end the game and you need to go up to Castle Age. DON'T OVERDO IT! Keep your Rally on Wood. It is a very common newbie mistake to over macro on Gold
Keep increasing Food and Wood production. If your Battering Ram player needs assistance, you can easily research Siege Engineering from your Blacksmith and add some Battering Ram yourself

From here onward, get all the relevant eco tec and military upgrades. As always, play the game on a case-by-case basis to see if you need to adjust your army (shifting to Earl's Guard for example) and either play out in Castle Age or go for Imperial Age

Lumber Camp: Forestry

- Feudal Age all-in: Once you get 80 Gold, move Gold Villager,then Wood
- Team games/faster Castle Age: No changes.
1 Wood Villager,then Build House
Army composition: Ghazi Raider. Add Spearman vs Lancer. Add Archer vs Spearman

UPGRADES: Sanctity Piety All-Seeing Eye, Double Broadax Forestry Horticulture Professional Scouts Survival Techniques Specialized Pick. Make Scholar at Dome of the Faith as soon as you get the Gold (7 is a good amount to start saving up for Castle Age ).

Blacksmith: Bloomery,then Iron Undermesh,then Fitted Leatherwork,then Steeled Arrow,then Siege Engineering

Rally,then Gold (8)

1 Wood Villager,then Build: - Barracks vs cavalry civs ( French, Jeanne d'Arc, Rus, etc.). - Archery Range vs Spearman + Archer pushes ( English Council Hall, House of Lancaster, etc.). - 2nd Blacksmith vs greedy openers (Fast Castle Age, 2 Town Centers, Malians ). Move Scholar from inside Stable to Barracks / Archery Range; or to Mosque to accelerate research speed. If you build Archery Range, you will need at least 12 Villagers on Wood

Use Ghazi Raider to raid while you get a decent group of Spearman / Archer in your base. Use Spearman / Archer to build Palisade Wall around your base and to escort Scholar while they capture Sacred Site

Move Scholar to capture Sacred Site a few seconds before Sanctity finishes. Don't fight too hard for Sacred Site. Use them as a distraction, forcing the enemies to move out of their base and creating more opportunitites to raid. Obviously the extra Gold is nice, but don't take bad fights to defend them.
Rally,then Food
If you are forced to stay in Feudal Age for longer and make units, train additional Scholar so you don't float over 600 Gold, or trade it for Food at a Market for a faster Castle Age

Make sure to have at least 2 Barracks, 2 Archery Ranges and 2 Stables by the time you age up to start producing Man-at-Arms + Crossbowman + Lancer at the same time that you get upgrades. Order of priority is Stable always first, then either Barracks or Archery Range depeding on whether you need Spearman or Archer upgraded first.
10 Food Villager and 4 Gold Villager,then Build House of Learning,then Food
Train additional Scholar (but never going below 200 Gold, you will need it for units)
A few seconds before Castle Age move Scholar near Relic to grab them as soon as you age up.
Army composition: Lancer + Archer. Add Spearman and Crossbowman vs Lancer. Switch Lancer for Ghazi Raider when enemy starts making Crossbowman and make Man-at-Arms as frontline
Stable with Scholar make Lancer nonstop. Second Stable upgrade Ghazi Raider. If you are scared of Lancer diving your base, make 1 War Elephant first to defend alongside Spearman
Research: House of Learning: Honed Blades Hearty Rations Paiks Tranquil Venue Reinforced Foundations Mahouts. Research all remaining upgrades. Don't forget about Mosque Swiftness Herbal Medicine
Make 4 Scouts to steal Deer from the opponent's side of the map once Professional Scouts finishes, securing Food and delaying the farm transition.
See to the left. Ideal economy should look like this
Production buildings: 2 Barracks; 2 Archery Ranges; 2 Stables
After technologies are done, garrison Scholar inside military buildings or move them out to heal units after fights.
Delay Farm transition as much as possible, gather from Berries and Deer instead.

Palace of the Sultan: good long-term value. Sultan's Elite Tower Elephant are the strongest unit in the game and a push with 5 or more of them with a full army can be devastating. Hisar Academy: for faster tempo (faster late game upgrades) and better food economy. Allows you to liberate population space for a bigger army while keeping high production of Man-at-Arms and Ghazi Raider
Make Scholar up to 20, but don't build more than 3 Mosques.
Ideal army composition: Ghazi Raider + War Elephant + Sultan's Elite Tower Elephant + Scholar. Add Man-at-Arms and Archer vs Spearman. Add Crossbowman vs Lancer

Garrison Scholar inside Palace of the Sultan / Hisar Academy / Madrasa. Build 2 Madrasas (or Hisar Academy + 1 Madrasa ). Research: Hisar Academy / Madrasa: Biology Incendiary Arrows Silk Bowstrings Elite Army Tactics Court Architects Siege Works Chemistry Serpentine Powder. Don't forget about Mosque: Zeal Tithe Barns. Research all remaining upgrades.
After upgrades are completed move Scholar with the army to heal during fights.

Military buildings proportions: 10 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 10 Stables

Send wood villagers Wood Villager to stone Stone (One trip provides enough stone (50) to upgrade 1 outpost Outpost )

Rally villagers Villager to food Food. *** Try to not completely exhaust berries. Future age-up will provide bonus to berry bushes that still remain
Send berry villagers Berries Villager (should be around 7-8) to gold Gold

Castle Age Age up to Castle with appropriate Wing. - Growth Growth (Bonus Economic Wing): Get 8 villagers on age up, best in 90% of scenarios. Rally Rally to berries Berries (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP). - Logistics Logistics (Bonus Culture Wing): Great if against Civs that prioritize Relics. ----------------------------------------------------------------------. - Advancement Advancement (Bonus Culture Wing): Save for when a quick age up can be decisive
Rally villagers Villager to wood Wood until 12 (Build Lumber Camp when necessary)

Immediately queue Camel Lancers Camel Lancer and harass

Build blacksmith Blacksmith get appropriate upgrades ( Iron Undermesh + Bloomery + etc)
Upgrade to Veteran Camel Lancers Camel Lancer at stables Stable
Rally villagers Villager to gold Gold

title: English Man-at-Arms Feudal Cheese Build - Beasty 2025 Version
description: A cheesy build based on spamming Man-at-Arms and overwhelming the opponent. Designed by Beasty in 2025.
author: Xander
steps: Start by putting 4 Villagers on Wood and 2 Villagers on Food.
Rally on Sheep.
The Villager from Wood will cut down 2 Straggler Tree.
1 Villager from Wood will also build a House.
2 Villagers from Food will build a Mill and 2 Farms.
Every new Villager will create a new Farm, until you have a total of 8.
Once the 4 Villagers gather the second Straggler Tree, get them to build a Mining Camp and start getting Gold.
Age up with Abbey of Kings with the 4 Villagers from Gold.
Move all Villager from Sheep to build a Lumber Camp near the tree line.
Rally to Wood until a total of 8. Build necessary House with these Villager.
Rally 2 Villagers on Gold for a total of 6.
Keep Rally on Sheep moving on.
Moving on you will build 2 Barracks with 1 Villager from Wood.

As soon as Barracks are done, get Early Man-at-Arms upgrade and start pumping Man-at-Arms (or Spearman if vs. a lot of Horseman / Knight ). And when you have 5-10 units, start harassing opponent Gold / Wood, together with the King. Do not dive the Town Center until you have Iron Undermesh.
About now you start your eco upgrades. In this order: Horticulture Wheelbarrow Double Broadax Specialized Pick. Also later on: Forestry.
Build another Mill with 8 Farms with the villagers from Sheep.
Once you have 16 farms operating, start a Blacksmith with 1 Villager from Wood.
When Blacksmith is built, start in this order: Iron Undermesh Bloomery Fitted Leatherwork.
Keep pumping Man-at-Arms / Spearman (again, only if vs a lot of Horseman / Knight ) and keep raiding opponents base, to idle eco and overwhelm them.
Adjust Villager between resources as necessary. Build another Mill and Farm if necessary.
Keep building Barracks to spam faster.
The eco should look similar to this. Also at this time mark, you should have about 19 Men-at-Arms, plus the King.
Consider upgrading to Castle Age eventually.

title: 朱熹-2TC上宋
description: CrackedyHere's Zhu Xi's Legacy Song Dynasty for wood cost reduction into fast second TC build from his video
author: hydeng
steps: Scout needs to look around base a little bit to look for good spots for Meditation Gardens (not included in video, described further in the step at 2:15). Note that Zhu Xi's Legacy starts with 5 villagers, 1 scout, and 1 Imperial Official.
4 Villagers,then Berries
1 Villager,then Build Mill (on Berries ). One villager builds a mill on the berries.
3 Sheep,1 Imperial Official,then Mill. Move the three sheep to the mill and make the Imperial Official supervise the mill.
6 Villagers,then Sheep. Mill should be finishing up. First produced villager and all other villagers (6 total) start collecting the sheep at the mill.
Rally x2,then Gold. Villager,then House,then Mining Camp. Rally next two villagers to gold. The first one will make a house then a mining camp at the gold.
Rally x3,then Sheep. Rally next 3 villagers to sheep at the mill

Mill Villager,then Mill,then Sheep. Imperial Official,then Mill Gold,then Town Center,then Mill. Force dropoff of all villagers to the mill and make them go back to sheep. After this, have the imperial official grab the gold from the mill, drop off at the Town Center, then resume supervision of the mill.
Rally,then Wood. Rally villagers to wood on the treeline. The first one will make a lumber camp at 2:20, and the rally will stay on wood until the 3:40 step.

1 Mill Villager,then Meditation Gardens. One of the sheep villagers from the mill should build the Meditation Gardens landmark. If you get a berry patch, you only need 3 villagers on food. Ideally you want berries, stone, and wood to make the second TC the fastest. If you can't, then try for stone and wood.
New Villager,then Lumber Camp Wood. The next villager that comes out will build a lumber camp on the wood. This is the first of two villagers rallied to wood.

Mill Villager,then Mill,then Sheep. Imperial Official,then Mill Gold,then Town Center,then Mill. Force dropoff of all villagers to the mill and make them go back to sheep. After this, have the imperial official grab the gold from the mill, drop off at the Town Center, then resume supervision of the mill.

2x Villagers Mining Camp Gold,then Wood. Two villagers from gold can dropoff and head to wood. Between this final dropoff that should be happening around now (~140 gold) and future tax income, you should be able to have enough gold for the second landmark later on.

Mill Villager,then Mill,then Sheep. Imperial Official,then Mill Gold,then Lumber Camp Gold,then Town Center,then Mining Camp Stone. Force dropoff of all villagers to the mill and make them go back to sheep. After this, have the imperial official grab the gold from the mill, AND the lumber camp this time, drop off at the Town Center, then send to supervise the mining camp for stone built in the next step.
Rally,then Stone
3x Villagers Sheep,then Build Mining Camp. 2x Villagers Sheep,then Stone. Move 5 villagers off of sheep to the stone. Three build a mining camp on stone, two start mining stone.

1x Villager Meditation Gardens,then Stone. After the Meditation Gardens finish, move that villager that was building them onto stone. NOTE: If you don't have berries in range of Meditation Gardens, you'll need to leave 4 on sheep instead of 3.
2x Villagers Wood,then Jiangnan Tower. Two villagers from wood build the Jiangnan Tower landmark

3x Villagers Mining Camp,then Stone. Imperial Official,then Mining Camp Stone. Mining camp on stone finishes. The villagers building it should now be mining stone. The Imperial Official should be supervising the stone mining camp.
Rally,then Jiangnan Tower. Start rallying villagers to build the Jiangnan Tower
Rally,then Sheep. Villager Jiangnan Tower,then Sheep. Start rallying to sheep and send the villagers building the Jiangan tower to sheep as well.

7x Villagers Stone,then Mining Camp,then Build Town Center. Depending on your Meditation Gardens, you should have the resources for second TC now. Force your 7 stone villagers to dropoff and then build a second TC.
Make appropriate production building(s) next, and keep in mind the Jiangnan Tower will be spawning a villager from creating the TC and units from building any production buildings.

title: Timing push/fast imp pl
description: Uniwersalny build dla Sułtanatu Delhijskiego
author: tobradex1
steps: Jeżeli będziesz spear rush'owany, wyciągnij Scholar na złoto i gdy wyzbierasz 3900/4000 z Gold daj villsów na Wood.

Wyślij 5 Villagers do Wood jednorazowo (zbuduj nimi później Mill Wheelbarrow, by nie musieli wracać do Town Center. Villager wybuduje Mosque Efficient Production Piety = on House, później daj go na Berries. Rally Berries do 8.
Rally Gold do 3.

Rally Wood do 5, gdy będziesz grał kompozycję Ghazi Raider + Archer lub. Rally Wood do 7, gdy będziesz grał kompozycję Ghazi Raider + Spearman. Rally Food do Castle Age (jeżeli grasz Ghazi Raider + Archer Rally Food do 12. = on Rally Wood do 12 = on Rally Food do Castle Age ).
Wyślij 4 Villagers do Dome of the Faith. 1 Villager = on Lumber Camp Forestry

Wyklikaj wszystkie technologie w tej kolejności: Double Broadax Forestry. Wheelbarrow Professional Scouts Survival Techniques Horticulture. Sanctity Piety All-Seeing Eye. Specialized Pick. Non-stop produkcja z Dome of the Faith. 2 Wood Villager = on Stable. Umieść Scholar = on Stable. Non-stop produkcja Ghazi Raider. Próbuj ciągle zadawać obrażenia z Ghazi Raider. Gdy będą miały low hp odsyłaj je pojedynczo, by je wyleczyć, ważne by ich nie tracić.

Wyślij Scholar na Sacred Site. Jęzli eżeli przeciwnik będzie walczył o Sacred Site zajmuj Sacred Site pojedynczo, w przeciwnym wypadku wyślij po jednym Scholar na każdy Sacred Site. Dołóż Archery Range / Barracks jak najszybciej (nie zapomnij o Scholar ) = on 2x Blacksmiths Steeled Arrow Iron Undermesh Bloomery Fitted Leatherwork Siege Engineering. Nie inwestuj w jednostki więcej niż musisz. Spróbuj wejść w Castle Age ok. 13 min. Gdy tylko wybadasz Professional Scouts zrób 3x Scouts i zacznij zbierać Deer. (Jeżeli przeciwnik będzie walczył o Sacred Site możesz dosłać więcej Villager na Gold by móc wejść w Castle Age.)

Remacro: 14 Villagers = on Food. Daj tylu Villager na Gold, by mieć na War Elephant po wejściu w Castle Age. Reszta Villager na Wood. Roześlij Scholar na każdy Relic, by po wejściu w Castle Age od razu je zebrać. Przygotuj koniecznie 2x Archery Ranges = on Stable = on 2x Blacksmiths = on 2x Mosques. Jeżeli przeciwnik szykuje się do dive'u, ulepsz Textiles.

Wyklikaj wszystkie technologie w tej kolejności: Lumber Preservation. Fertilization. Shaft Mining. Herbal Medicine Swiftness. Wedge Rivets Balanced Projectiles Forced March Decarbonization Insulated Helm Military Academy. Paiks Mahouts Hearty Rations (reszta dowolnie/jak wolisz). Ulepsz Archer oraz non-stop produkcja War Elephant. Jeżeli przeciwnik nie ma 20+ Crossbowman oraz wybadałeś Archer Balanced Projectiles Wedge Rivets Paiks, po zrobieniu 4x War Elephants idź w all in'a (wyciągnij wszystkich Scholar ). Powinieneś tutaj skończyć grę. Jeżeli przeciwnik zadał ci duże obrażenia w feudalu i nie dasz rady zrobić timing push, pójdź w Imperial Age. W tym miejscu powinieneś dołożyć Barracks oraz Siege Workshop, jeżeli jeszcze nie masz, by móc tam również wybadać technologie. Staraj się zabudować bazę Palisade Wall przy użyciu Archer. Zbierz całe Food z mapy i wejdź w Imperial Age ok 18 min.

Wybierz Hisar Academy jeżeli nie masz jeszcze ukończonego farm transition, w przeciwnym razie wybierz Palace of the Sultan. Przygotuj koniecznie 3x Archery Ranges = on 4x Stables = on 2x Barracks = on 1x Siege Workshop. Powinieneś w tym momencie mieć ok. 20x Scholars.

Crosscut Saw. Precision Cross-Breeding. Cupellation. Platecutter Point Angled Surfaces Damascus Steel Master Smiths. Tithe Barns Zeal. Ulepsz wszystkie unity w Barracks / Archery Range / Stable / Siege Workshop. Spróbuj wybudować 3x Madrasas = on Biology Incendiary Arrows Silk Bowstrings (reszta dowolnie/jak wolisz). Po wybadaniu tych 3 technologii z Madrasa, wyciągnij wszystkich Scholar i idź po finałowego push'a z Archer + War Elephant / Sultan's Elite Tower Elephant.

title: 2 Fort 2 TC Open
description: Flexible opener to play 2TC with options to deviate depending on your opponents play.
author: King Roar
steps: 6 opener Vills to Berries. Make 2 Worker Elephants - one to gold vein - other to scout opposite side of your Scout. Rally 2 to Gold - First vill out makes House. Rally back to Berries until age up
Upon 200 Gold immediately move 2 gold vills + worker elephant to stone (should be very close to age up time)

Pull from food Vills, leaving 4 on food. - 4 to build age up. - 3 to stone to join the 2 already there (the 5 stone vills will now stay there until stone is gone). Rally to Wood (Your scout Worker Elephant be on its way back to base by this point, if it's too far out collect straggler trees first). One wood vill will build House at first 50 wood

Probably need to make units depending on state. dont be afraid of people fast castling, you can defend with forts and elephants. Get to castle naturally with making farms, if you arent facing any harass, it can be quick, if you are you will need to add production and units. You have the amazing advantage of upon aging up, with a stockpile of gold you can upgrade your units instantly. So dont be afraid to age up. This is a highly flexible build with choosing govenors / Forts vs TC / etc, It is difficult, you do have to constantly scout to see what your opponent is doing, and is quite greedy opener to early feudal aggro and you likely will need to abandon 2nd TC. But it can hold all - ins with Ajmer Man At Arms very well early (these guys are crazy). As a note, the number one reason I lose games is probably not making military units lol...so if you make it to 2TC 2 Fort. Id say probably start pumping out some units and try to gain map control. For imperial always go Palace of the Sultan and immediately pick Governor for Tier 4 discount Techs!
Landmark vills head to wood upon age up. Rally to Wood remains

Upon reaching ~400 Stone - have 5 Wood vills head to gold and create a new Worker Elephant. These vills build Tughluqabad Fort on gold. (Look to optimize what you can protect, best spawns have gold near stone). GOVERNOR CHOICE: Want to go Vill TC Speed Multan choice - if you are already getting heavy aggression at this point go the Ajmer Man At Arms choice instead but you should be safe to go Vill production, unless you sense cheese / all in incoming.
After getting back to 8 on wood. Now set main Rally to Sheep (which you should have alot of from your scouting)

At 350 Stone, have the 8 Wood vills build 2nd Town Center (usually on woodline) -rally this TC (And these vills) back to wood. NOTES: You will have additional wood past 400 by the time you can make this TC use this for a Stable Archery Range Barracks IF needed based on what your opponent is doing, if they aren't going aggro you can hold to make until AFTER the TC. DECISION: If you are scouting trouble, you instead and skip this step and make a 2nd fort at 425 stone instead and get Ajmer Man At Arms

When your first stone vein runs out, have those 5 vills build your 2nd Tughluqabad Fort. GOVERNOR CHOICE: If you are not in immediate danger I place this by a woodline / opening and pick Bhakkar for farm production. but as always, at any time if you are worried, you can make Ajmer Man At Arms
At this point you can look to get 3-5 vills back on a stone vein if possible. You should be looking to populate your farm eco around your Bhakkar. Upgrade your two forts with extra stone

title: OotD | Standard opener
description: Standard opener with both defensive and aggressive options. Can transition into FC or Feudal pressure.
author: Jockxtar
steps: Focus on scouting the closest Deer and Boar to your base. Once you age up you should scout your opponent's base to know where to raid.
Rally,then Sheep (6)
Rally,then House,then Mining Camp,then Gold (3)
Rally,then Wood (4)
2 Sheep Villager,then Meinwerk Palace
Rally,then Food (10)

Now it's a great time to move 5 Sheep Villager to Deer / Boar. Only consider Boar if it's not too far from your base, otherwise you will have to idle villager production and delay your first military unit. Use Scout to tank it.

Gilded Archer is the best unit of OotD. They should be the backbone of your army, then use other units to complement them depending on the opponent's composition. Gilded Man-at-Arms to tank archers and zhuge-nu defended by spearmen. Gilded Horseman to counter mass ranged armies. Gilded Spearman to counter cavalry and protect your Gilded Archer
Meinwerk Palace Villager,then Food

vs Mongols French Jeanne d'Arc Byzantines (Hippodrome): 1 Wood Villager,then Barracks. To defend against cavalry raids, put 2 Gilded Spearmen on each exposed resource. Once the opponent starts bringing archers alongside their cavalry, an Outpost to garrison Villager should be enough to keep defending.
vs any other civ: 1 Wood Villager,then Stable. Start recruiting Gilded Horseman and raid ASAP. To just raid, 2 are enough; 4 maximum. Send them in pairs to raid different resources at the same time.

Rally,then Wood for: - Aggressive playstyle: Stable,then Archery Range,then Barracks and Battering Ram; - Defensive playstyle: Barracks and Outpost and Palisade Wall; - Or economic playstyle: Mill + Outpost on Deer Boar and Town Center. Rally,then Gold (6) for FC. Rally,then Stone if you want 2nd Town Center after getting at least 6 Wood Villager
Economic upgrades: Survival Techniques,then Double Broadax,then Wheelbarrow,then Forestry,then Specialized Pick

Military upgrades: Always Iron Undermesh unless you plan on going FC; If you want to all-in Steeled Arrow,then Siege Engineering,then Fitted Leatherwork,then Bloomery. Only research Golden Cuirass if the game stays in Feudal Age for very long and you are making Gilded Man-at-Arms
Instead of rushing Castle Age like Holy Roman Empire, first make a decent army to protect Relic and your hunt economy.

Regnitz Cathedral if you are aging up earlier than your opponent or if you have a big army advantage to secure Relic. Burgrave Palace if you are behind, if the opponent has a big army or if you want to make a super strong all-in in Castle Age

title: FULL WATER Zhu Xi Guide
description: The most effective way to play Zhu Xi's Legacy on water. It is a hard build order and requires a lot of practice to get right, if you're not used to playing water. Recommend scrimming this one. IMPORTANT: Don't forget tax drop offs and dont miss res drop offs while you collect tax.
author: Valdemar1902
steps: There are slight variations depending on matchup, but this only applies to the highest level. An example is pulling 1 from wood to food to age up quicker or solely using drop offs from lumbercamp and saving on the mining camp cost. TIP: If you are way behind on age up, then build a 2nd Dock to garrison Fishing Boat as you might lose water from archer ship rush. If this happens, dont forget to macro vills on food so you can produce ships as well when not relying on boat food income. TIP: Try to hit 4:00 age up construction.
Send 1 Villager to Sheep to gather 10 Food. 3 Villagers go to Straggler Tree. 1 Villager builds Dock

When the Food Villager has 10 Food carry the food to the woodline and build a Lumber Camp to drop off with 20% from official. Supervise the Lumber Camp with an Imperial Official. Have the 3 Wood build the Lumber Camp while still carrying 10 wood each from Straggler Tree
Rally the first 2 Villagers from Town Center to Fish by the Dock (or sheep if dock is far away). After, Rally until 6 on Wood
Fishing Boat production until 6 boats
House built with Fish Villager
Rally 1 Villager to Gold and build Mining Camp
Rally Sheep under Town Center until Feudal Age
Sheep Villager builds Village

Take 5 Sheep Villager to build Meditation Gardens in a close to base but good spot. (you dont want to walk for too long). When at the spot, drop off with Fishing Boat to get max food to age with. Rally Town Center to Wood
Remacro.

Keep balancing wood float by adding in more docks and fishing boats to even out food/wood income. Keep 3 archer ships, and spam springalds ships. Hold off on demos until later, since you will easily lose them early with a minimal economy, you will fall behind quick not producing warships.
Send 1 age-up Villager to Gold. Keep Rally to Wood

If aged up first: Hunting Canoe,then War Canoe,then Explosive Junk. If aged up second: War Canoe,then Hunting Canoe War Canoe War Canoe War Canoe. When pushing enemy: Mass demos typically around 9-12 min mark
1 new Imperial Official that will collect tax

title: Golden Horde | Feudal aggro
description: Standard tempo strategy for the Golden Horde. Take advantage of the Khan, torguuds and keshiks to raid the opponents while you slowly get ready to tech up into your late game power spike. Added some tips for the late game. Check my other golden horde guides: - Feudal all-in: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/CroZRSJRDDcQvM3tY58o - FC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/Ev10L06ryLekNVbgmWEy
author: Jockxtar
steps: 4 Villagers,then Sheep. 1 Villager,then Build Ovoo,then Build Golden Tent (next to Gold ),then Build Ger on Gold. Rally,then Sheep (8)
Rally,then Gold (3)
Rally,then Sheep (10)
Rally,then Straggler Tree (9). Gather all 3 Straggler Tree near Town Center fully
Age-up with. Send 3 Sheep Villager to Straggler Tree
Research Wheelbarrow
Rally,then Sheep (20)
Send the closest Wood villager to the second Stone to be ready to Build Ovoo
Army composition: Raiding: Batu Khan + Torguud + Keshik. All-in: Archer + Batu Khan + Torguud + Keshik + Battering Ram. Add Spearman against Knight
Produce Batu Khan from Golden Tent. Build Ovoo,then Sheep
Drop Wood with 3 Straggler Tree Villager and Build Stable next to Golden Tent with them. They will later go to Gold.
Golden Tent,then Torguud
Build Ger on Wood
Produce Torguud and Keshik nonstop.
With Wheelbarrow complete, you may move 5 Villagers to closest Deer and research Survival Techniques. If not now, do it when it's safe.

Build Fortified Outpost on Deer with 5 Sheep Villager, so that you have a total of 10 on Deer and the rest on Sheep and Berries. This is risky but will accelerate the Castle Age timing considerably. OR --- vs Delhi Sultanate French Jeanne d'Arc Rus Knights Templar Mongols Golden Horde Byzantines ( Imperial Hippodrome ) ---. Build Barracks and make Spearman to protect the Deer. OR --- if opponent is making Spearman ---. Build Archery Range next to Stable and Golden Tent.
Choose a follow-up:

---------------------------------------------- FC -------------------------------------------------. Standard choice, Golden Horde hits its powerspike in Castle Age. Keep Rally,then Food until 20. Then Rally,then Gold for 2 more (8 in total). Finally Rally,then Wood. Build Blacksmith and research Iron Undermesh. Keep raiding enemy economy. Once you feel safe enough, stop making units and save up for Castle Age.

--------------------------------------------- All-in ------------------------------------------------. To punish additional Town Center. Move 1 Gold Villager to Wood. Keep Rally,then Food until 18. Then Rally,then Wood. Produce Archer nonstop and Build Blacksmith. Eventually Build Fortified Outpost near Golden Tent and production buildings and Build Barracks to add a few Kharash. Research Iron Undermesh,then Siege Engineering,then Steeled Arrow,then Double Broadax
If Deer and Boar start to run out, Build Stockyard and research Rotation Grazing. It's expensive, but way better than Berries.

Relic Ovoos: Has better scaling as you can research Stone upgrades faster. Muscovy Yasak: Good choice if you want to go for an all-in in Castle Age. The +2 ranged armor makes Torguud, Keshik and Man-at-Arms take barely any damage from Town Center.
Army composition: Batu Khan + Torguud + Keshik + Kipchak. Add Kharash against Spearman. Add Horseman against Crossbowman. Make Spearman + Crossbowman to defend against Knight

Start adding Stockyard gradually during Castle Age with Food Villager whenever you float over 300 Wood. We want to have 12 Stockyards in total. Build them around Fortified Outpost at the back of your base. Rotation Grazing and Over Grazing are very important.
Build second Archery Range. Make Kipchak and Keshik nonstop.
Remember to research Ovoo Offering, Steeled Arrow, Balanced Projectiles and Lumber Preservation. As well as other relevant Blacksmith upgrades.

Produce Torguud until you have 8 or 10. Then, depending on the enemy army composition, use excess Stone for: - vs Spearman + Crossbowman: Kharash Edict,then Triple Shot,then Battlefield Salvage. - vs mass Archer: Stables Reinforcements,then Padded Armor. - vs anything else: Archery Range Reinforcements,then Triple Shot

We want to prolong Castle Age as much as possible to get our Stone related upgrades before saving up to Imperial Age. It is a good idea to research Stockyard Edict before aging up to get extra Gold for upgrades while waiting.

Stone Armies: Reduces the amount of time it takes to produce Torguud and Stone cost by half (from 20 to 10 seconds, 160 Stone to 80). Since that's the core unit in our army, the faster we produce them the better. Yam Network Trade: Generates passive Gold for each Fortified Outpost built, which comes very handy for producing Handcannon Ashigaru. Since we already are generating Gold with Stockyard Edict, Yam Network Trade is not entirely necessary, so pick whatever you prefer.
Produce Horseman instead of Keshik to save up Gold. Also, upgrade Horseman to Castle Age.
Switch to Stockyard Edict for extra Gold.
If you didn't already, research Rotation Grazing and Over Grazing at Ger
Army composition: Batu Khan + Torguud + Handcannon Ashigaru. Add a few Horseman against Crossbowman. Add Bombard to destroy Keep. Use Horseman and Kipchak to raid enemy economy.

Research Ovoo Ceremony ASAP. Upgrade Keshik and Horseman if you already have a lot of them, otherwise skip that to get the other upgrades. Focus on producing Torguud and Handcannon Ashigaru, that will be the core of the army. Once you are at full population, spend Stone on upgrades (see next row).

Blacksmith: Biology,then Serpentine Powder,then Angled Surfaces,then Damascus Steel,then Master Smiths. With Stone: Ovoo Tithe,then Archery Range Reinforcements,then Stables Reinforcements,then Padded Armor,then Increased Supplies,then Steppe Lancers,then Glorious Charge
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production buildings: 1 Barracks; 5 Archery Ranges; 3 Stables

Edicts: Production Edict: Not very useful at this point since we can simply build more production buildings. Defensive Edict: Toggle it if you are fighting in range of a Fortified Outpost. Kharash Edict: Not worth at this point in the game. The +1 armor is barely noticeable against Imperial Age units. Stockyard Edict: The best by default. The extra Gold is very much needed for the army.

author: Lizarian
steps: Select TC and make 4 villagers. Send the scout out to find sheep.
Send all 6 villagers to sheep under the TC. Set TC rally point to sheep.
First villager that pops out builds a house and goes to sheep afterwards.
Set TC rally point to gold. Next two villagers build a mining camp and mine gold.
You should have 400 food and 200 gold around 2:30 to 3:00. Age up with the Council Hall.
4 villagers build the Council Hall, 4 stay on sheep, rest go to wood. TC rally point goes on WOOD.
Build a lumber camp and a house. Send the gold miners to wood.
Around this time (3:00 to 4:00) your scout should return to the TC with your found sheep.
Try to scout the enemy to see what they are doing.

Villagers that finish the Council Hall go back to sheep. Keep rallying onto wood for the rest of the game. When you need other resources, send villagers from wood to food/gold. Start building farms when you have a large surplus of wood.
Once you hit Feudal Age, start building Longbows from the Council Hall and send them out to harass the enemy when you have 5 of them.
Build a Barracks and produce Spearmen to send forward to protect your longbows.
Build a Blacksmith to get upgrades. Send some villagers from wood to gold so you can research Blacksmith upgrades as well as Mill, Lumber and Mining upgrades.

title: Dark Age Samurai Harass into Feudal Rush
description: The Build is very hard and easy to mess up practice before you try. I would like to hear if the strategy works for you, as well as it does for me. Pls leave comments on how it goes. GL HF :D
author: ßlàçk
steps: 5: Villager,then Straggler Tree gather 50 Wood. 1: Villager,then Build Barracks. Queue 3 Villagers from Town Center (Not 4, just 3 to have enough food for a Naginata Samurai ). Move Scout in an aggressive path to find enemy base and Gold
Rally,then Sheep. 5: Villager From Straggler Tree,then Sheep
Villager From Barracks,then Sheep
Rally to Berries and make a Farmhouse (Leave Villager on Berries ). Queue a Naginata Samurai from Barracks
Rally,then Sheep until we have 3: Naginata Samurai (2 out 1 in queue)

Make sure your Town Center Doesn't go idle. Try to memorize and Follow this Queue: 3: Villager,then 1: Naginata Samurai,then 2: Villager,then 1: Naginata Samurai,then 1: Villager,then 1: Naginata Samurai,then and: Villager

If at any point you see Villager idling because you are running out of Sheep. move them to Straggler Tree early. That is natural because we only use the 3 starting Sheep. But if you messed up somewhere then go to Berries if you run out of Food
When you Queue your 3rd Naginata Samurai (should be around this time). Move 8: Villager from Sheep,then Straggler Tree gather 175 Wood
Scout should be back with Sheep. So we keep Rally,then Sheep
5: Villager From Wood,then Gold and build a Forge. The rest go to Sheep and gather Food until we can Age Feudal Age
Rally,then Food. Make 2nd Farmhouse with the Villager on Berries
4: Villager,then Build Kura Storehouse. Upgrade Tawara with the first 50 Gold
Villager build Lumber Camp and Rally until we have 3: Villager,then Wood. You can make Naginata Samurai if you have extra Food. just make sure your Town Center doesn't go idle again

if at any point you were able to kill a Villager in dark age, or were able to age up faster than your enemy you have a huge lead. If your enemy ages up before you even though you harassed him, it's fine you are not necessarily behind. Make sure you don't lose you first 3: Naginata Samurai without geting some sort of value from them like. Villager idle time or Feudal Age delay. If you were able to prevent your enemy from gathering enough Gold to age up be mindfull of other spots he can go to. Try to force the enemy to shelter Town Center for idle time just dont get hit a lot. Naginata Samurai are very stronge in dark age so if the enemy tries to fight back with Spearman you can fight him he will have to invest a lot to defend so if you see him making Barracks you are in a huge lead. Why i like this strategy is because most ppl get confused and make mistakes. some times they have very greedy openings like going for Deer or making their lankmark out of Town Center range so i can stop their age up, ending up winning games. Also if you dont make any mistakes yourself in the build order you end up with a normal one Town Center feudal rush and you can play the game normally if your harass doesn't net you any value. Your age up is slower but you have a Barracks already to make units so you end in a neutral position. Dont use this strategy vs Holy Roman Empire the early monk can heal the villagers and you end up just delaying your age up and giving them time to go castle and stomp you. Go fast Castle and make Onna-Musha. Dont use on Rus either since they dont need to mine Gold go for a 2 Town Centers strategy. I am not sure about Mongols i haven't been able to pick a dark age fight before it could be good because like i said Naginata Samurai are stronge and you could destroy their Ovoo before they make their Barracks but if you dont make it in time mongols can make way to many Spearman i think it would be better to try and either mine gold early or just make a Outpost on your Gold you can also get Siege Engineering without spending extra 150 Wood so you are propably one of the better civs to defend Outpost rush.
3: Villager From Kura Storehouse,then Wood. 1: Villager From Kura Storehouse,then Farm
Rally,then Food until you have 17-18: Villager. Make sure to get Takezaiku and Double Broadax. Make sure your Barracks is in constant production of Naginata Samurai from this point
At some point add another Barracks. Get Iron Undermesh and Siege Engineering to try and finish the game by 10 min

author: wrekcz
steps: 5x Villagers chop closest tree unitl each Villager has 7 Wood each.

5x Villagers to sheep under the Mill with Imperial Official supervising. 1x Villager builds Village near berries.

Collect tax with your Imperial Official from the Mill when it hits 40 then continue to supervise the Mill.
Construct Meditation Gardens with 2x Villagers.
Continue rallying out to Food until you have enough for Jiangnan Tower. Pull your Gold Villager off when you get exactly 170 Gold.
Send the Gold Villager to stragler trees near main TC. Send 6x Villagers from Food to construct a mining camp on the Stone. Use the Imperial Official to supervise the Stone.
The 2x Villagers that were making Meditation Gardens will then make the Jiangnan Tower once the Meditation Gardens is completed. Rally new Villager onto wood.
Once you get 350 Stone pull 6x Villagers off and go to Wood until you can afford 2nd Town Center.
Construct 2nd Town Center with 6x Villagers.

Keep majority of Villager on Wood as spamming production buildings grants you free units essentially driving the cost of the production building down to a fraction of the price. Wood also helps you afford an early Granary and Farm which means you never need to leave your base.

title: Fast Castle Keshig + Cataphracte - Jeando tuto
description: Fast Castle byzantin avec double pack de Keshigs. Pression rapide en âge 3 grâce aux Keshigs (mercenaires) et transition full cavalerie lourde Cataphracte. Excellent en multi (2v2/3v3/4v4) et jouable en 1v1 contre des civilisations lentes ou double TC.
author: Readix
steps: Envoyer les 6 premiers Villager sur les Sheep — commencer par les B les plus éloignées du Town Center. Un Villager construit une House en chemin. Tip: commencer par les moutons loin du TC protège des rushs — les B proches restent accessibles plus tard.
Les 2 premiers Villager sortant du Town Center vont directement sur Gold. Construire le Mining Camp dès que possible sur la Gold.

Dès que le Mining Camp est terminé, construire immédiatement la Cistern of the First Hill (citerne). Placer la citerne pour booster Food moutons + Gold + Food B si possible. Ajouter 2 Villagers supplémentaires sur Gold (total 4 sur or). Ajouter 2 Villagers supplémentaires sur Food (total 8 sur nourriture).

Lancer le passage Feudal Age avec 2 Villagers. Construire l' Imperial Hippodrome — le placer dans la zone d'influence (carré) de la citerne pour accélérer la production militaire. Envoyer 5 Villagers depuis les moutons vers Wood.

Dès 100 Wood: déplacer 2 Villagers du bois vers Gold. Rally Town Center toujours sur Food moutons. Construire un Outpost avancé et une House supplémentaire. Garder 5 Villagers sur Wood jusqu'à 150 bois.

À 150 Wood: construire la Mercenary House (maison des mercenaires). ⚠️ Ne pas supprimer les arbres autour — vous avez besoin de 3 arbres pour ce build. Depuis le bois: 1 Villager → Gold, 2 Villagers → Food, 2 restants sur Wood. Lancer immédiatement le contrat des Keshik Keshigs (coûte 400 huile d'olive — vous en avez 800: 2 packs possibles).

Lancer le 2ème pack de Keshik Keshigs (2x400 huile d'olive depuis les 6 B = 800 au total). Lancer le passage Castle Age avec les Cistern of the First Hill. Placer la citerne d'avance sur un point d'intérêt: B + Gold si possible. Envoyer un Villager construire un aqueduc pour relier les deux citernes.

Dès l'âge 3: lancer le contrat vétéran sur les Keshik Keshigs. Ajouter 5 Villagers sur Gold. Objectif: 15 Villagers sur Food + 15 sur Gold. Lancer Wheelbarrow Brouette dès que possible. Si le moulin est sous la citerne, activer Dialectique. Activer le Glops automatique sur la citerne: +25 HP/s pendant 6s sur les unités à faible vie. Produire Cataphract Cataphractes + Keshik Keshigs en continu. Utiliser Triomphe de l'Hippodrome lors des grands combats (+dégâts, +vitesse, régénération).

Rechercher Iron Undermesh Résistance aux flèches rang 1 puis Teardrop Shields +1 armure corps à corps ET distance sur Cataphract. Ajouter des Stable écuries pour produire plus de Cataphract Cataphractes. Combo idéal en multi: Cataphract Cataphractes + Keshik Keshigs (allié archer recommandé). Réutiliser Triomphe après chaque combat — les points d'approvisionnement (kills) augmentent sa durée. Spamm Keshik + Cataphract pour cleaner la map.

title: Pro Scout > FC > Horse Archers > Knights -piperunners redone with icons
description: This build relies on deer and relics. This has the advantage of very quickly overwhelming the enemy into a turtle by an FC aggression. No infantry units were produced so mobility is a huge advantage. Designed to work against civs that flow through turtle/boom->agression->boom since this builds flows through boom->agression->boom Beats: - HOL
author: Etherz
steps: Using the The Golden Gate Golden Gate to get to pro scouts ASAP

- 2 Villagers make 2 Hunting Cabins simultaneously, then they return to Food. Wood Villager will only do one round of gathering and then they will go on Food. - To remember this, you will have one round of wood as soon as your 7th Villager is produced. - The Rally will be on the chopped Wood. - We make 1 Scout from the first hunting cabin.
- 7th Villager gathers one round of Wood makes a House then goes back on Food.
- 1 Villager will be in the queue and Feudal Age will be available by this time
The idea is to bank 100 Food to sell and get 150 Gold from Golden Gate. 8 on Wood give us enough Wood to get Professional Scouts pro scouts.
- Age up with 4 Food Villager. We want to get to 8 Wood Villager and then rest go on Food.
- House will be build using Wood Villager.
- The rest of the Villager go on Food. Age up will finish by 4.25.
- Instantly sell 100 Food. You just need 100 Food, so extra food should be used to make scouts Scout. - Age up Villager go to Food. - Idle scouts can be used to burn enemy mils/houses.
- Build one Wooden Fortress on the woodline. Keep queuing scouts.
- 7 to 9 Scouts will be needed. - If the enemy is being aggressive, pick your 2 packs first. If not, pick 1 of yours and 1 from his side.
- Walls, houses etc must always be built using the W vils since, gathering F from deer also gives us G. So using F vil will hurt eco x2.
- Age up with 8 Villagers and now remacro to Wood. We need exactly 15 on Villager Wood. - The new Villager go to Food. - We get a Wheelbarrow. - We get Double Broadax
- We start making 3 Archery Ranges. Use Food Villager for this.

- Age up Villager go to Food. - At this point the macro is 50-50 on Food and Wood. Rally Villager go to Wood. - Make a few (6 Horse Archers ), bank a little bit of Wood to make a Monastery. - Get Forestry
- Use previously made Scout for tanking and Horse Archer to harass.
- Constant Horse Archer from 4 Archery Ranges will need 50-50 eco on Food and Wood. - Prioritize picking up Relic.

- remacro to Food prioritized eco. - Put down 3 Stables. We will move into a Knight. - Get knight veterancy upgrade. - Get horticulture upgrade. - Get +1 range attack, +1 range defence. - All this should be done while harassing and trying to do eco damage to the enemy.
- Start getting gold now since we want to make knights. - This has to be done while forcing the opponent to stay in their base and defend against your raids.
- Buy S for 2nd TC, use G vils to make TC. Send them back to G.
- Farm transition starts. Use W vils to add farms. - 8G vils will be constant, new vils go to W, and we keep adding farms. - We stick to horse archers and knights.
- The macro proportion will be 3:2:1 for F:W:G. Slightly leaning towards F.
- The unit comp is very food heavy so roughly around 20-minute mark,40+ vils should be on F, half on them on W, about 10 on G and 8 on S for a keep drop for map control.

title: Lancaster
description: Flexible Abbey of Kings Fast Castle into White Tower with adaptive Feudal defense. Early stone for Manor influence, optional pressure with Lords, and strong eco transition with Manors and Relics.
strategy: Abbey of Kings Fast Castle → White Tower Knight Pressure
author: MrFish29
steps: Send all villagers to Sheep. Scout circle base and find more sheep.
First 3 new villagers build Mining Camp on Gold and a House near TC.
Next 3 villagers → Sheep (final 9 food / 3 gold). age up with Abbey of Kings using gold villagers
Send 2 food villagers → Stone and 4 → straggler trees. Set TC Rally to Gold until 4 villagers there, then back to sheep.
After mining 100 Stone, send both stone vils → Wood. Once 175 Wood gathered, send the 4 straggler wood vils → Sheep.
After Feudal age-up: use 4 gold villagers to build Manor to influence Gold + Sheep (include Wood if close). Scout opponent’s base — if they’re passive, send Lord of Lancaster to harass exposed vils.
If facing early aggression, you can: - Place Manor beside Wood instead for Feudal defense. - Transition into military production buildings around it. - Defend with Lords or tower gold if needed.
Continue normal build if safe: maintain **7 gold / 2 wood / rest on food**. At ~6:20, start The White Tower with 8 food villagers. Place landmark near Gold or between gold + woodline.
While landmark builds, set TC Rally to Wood for remainder of game. Use 2–3 gold villagers to build 2 Stables nearby. Train 1 extra Lord of Lancaster from Abbey of Kings.
After aging up, eco layout: 10 food / 12 gold / 1 stone / rest wood. Start constant Knight production from stables.
If pressured: use spawned Men-at-Arms + Lords defensively. Otherwise, pressure with Knights + Lords to gain map control and relics.
Add Blacksmith + Monastery for relics and upgrades. Optional tech path: add Archery Range if enemy makes spears/crossbows.

If sheep run out → move to Berries or external food. Your 1 stone villager will have enough for another Manor → place near new food source to maintain influence on ≥10 vils. Always aim for 10+ vils under each manor for best passive bonus.

Keep producing units, complete eco upgrades, and build Farm clusters around manors. At this stage, your eco should be extremely strong with relics + manor passive income. You can close games with Knight/Lord pushes or safely go Imperial depending on map control.

Ahora pondremos el punto de reunión Rally en el oro Gold donde el aldeano Villager que salga lo haremos construir el campamento minero Mining Camp donde igual irá a oro Gold junto con 2 aldeanos más que salgan hasta completar 3

Ahora podremos el punto de reunión Rally en ovejas Sheep hasta tener un aproximado de 6 aldeanos Villager en comida Food
Se que me pude haber explayado demasiado en las instrucciones, pero intente hacerlo lo más entendible posible para que sepa paso por paso lo que se debe hacer

Apenas lleguemos a Feudal Feudal Age con 2 aldeanos Villager de madera Wood construiremos un establo Stable y pondremos un aldeano Villager más en la comida, luego el punto de reunión Rally volverá a la madera Wood y no saldrá de ahí por el resto de la partida
Cuando se construya el establo Stable enviaremos un Erudito Scholar dentro de este y comenzaremos a sacar Incursores Ghazi Ghazi Raider a molestar al rival

No pararemos la producción de Ghazis Ghazi Raider y dependiendo de lo que hayamos elegido, investigamos las mejoras de la herrería, empezando por Malla de Hierro Iron Undermesh y luego las que estimemos convenientes y según el edificio secundario que hayamos elegido, iremos sacando Arqueros Archer o piqueros Spearman sin olvidarnos de su mejora a curtido

Suponiendo que con los Ghazi tenemos control del mapa, sacaremos 5 aldeanos Villager de la madera Wood y los enviaremos a ciervos Deer construyendo molino Mill y torre Outpost (Cuando estemos faltos de comida, Sacaremos aldeanos de madera y los enviaremos a recursos neutrales del mapa Berries Deer )

Cuando sea alrededor de minuto 7 ya debería estar acabando la tecnología de Santidad Sanctity, por lo que sacaremos a nuestros 2 eruditos Scholar y los enviaremos a capturar los lugares sagrados Sacred Site, ayudándonos con nuestras tropas ya sean Ghazi arquero, Ghazi piquero, o los 3 Ghazi Raiders Archer Spearman y construiremos alrededor del Sitio sagrado Sacred Site un cuadrado con empalizada Palisade Wall con la infantería que tengamos Spearman Archer

For Castle Age: your composition is still Sipahi Archer with upgrades, but now make Man-at-Arms / Lancer and Siege Workshop. For Imperial Age: your composition should be Sipahi, Man-at-Arms, Janissary, Siege Workshop. This build works against all but Rus and English where you instead go straight to feudal with" 6 on food/2 on gold,then rest to food" opening for fast ageup. Rally House

The idea is to rush archers as soon as possible and rush an opponend (preferably boom civ) together with your teammate knight civ (French/JD/Rus/Mongol/another KT). Bulk of your army are archers (later with upgrades) and rams (cheaper, better wood income) with Hospitalier Knights to heal up your teammate cavalry and possibly a few spearmen to guard from opponent knight civs.

After this point it is highly situational to your game. Make sure you coordinate yourself with you teammate! He should protect your archers from Horseman and Knights and you should heal up his injured knights with your Hospitaller Knight. IF opponent has NO knights: train 2 Hospitaller Knights with 2nd pilgrim Gold income and then get Iron Undermesh,then Steeled Arrow
Build 1 Battering Ram (preferably hidden) and then 1 Outpost once you attack covering critical resources.
OPTIONAL: If you are certain that you'll manage to get a Outpost up, then mine 50 Stone to upgrade it Arrowslits!
Once Food and Wood income is stable for continuous military production, add 2-3 on Gold.

title: Lancaster | Safe 6 Manors tempo
description: Slightly less greedy build order with early army production to dictate the tempo from very early on. Tips on mid and late game strategies and army compositions. Check my other Lancaster guides: - 3 manors FC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/X0WisINpsxeI6vygC6gE
author: Jockxtar
steps: Rally,then House,then Mining Camp,then Gold (3)
Rally,then Sheep (9)
We want to gather excess Food for Double Broadax and for our first Spearman. Scout enemy intentions. If they Build Stable or landmark equivalent, follow the build variation with Barracks
4 Sheep Villager,then Build Lancaster Castle / Abbey of Kings,then Wood

Lancaster Castle: Strong defensive landmark with upgrades that can boost our tempo considerably in the mid game. Abbey of Kings: The healing aura plus the Lord of Lancaster grant a lot of long-term value. Strong for Feudal Age all-ins, but also a good choice in team games to boost your late game efficiency.
Rally,then Wood (12) (first Build Lumber Camp )
1 Gold Villager,then Mining Camp Stone
2 Sheep,then Mining Camp Stone
Army composition: Yeoman + Spearman. Veteran Demilancer are decent raiders and provide an efficient frontline, forcing the opponent to react with Spearman which we will hard counter with our Yeoman
Lumber Camp,then Double Broadax

Force drop Wood with 4 Villagers and Build Manor near Wood (it doesn't matter if it's outside of Lancaster Castle range). OR --- vs Delhi Sultanate French Jeanne d'Arc Knights Templar Mongols Byzantines ( Imperial Hippodrome ) ---. 1 Gold Villager,then Build Barracks. 1 Gold Villager,then Build House
Rally,then Gold (5). OR --- if you built Barracks ---. Rally,then Food (1 more, total of 4); then Rally,then Gold (5)
2 Wood Villager,then Build Manor. OR --- vs aggro that's not melee cavalry ---. 1 Wood Villager,then Build Archery Range
Rally,then Wood (16). 2 Wood Villager,then Build Manor
2 Wood Villager,then Build Manor. If you already have the third one Build Archery Range instead
Manor,then Condensed Land Practices
Rally,then Food (12)
1 Wood Villager,then Build Archery Range / Barracks (you want 1 of each)
Keep building Manor with 1 Wood Villager. Produce Spearman and Yeoman with excess Food and Wood
Build 6th Manor with 3 Stone Villager,then Food. And research Muster the Nobles at Lancaster Castle as soon as they start building.
Once Veteran Demilancer are out, prepare for a push.
Rally,then Gold (15)
Build Blacksmith and research Steeled Arrow
Add second Archery Range and second Barracks
The only economic upgrades that we want for now are Wheelbarrow and Specialized Pick

Now you have 2 choices: - Research Siege Engineering, build Battering Ram and go for an all-in to punish greedy players (2 TC, etc.). Your economy should be superior enough to overpower any opponent. OR. - Start saving Food and Gold for Castle Age, but don't stop unit production completely.
If you still have Veteran Demilancer alive, try to keep them safe until you age up so that they can benefit from the instant upgrade.

King's College: The discount on technologies alone makes this landmark really good, but the unique ones that it unlocks are very strong as well. If you expect the game to reach Imperial Age, this is clearly superior. The White Tower: Good choice to start a Earl's Guard rush. With their dagger throw and stats they can easily overwhelm opponents before they can get a high amount of Crossbowman. If you want to finish the game before Imperial Age, choose this landmark.
Build 2 Stables and 2 more Archery Range while aging up
Rally,then Food (30)

During this age we want to abuse our superior economy. Get a massive army and push into the enemy base. Stay around their military buildings to kill reinforcements and snowball even harder. Army composition: Spearman + Yeoman + Knight. Add Hobelar to counter Crossbowman. Add Crossbowman + Earl's Guard instead of Knight if you lack Gold or if the enemy has camel units.

Research Yeoman and Spearman veterancy upgrades. The most important upgrades we want, in order, are: Billmen,then Balanced Projectiles,then Synchronized Shot,then Open Field System,then Collar of Esses,then Hill Training
See to the left. Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Production building proportions: 2 Barracks; 2 Archery Ranges; 1 Stable
Once you start researching Open Field System, move 5 Wood Villager to Stone and build the remaining 3 Manors
Synchronized Shot makes the Yeoman act as anti-ranged and anti-siege units. Try to always keep Yeoman count at 40 or higher

Collar of Esses makes Knight an amazing counter to heavy units, if we have the Gold to mass produce them. Otherwise Crossbowman are more cost-efficient as counter units and Earl's Guard as a meaty frontline.
Once you have a clear military advantage, use Knight to raid enemy economy and Battering Ram or Counterweight Trebuchet to deal with static defenses and landmarks.
Build Farm as you start running out of natural sources of Food.

Wynguard Palace: Has fast and cost-efficient unit producion of infantry, cavalry and gunpowder siege; providing more long-term value. Berkshire Palace: To secure control of important parts of the map, lock an opponent inside their base or defend your own if you are on the back foot.
Army composition: Spearman + Earl's Guard + Yeoman + Handcannon Ashigaru. Add Hobelar to counter ranged and siege units if the opponent has too many of them for your Yeoman to handle.
Research Scutage ASAP

If you aged up with King's College to Castle Age, you can now research Burgundian Imports to produce cheaper Handcannon Ashigaru. As for University tecs, you want: Incendiary Arrows,then Elite Army Tactics,then Serpentine Powder
Finish your Farm transition and research Horticulture, Fertilization and Precision Cross-Breeding

steps: Starting 6 villagers build a mill in the direction of the woodline. Leave some space for Lumber Camp and Imperial Academy.

Once you have 2 on gold, rally TC back on sheep.
Take 5 food villagers and use them to build the Imperial Academy near the mill and woodline. Shift-click them to a straggler tree after they finish the Imperial Academy.
Collect exactly 35 gold with the gold miners and then pull the gold miners to wood.
Once you have 8 on food, rally TC to wood.
Build Imperial Officials from the Academy until you have 4. Collect tax revenue with the first IO so you can fund more.
Supervise the Mill.
Build a village (put it anywhere, use wood villagers).
2nd Official pops out and you build a Lumber Camp. Supervise it.

Queue a 3rd Official, rally TC back to food and spend wood on a Stable if the enemy is passive, Barracks or Archery Range if they're attacking with horses/spearmen. You will need a Stable for Professional Scouts.

Research Professional Scouts and start building Scouts from your stable. Build at least 5 scouts and send them to pick up deer and deliver it (T key) to the mill. Use your Barracks and/or Archery Range to make units to pressure your opponent and defend your deer while preventing THEM from taking deer.

Don't forget to build a Blacksmith at some point and research economic upgrades (wheelbarrow first) when your taxes pile up. If you want to build a lot of units in the feudal age, prioritize Blacksmith upgrades too. If you want to play passive and collect deer to go up to Castle Age, prioritize eco upgrades and put one Official on tax collection.

Your villager eco split should look something like this by the time you go up to Castle Age. Put more on wood if you build a lot of archers, more on gold if you want to age up faster or go Song Dynasty.

title: Rus | Pro scouts + 2TC
description: Pro scouts build order with inmediate second TC follow up. Also some tips. Ideal to counter greedy openings and to play in team games when your base spawns at the back. You can easily reach imperial age with a large army in 20 minutes.
author: Jockxtar
steps: This is the standard Professional Scouts opening. First Scout goes to steal Sheep on the enemy side, second Scout scouts the area around your base quickly to not idle your Villager.
Send 5 Villagers to gather 50 Wood from a Straggler Tree then go to Sheep. 1 Villager build Hunting Cabin on first woodline then House then goes to Sheep
Rally,then near Wood (not to chop, it will build)
First Villager builds 2nd Hunting Cabin on opposite woodline ( or to the side of the first one opposite the first Hunting Cabin )
Rally,then Sheep
When first Hunting Cabin is finished queue up a Scout
Build The Golden Gate with 4 Villagers. Later send them to Stone
Remacro 5 Villagers onto Straggler Tree
House
Rally,then Wood (14)
Army composition: Spearman + Archer early to protect Scout. Knight + Archer later to put pressure and gain control of the map
The Golden Gate: Sell 100 Food for Professional Scouts and queue up 2 Scouts from Hunting Cabin
Build Lumber Camp
Remacro 1 Sheep Villager,then Stone

Gradually produce Scout with excess Food until you have 8. 7 Scouts will get the Deer, move them close to them before Professional Scouts finishes. 8th Scout will stay at the enemy base checking what they do
Remacro 5 Stone Villager,then Gold after dropping 50 Stone
Once Professional Scouts is researched, start collecting the Deer. Depending on the matchup you might want to move all Scout together, or send one or two to each Deer pack.
The Golden Gate: Buy Stone twice
Build Town Center with 10 Wood Villager in a safe spot. Ideally protecting Wood or Gold at the back of your base.
Research Survival Techniques and Double Broadax

The Golden Gate: Buy Wood. Build Barracks or Archery Range or Stable depending on the matchup. -----------------------------------------------------------------------------. Barracks is the safest option since Horseman and Knight are the most typical counter to Professional Scouts. Archery Range vs Ayyubids ( Desert Raider ), Mongols ( Mangudai ) and Abbasid Dynasty ( Military Wing ); also good against Dark Age Barracks. Stable if the opponent is also playing greedy and doesn't have units early. Great counter to FC openings to deny Relic
See to the left. Remacro to this. Main Town Center Rally,then Deer (the ones that your Scout are dropping). 2nd Town Center Rally,then Wood
Don't forget to build Wooden Fortress near Lumber Camp for the 20% bonus
Get a decent army to put pressure and slow the opponent's plan. From this point onwards, there is no other civilization in the game that can compete with your economy (on land maps at least).
At some point your economy will outscale your production, so you can basically go to Castle Age without affecting your tempo.

High Trade House: Is, generally speaking, very op. It grants a lot of passive Gold income and guarantees reaching the last tier of the Bounty system. Abbey of the Trinity: If the opponent managed to get to Castle Age already and you really want to deny the Relic, this landmark accelerates the production of Warrior Monk. It's also a good choice in the long term to improve the value of your late game army. Ideal for team games where you expect the match to last for a long time.
Make sure you have 2 Barracks, 1 Stable and at least 3 Archery Ranges
Rally,then Gold (15)

Army composition (early): Spearman + Crossbowman. Add Man-at-Arms / Horseman vs Archer. Add Archer vs mounted cavalry. Army composition (late): Horse Archer + Knight + Warrior Monk (2). Add Horseman vs Crossbowman
Build Monastery. Make Horse Archer for Relic collection
Build a few more Barracks and Archery Range
See to the left. Economy should look like this

After securing Relic and protecting your base with Fortified Palisade Wall, swap to a cavalry army composition. Horse Archer + Knight are pretty much unstoppable with Boyar's Fortitude and the insane economy. Add Horseman vs Crossbowman
Once you take control of the map, move groups of 8 Villagers to gather Boar
If you don't have control of the map, start adding Farm and research Horticulture
If the opponent has a large army, distract them while you get to Imperial Age
Keep making units while aging up except Knight, we will need a lot of Gold for upgrades.

High Armory: The discount on siege units is super useful for a quick transition and, on top of that, the unique upgrades are very strong. Spasskaya Tower: Is a nice defensive structure to protect your base if you rushed Imperial Age. Unlocking Stone Wall is nice to block raids from the opponent for good.
5 Barracks; 10 Archery Ranges; 5 Stables
Army composition: Knight + Streltsy + Warrior Monk (3 or 4). Add Horseman vs Crossbowman. Add a few Man-at-Arms and Springald vs mass Spearman. Add Bombard to finish the game

Restabilize the game while you remax your army with Streltsy + Spearman / Man-at-Arms / Horseman (depending on the enemy army), then move out for a counter attack and slowly transition to your final army composition of Knight + Streltsy + Warrior Monk
See to the left. Economy should look like this
Research Mounted Training if you have a lot of Horse Archer remaining. Don't forget to research Knight Poleaxes after you transition into Knight.
University: Biology,then Siege Works,then Elite Army Tactics,then Chemistry

title: Knights Templar | Dark Age tower rush
description: Dark Age tower rush with spearmen to block gold, stone or berries at enemy base. DO NOT do this build order against HRE, China, Zhu Xi, English, House of Lancaster, Mongol or Rus; they can either make a lot of units very early in the game, have villagers with ranged attacks or both. My other Knights Templar build orders: - Feudal all-in: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/3zDTNY0CFvLUA8dZ0UnX - 2TC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/4eHSzSzuResmbfKsdVCV
author: Jockxtar
steps: 4 Villagers,then Straggler Tree. 2 Villagers,then Sheep. Send Scout to opponent base to locate Gold / Stone / Berries
Rally,then Sheep (8)
At 150 Wood, 1 Straggler Tree Villager,then Build Barracks
At 50 Wood, 1 Straggler Tree Villager,then Build House
Barracks make Spearman. Unless enemy makes defensive units, make only 3
When 2nd Spearman is out, send 1 Straggler Tree Villager to build Outpost at enemy base

Where to build Outpost: - On Gold: Against Feudal Age Knight civs and fast Castle Age civs. French, Jeanne d'Arc, Jin Dynasty, Order of the Dragon, Japanese, Sengoku Daimyo, Malians, Ayyubids, Macedonian Dynasty, Ottomans. - On Stone: Against 2 Town Centers civs (except English and House of Lancaster ). Knights Templar, Abbasid Dynasty, Tuglhaq Dynasty, Golden Horde. - On Berries: Against civs with bonuses on Berries gathering. Byzantines, Delhi Sultanate. Don't do this against Holy Roman Empire, China, Zhu Xi's Legacy, English, House of Lancaster, Mongols, Rus
Rally,then Wood
You should have enough Wood for the outpost now. If the enemy is making their own units to defend, make more Spearman
Move 6 Wood Villager,then Gold once you have 200 Food in the bank and are no longer making Spearman. 1 Build Mining Camp, the other 5 gather Gold

Principality of Antioch: Serjeant are great in Feudal Age against Royal Knight, making this the best option in those matchups ( French, Jeanne d'Arc, Rus, Mongols, Golden Horde ), but they are quite expensive and weak against Archer, so you shouldn't commit to a Feudal Age all-in. Going Castle Age to get Heavy Spearman and Crossbowman would be the best strategy. Knights Hospitaller: Hospitaller Knight are decently tanky and, with good micro, they can save units from dying even while diving the enemy static defenses. Good for all-ins when supporting Archer + Horseman armies. Kingdom of France: Heavy cavalry in Feudal Age are super strong and the bonus unit production speed allows you to outproduce most civilizations in the game. Additionally, you will force the enemy to make Spearman, which you will counter with Archer. Perfect for Feudal Age all-ins unless your opponent can make heavy cavalry ( French, Jeanne d'Arc, Rus, Mongols, Golden Horde )
Mine 50 Stone and 25 Gold to upgrade Outpost with Arrowslits

Upon aging up you can do whatever you want. - All-in: Stable for Horseman / Chevalier Confrere; Archery Range for Archer; Blacksmith for Iron Undermesh and Siege Engineering. - 2 Town Centers: Send Villager to Wood and Stone during age up. - Fast Castle Age: Macro towards Food and Gold while the enemy is distracted trying to take down the Outpost

title: 1TC proxy barracks Hospitalier rush
description: a very aggressive hospitalier rush build which has emerged on ladder this season. Made much stronger by hospitalier move speed buff, piligrim tech cost reductions, and people getting more and more used to KT being a 2TC civ.
author: Entropic
steps: 6 Villagers on Food, next 2 Villagers on Wood on straggler tree. Build House with one of food villagers.
next 3 Villagers on Gold
next 1 Villager on Food; next Villager goes out on the map to eventually build proxy barracks. Make sure your Scout circles around enemy base to see where his Gold is.
next 1 Villager on Wood, start age-up with Knights Hospitaller
immediately after age up, transfer 4 vills from Food on Wood (use straggler tree). The goal is to gather 350 food until age up finishes for Barracks and Safe Passage

use Villager out on the map to build proxy Barracks, on the map, preferably close to opponent's Gold, but also aim for position close to the middle of the map, from which it's easy to rally units anywhere you need. After finishing building, Villager goes on Wood

From here, everything depends on what opponent does. Primarily you use Hospitaller Knight + Archer to efficiently trade with opponent's army, Make sure to use hold position micro as much as possible to get heals during the fight. Any non-all-in trades are good, as you can use Hospitaller Knight to completely heal up your army outside combat, while opponent in a lot of cases can't do the same.
after age up finishes - immediately start producing Hospitaller Knight, at home research Safe Passage, transfer 4 Villagers back on Food

go up to 10 Villagers on Food, transfer 5 of them on closest Deer once you start banking resources. Keep up Hospitaller Knight production. Add second proxy Barracks once you have enough Wood. Start saturating Gold more after this.

from here, you should be able to consistently pump out Hospitaller Knight from two barracks and pressure opponent's resources, while Safe Passage provides extra gold for upgrades. If opponent tries to defend resources with Outpost - just hold-position Hospitaller Knight under it. Make sure you scout for any attempts to sneak resources out on the map and send Hospitaller Knight there if it's discovered.

after previous step, the build becomes more flexible, but you should start saturating Wood more, as you'll need a lot of extra buildings. Very common response from opponents are Archer, adding your own Archery Range Archery Range Archer in response is effective (use proxy builder Villager to build next to opponent's base). Add Outpost on your resources in case of counter-raids. Build Blacksmith and get Iron Undermesh ASAP. Research Steeled Arrow once you have enough archers.

If opponent doesn't lose in feudal, eventually you will need to age up. Possible options include Kingdom of Castile and Angevin Empire, depending on what units you think you will need. Angevin Empire provides Heavy Spearman which is very good against any Horseman attempts to counter your archers. Against very large amounts of Archer (also, depending on the civ, possible inclusions of ranged cav) - going Kingdom of Castile and Genitour can be a good option: Hospitaller Knight form a solid frontline, while Genitour poke everything to death.

If the game stabilizes - prioritize Monastery, get as many Relic as possible; start gathering Stone to secure at least one sacred site with Fortress, play standard game from there. Extra note: this build is not recommended at all into: French Macedonian Dynasty Jeanne d'Arc - they have pretty strong early feudal tempo and they outscale your army in long feudal; Be careful vs: Mongols Malians Delhi Sultanate Ottomans Rus English Ayyubids - I think these civs have tools to deal with this build more or less effectively, although if they blindly go for greedy build orders and try to defend with Outpost - they can easily lose. Otherwise you can just not commit as hard into feudal and go for earlier castle age. Knights Templar mirror can also be very tricky, strongly depends on what they age up with and what build they're going for. In other matchups this build should work well.
Get Wedge Rivets and veteran upgrades ASAP, use your age up of choice to add relevant units. Usually you can find a timing to all-in opponent after all upgrades are done.

See to the left. Idea economy
Production buildings: 4 Stables; 2 Barracks

Our Gold income is enough to keep a constant production of Mounted Samurai from 3 Stables, and since we will be adding Farm, we will eventually have an excess of Food that we can use to make Yari to counter Crossbowman or Naginata Samurai to counter Spearman.

Sword Hunt Statue: The increase to the Daimyo attack speed aura makes Sengoku Daimyo army insanely strong. By far the best option. Castle of the Crow: Good in closed maps with key chokepoints. Overall quite weaker in team games.

Research elite ( Imperial Age ) upgrade for the Mounted Samurai. Later build University and research Biology. Then you can consider researching elite upgrades for Yari, Naginata Samurai and Tanegashima Ashigaru

Tanegashima Ashigaru are a good addition to the army since they are ranged units and benefit a lot from the bonus attack speed of Daimyo. Ikko Ikki Monk are also a great addition to the frontline, since they can heal the whole army every time they attack and can become quite tanky with upgrades, and they don't receive bonus damage from either Archer or Crossbowman.
Last but not least, research Oda Tactics and Serpentine Powder as well as Samurai Bow and Buddhist Temple upgrades.

title: New Player Guide to Sengoku Daimyo
description: As basic as possible Sengoku build order for new players. Video below! The goal is to build a Feudal Age army of Yari Cavalry + Yumi Ashigaru and attack. There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build and attack: 1. Go all-in with aggression! Make more production for more units, get siege engineering from the blacksmith so you can make rams with your infantry, and keep your food villagers working by adding farms or putting them on deer, boar or berries. 2. Go Castle Age! Put a few more villagers to gold (or use the Matsuri market to buy/sell if you're floating resources) and age up with the Sake Brewery. Upgrade your Yumi and spam Mounted Samurai alongside your Daimyo to go kill your opponent with an incredibly strong unit composition! Once you're feeling comfortable with this build, look for a more advanced and optimal build order. Note against feudal knight civs, you may want to alter this build and try spear + horsemen in Feudal instead. title: OotD | Stable rush
description: Greedy opener with very early horsemen to put pressure while hunt boar food for a massive economic power spike. Ideal for FC

Gilded Archer is the best unit of OotD. They should be the backbone of your army, then use other units to complement them depending on the opponent's composition. Gilded Man-at-Arms to tank archers and zhuge-nu defended by spearmen. Gilded Horseman to counter mass ranged armies. Gilded Spearman to counter cavalry and protect your Gilded Archer
Meinwerk Palace Villager,then Stable,then Gold
Start recruiting Gilded Horseman and raid ASAP (you might have to force-drop food). To just raid, 2 are enough; 4 maximum. Send them in pairs to raid different resources at the same time.

Rally,then Wood for: - Aggressive playstyle: Archery Range,then Barracks and Battering Ram (balance Food and Wood ); - Defensive playstyle: Barracks and Outpost and Palisade Wall; - Or economic playstyle: Mill on Deer Boar and Town Center. Rally,then Gold (6) for FC [I started aging up at 7:23 with 2 horsemen]. Rally,then Stone if you want 2nd Town Center after getting at least 6 Wood Villager
Economic upgrades: Survival Techniques,then Double Broadax,then Wheelbarrow,then Forestry,then Specialized Pick

Military upgrades: Always Iron Undermesh unless you plan on going FC; If you want to all-in Steeled Arrow,then Siege Engineering,then Fitted Leatherwork,then Bloomery. Only research Golden Cuirass if the game stays in Feudal Age for very long and you are making Gilded Man-at-Arms
Instead of rushing Castle Age like Holy Roman Empire, first make a decent army to protect Relic and your hunt economy.

Regnitz Cathedral if you are aging up earlier than your opponent or if you have a big army advantage to secure Relic. Burgrave Palace if you are behind, if the opponent has a big army or if you want to make a super strong all-in in Castle Age

description: Fast Council Hall rush, with tips for team games and a smooth transition to Castle Age in case an all-in is not viable.
author: Jockxtar
steps: 6 Villagers,then Sheep

When 3900 left in Gold vein; 3 Gold Villager,then Wood
